I observed a male, later identified as (A), white male, 21 years of age, arguing with a bar security guard outside "The Red Door" at 123 Main St. The subject was yelling and gesturing aggressively towards the security guard, causing a disturbance and attracting a crowd. I exited my vehicle and approached the subject, identifying myself as a police officer.

(A) was advised to calm down and disperse, but he refused to comply, continuing to yell and threaten the security guard. I gave verbal commands to (A) to step back and place his hands behind his back, but he failed to comply. (A) took a step towards the security guard, and I perceived a threat to the officer's safety. I then grabbed (A)'s left arm with my right hand and placed my other hand on his upper back to control him. (A) resisted, attempting to pull away and push me. I applied a control hold, using a wrist lock to control (A)'s left arm, and (A) was then able to be handcuffed with assistance from backup officers.

(A) continued to struggle and yell, but eventually became compliant. I then placed (A) in a seated position on the sidewalk and read him his Miranda rights. (A) was subsequently transported to the police station for further processing.

S immediately became verbally aggressive, yelling "I ain't doing shit, you can't tell me what to do!" and stepping towards Ofc. [NAME] in an aggressive manner.

I gave S several verbal commands to step back and calm down. S ignored these commands, clenched his fists, and took a fighting stance, stating, "Come on then, let's go!" Fearing S would assault Ofc. [NAME], I grabbed S's right arm and attempted to guide him away from the store entrance. S immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away forcefully, and spun around, attempting to break free from my grasp. Due to S's active resistance and aggressive posture, Ofc. [NAME] and I initiated a controlled takedown to the ground. S continued to struggle on the ground, kicking his legs and attempting to push himself up. After several seconds of active resistance, we were able to secure S's hands behind his back in handcuffs. S remained verbally combative while being escorted to the patrol vehicle.

Narrative:
On 11/15/23 at approximately 1930 hours, I responded to the report of a disturbance at 745 Main Street (QuickMart). Dispatch advised a female subject was refusing to leave the premises and was yelling at staff. Upon arrival, I observed a female, later identified as (A), standing near the counter, shouting obscenities at the store clerk. I approached (A) and identified myself as a police officer, ordering her to calm down and exit the store. (A) turned towards me, her eyes wide, and stated, "I ain't going anywhere, you pigs can't make me." She then took a step back and clenched her fists. Fearing she was preparing to assault me or the clerk, I gave further verbal commands for her to place her hands behind her back. (A) refused, tensing her body and pulling her arms close to her chest. Ofc. [NAME] arrived on scene and attempted to grab (A)'s left arm. (A) actively pulled away, spinning her body and yelling "Get off me!" I then secured (A)'s right arm and, with Ofc. [NAME], guided her towards the exit. (A) continued to resist, planting her feet and attempting to pull free. We utilized a controlled take-down to the ground, where she continued to struggle but was eventually secured in handcuffs.

Narrative: On 06/15/2023 at approximately 2015 hours, I responded to the Walmart at 123 Main St regarding a report of shoplifting. Loss Prevention identified a female, later identified as (S), a 20-year-old Black female, who had concealed merchandise and attempted to leave the store without payment. Upon making contact, I requested (S)'s identification and explained the reason for the stop. (S) immediately became agitated, yelling, "I didn't do anything!" and refused to provide identification. I gave repeated verbal commands for (S) to calm down and place her hands behind her back, advising her she was being detained. (S) continued to yell, stating, "You can't touch me!" and attempted to walk away from me. As I reached for her arm to prevent her departure, (S) pulled her arm away forcefully and began to actively resist, tensing her body and attempting to twist free. Ofc. [NAME] arrived on scene and assisted. We utilized a wrist lock control technique to gain compliance. (S) continued to struggle, kicking her legs and screaming obscenities. After several seconds of active resistance, we were able to bring (S) to the ground and secure her hands in handcuffs. During the struggle, (S) scratched Ofc. [NAME] forearm. Once handcuffed, (S) continued to be verbally combative but ceased physical resistance. She was then escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2030 hours, I responded to the area of 45 Elm Street for a report of a male causing a disturbance, yelling at passersby and obstructing the sidewalk. Upon arrival, I observed S (later identified as a 57-year-old Black male) standing in the middle of the sidewalk, yelling unintelligibly at no one in particular. His eyes appeared bloodshot, and he swayed slightly. I approached S and identified myself as a police officer, asking him to move to the side of the sidewalk. S ignored my commands, continuing to yell and waving his arms erratically.

Ofc. [NAME] arrived to assist. We attempted to verbally de-escalate the situation, explaining that S needed to clear the public right-of-way. S turned towards us, stating "I ain't going anywhere, this is my street!" and took a step forward. Due to his agitated state, lack of compliance, and obstruction, we decided to take S into custody for disorderly conduct. I informed S he was under arrest and reached for his left arm to apply handcuffs. S immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away, and attempted to turn his body from me. Ofc. [NAME] secured S's right arm. S continued to pull and twist, refusing to place his hands behind his back. We utilized a joint manipulation technique to gain control of S's left arm, guiding him to the ground where we were able to successfully apply handcuffs after a brief struggle. S continued to verbally protest but ceased physical resistance once cuffed. He was then assisted to his feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 22:15 hours, I responded to 123 Elm St for a report of a disturbance. Dispatch advised a female, later identified as (A), a 33-year-old white female, was heavily intoxicated and refusing to leave the residence after an argument with the homeowner. Upon arrival, I observed (A) yelling loudly in the living room, slurring her words, and throwing items from a coffee table. I attempted to de-escalate the situation, giving clear verbal commands for (A) to calm down and cease her behavior. (A) turned towards me, yelling "I'm not going anywhere, you can't make me!" and advanced aggressively. Fearing for my safety and the safety of others, I advised (A) she was under arrest for disorderly conduct. As I attempted to take her into custody, (A) tensed her body, pulled her arms away, and began to flail. I secured (A)'s left arm in a wrist-lock control hold. (A) continued to twist and kick, making verbal threats. Ofc. [NAME] assisted by securing (A)'s right arm. We maintained control, guiding (A) to the ground in a controlled manner to prevent injury. On the ground, (A) continued to resist by pulling her hands under her body. After several verbal commands to show her hands, Ofc. [NAME] applied a knee strike to (A)'s left thigh, which allowed me to secure her left wrist in handcuffs. We then secured her right wrist. (A) continued to yell and resist while being escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On the above date and time, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to a report of a suspicious male, later identified as (A), fitting the description of a male seen attempting to force entry into the rear of 123 Main St., a closed vape shop. Upon arrival, I observed (A) attempting to conceal himself behind a dumpster. I exited my patrol vehicle and gave clear verbal commands, "Police, don't move, show me your hands!" (A) ignored my commands and immediately began to flee on foot towards an alleyway.

I initiated a foot pursuit, continually ordering (A) to stop. After a short chase, I closed the distance and made physical contact, attempting to grab (A)'s left arm to prevent further flight. (A) actively resisted, pulling his arm away with force and twisting his body, attempting to break my grasp. Due to (A)'s continued resistance and flight, I utilized a takedown maneuver, bringing (A) to the ground in a controlled manner.

On the ground, (A) continued to struggle, tensing his body and attempting to push himself up despite repeated verbal commands to stop resisting and place his hands behind his back. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted in securing (A)'s arms. While attempting to gain control of (A)'s right arm, (A) pulled his arm violently forward, nearly striking Ofc. [NAME]. I applied a brief knee-strike to (A)'s mid-back area to gain compliance, which was effective. We were then able to secure (A) in handcuffs without further incident. (A) was then searched and transported to the precinct.

Narrative: On 11/15/23 at approximately 23:15 hours, I responded to the report of a disorderly female refusing to leave "The Tap Room" bar at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a white female, later identified as (A), standing near the entrance, yelling obscenities at bar staff and patrons. (A) appeared heavily intoxicated, displaying slurred speech and an unsteady gait. I approached (A) and verbally identified myself as a police officer, instructing her to calm down and exit the premises. (A) turned towards me, her eyes bloodshot, and loudly stated, "I'm not going anywhere, you can't make me!"

As I attempted to guide (A) by her arm towards the exit, she violently pulled away, twisting her body and yelling, "Don't touch me!" Due to her continued refusal to comply and escalating aggression, I informed (A) she was under arrest for disorderly conduct. (A) immediately tensed her body, pulling her arms tightly to her chest, making it impossible to secure her hands. Ofc. [NAME] arrived to assist. We attempted a joint escort hold, but (A) actively resisted, kicking her legs and attempting to pull away from our grasp. To prevent injury to herself or officers, I initiated a controlled takedown to the ground. (A) continued to struggle on the ground, tensing her arms, but Ofc. [NAME] and I were able to gain control of her arms and place her in handcuffs. She was then escorted to the patrol vehicle without further physical incident, though she remained verbally abusive.

On the above date and time, I responded to a report of a disturbance at 720 Main Street, a local grocery store. Dispatch advised a female, later identified as (A), Race=BLACK, Sex=FEMALE, Age=51, was yelling at employees and refusing to leave the premises. Upon arrival, I observed (A) standing near the checkout aisles, shouting profanities at a store manager. I approached (A) and identified myself as a police officer, explaining the reason for our presence and requesting her to calm down and exit the store. (A) immediately turned her aggression towards me, yelling, "I ain't going nowhere! You can't make me leave!" and began pointing her finger aggressively in my face.

I issued multiple verbal commands for (A) to cease her disruptive behavior and leave the property. (A) ignored all commands and attempted to push past me to re-enter a restricted employee area. Fearing (A) would further escalate the disturbance or confront additional staff, I placed my hand on her upper arm to guide her towards the exit. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled her arm away, and swung her arm backward, striking my forearm. Ofc. [NAME] then assisted, and we applied a control hold to (A)'s arms. (A) continued to resist by pulling her body away and attempting to kick backward. Due to her active resistance, we transitioned to a controlled takedown to the ground. (A) was then secured in handcuffs without further incident. She continued to verbally protest during transport.

On the above date and time, I responded to a report of a male refusing to leave the premises of the public library, which was closed. Upon arrival, I observed a male, later identified as S, a 59-year-old white male, sitting at a table near the entrance, surrounded by several bags. I approached S and advised him the library was closed and he needed to gather his belongings and exit. S responded by stating, "I'm not leaving, I live here," and refused to make eye contact. His speech was slow, and he appeared disoriented. I repeatedly gave S verbal commands to stand up and comply, but he remained seated, tensing his body and gripping the edge of the table.

After several minutes of attempting to gain voluntary compliance, I advised S that he would be placed under arrest for trespass. As I reached for S's arm to assist him to his feet, S pulled his arm away sharply, stating "Get away from me!" and attempted to stand up abruptly while turning his body away from me. Fearing S might attempt to flee or become combative, I applied an escort hold to S's left arm. S continued to tense and pull against my grasp, necessitating a controlled takedown to the ground to prevent further resistance. Once on the ground, S continued to struggle by tucking his hands under his body. After repeated verbal commands to show his hands, Ofc. [NAME] applied a pressure point control technique to S's ear, which allowed us to secure S's hands in handcuffs. S was then assisted to his feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle.

Narrative:
On 11/15/23 at approximately 22:15 hours, officers responded to a report of a disorderly female at 'The Corner Pub,' located at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a white female, later identified as (A), aged 34, yelling loudly and refusing to leave the premises as requested by bar staff. Narrative:
On 11/15/23 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded with Ofc. Green to 456 Oak Avenue for a reported domestic disturbance. Dispatch advised of a female, later identified as (A) Sarah [NAME], 34, White, Female, yelling and throwing items inside the residence, with a male caller stating she was highly intoxicated and refusing to leave. Upon arrival, we heard loud verbal arguments from within. We made contact with (A) at the front door. She appeared visibly agitated, slurring her words, and had a strong odor of alcohol emanating from her person. We attempted to de-escalate the situation and understand what occurred. (A) became increasingly belligerent, yelling "I'm not going anywhere, this is my house!" and refused to comply with verbal commands to separate from the male party or step outside. When Ofc. Green attempted to guide her by the arm to speak with her away from the door, (A) tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and stepped back into the doorway, blocking our entry. I then informed (A) that she was being detained for disorderly conduct. As I attempted to secure her left arm for handcuffing, (A) actively resisted, pulling her arm away, twisting her body, and yelling "Don't touch me!" Ofc. Green assisted by securing her right arm. We utilized a joint escort hold to gain control and, after a brief struggle lasting approximately 20 seconds, were able to bring her hands behind her back and apply handcuffs without further incident. (A) remained verbally abusive but compliant during the escort to the patrol vehicle.

On 03/12/2023 at approximately 2330 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to a report of a disturbance at Elm Street Park. Upon arrival, we observed a group of approximately five individuals, one of whom, later identified as (A), a white male, age 19, was highly agitated and yelling loudly. (A) appeared heavily intoxicated, swaying, and slurring his words. We approached the group and advised them to disperse. (A) immediately became verbally aggressive, yelling "You can't tell me what to do!" and stepping towards Ofc. [NAME] in an aggressive manner.

I ordered (A) to step back and calm down. (A) ignored my commands, clenched his fists, and took a bladed stance, stating, "Come on, then!" Perceiving (A) as an immediate threat due to his aggressive posture and refusal to comply, I informed him he was under arrest for disorderly conduct. As I attempted to grab his left arm to place him in handcuffs, (A) tensed up and pulled away forcefully, attempting to spin away from my grasp. Ofc. [NAME] moved to assist, securing (A)'s right arm. (A) continued to actively resist, pulling his arms away and trying to twist his body. I then executed a straight arm bar takedown, bringing (A) to the ground onto his stomach.

Once on the ground, (A) continued to struggle, tucking his hands under his chest. Ofc. [NAME] applied pressure to (A)'s shoulder blade while I delivered two closed-fist strikes to (A)'s right side to gain compliance. After the strikes, (A) released his hands, and we were able to successfully handcuff him behind his back. (A) continued to yell obscenities but ceased physical resistance. He was then escorted to the patrol vehicle without further incident.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2030 hours, I responded to a call for service regarding a group of individuals loitering and blocking the sidewalk in front of 123 Main St, a known area for drug activity. Upon arrival, I observed a group of 4-5 males matching the description. As I exited my patrol vehicle, I gave verbal commands for the group to disperse. One individual, later identified as (A), a Black male, 18, refused to comply. He stated, "I ain't doing nothing wrong, I'm just chilling," and began to walk away from the group, ignoring my repeated commands to stop.

I moved to intercept (A), placing my hand on his shoulder and ordering him to stop. (A) immediately tensed up, shrugged off my hand, and attempted to push past me. Fearing he was attempting to flee or potentially arm himself, I attempted to gain control of his left arm to secure him. (A) actively resisted, pulling his arm away forcefully and spinning to face me in an aggressive stance, clenching his fists. Due to his active resistance and aggressive posture, I drew my department-issued taser and gave clear verbal commands: "Police! Taser! Get on the ground!" (A) continued to stand his ground, yelling "I told you, I ain't doing nothing!" I deployed my taser, striking (A) in the torso. (A) immediately fell to the ground, allowing Ofc. [NAME] and I to secure his hands behind his back without further incident. (A) was then searched and transported.

Narrative: On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Main St for a report of a male causing a disturbance. Upon arrival, I observed S (a 38-year-old Black male) yelling loudly at a group of individuals on the sidewalk. S was visibly agitated, gesturing wildly. I approached S and identified myself, advising him he needed to calm down and explain the situation. S immediately turned his aggression towards me, stating "I ain't doing shit, mind your own business!" and took a step towards me. I ordered S to stop and put his hands behind his back. S refused, clenching his fists and yelling profanities. Fearing S would become assaultive, I attempted to grab S's left arm to gain control. S immediately tensed up, pulling his arm away forcefully and spinning to face me, taking a bladed stance. Ofc. [NAME] then moved to assist. S continued to resist, pulling and pushing against both officers. I delivered a single open-hand strike to S's upper arm to break his resistance, which had no immediate effect. Ofc. [NAME] then performed a leg sweep, taking S to the ground. S continued to struggle on the ground, attempting to push himself up. I delivered two knee strikes to S's thigh while Ofc. [NAME] secured S's arms. S eventually ceased actively resisting and was handcuffed without further incident. S was subsequently charged with Disorderly Conduct and Resisting Arrest.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 1430 hours, I responded to a report of an elderly female shoplifter refusing to leave the "Corner Mart" at 123 Main Street. Upon arrival, I observed a Black female, later identified as P. Jenkins, age 65, standing near the cashier's counter, yelling at the store manager and refusing to identify herself or leave the premises. Ms. Jenkins was clutching a small purse tightly to her chest.

I approached Ms. Jenkins and attempted to de-escalate the situation, explaining the store's complaint and requesting her cooperation. Ms. Jenkins ignored my verbal commands, stating, "I'm not going anywhere, I didn't do nothing." She then attempted to walk past me towards the exit. Fearing she would flee, I placed my hand on her upper arm, instructing her to stop and comply with my orders. Ms. Jenkins immediately tensed up, pulled her arm away sharply, and attempted to continue towards the door, verbally resisting by repeating, "Don't touch me!"

Due to her active resistance and refusal to comply, Ofc. [NAME] assisted me in performing a two-officer escort hold. We each took one of Ms. Jenkins's arms, attempting to guide her out of the store. Ms. Jenkins continued to pull against our hold, digging her heels in and refusing to walk. We maintained a firm but controlled grip, slowly guiding her outside to the patrol vehicle. During the escort, Ms. Jenkins remained verbally abusive and passively resisted by going limp and tensing her body, requiring us to physically support and move her to the rear passenger seat of my cruiser. She was then secured without further incident.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2030 hours, I responded to 742 Elm Street for a report of a disturbance involving a trespasser refusing to leave. Upon arrival, I made contact with the complainant who identified the subject, later identified as (A), a 46-year-old Black female, sitting on the front porch. (A) appeared heavily intoxicated, was yelling incoherently, and refused to acknowledge my presence. I gave multiple verbal commands for (A) to stand up and leave the property. (A) responded by yelling, "I ain't going nowhere! You can't make me!" and remained seated.

Due to her continued refusal to comply and the complainant's desire for her removal, I attempted to assist (A) to her feet by taking her left arm. (A) continued to struggle, kicking her legs and pulling away from both officers. To overcome her active resistance and prevent further escalation, I applied a single open-hand strike to (A)'s left upper arm. This momentarily broke her resistance, allowing Ofc. [NAME] to secure her right arm in an escort hold. I then secured her left arm, and we were able to place (A) in handcuffs without further physical force. Narrative: On 11/15/23 at approximately 1930 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to 789 Elm Street for a welfare check on a female, later identified as (A), reported by her neighbor to be disoriented and yelling at passersby. Upon arrival, we observed (A) standing in her front yard, visibly agitated, and shouting incoherently towards the street. Her clothes were disheveled, and she appeared confused.

I attempted to engage (A) verbally from a safe distance, asking if she was okay and if she needed assistance. (A) immediately became defensive, yelling, "Get off my property! You have no right!" and began waving her arms erratically. Due to her agitated state and the neighbor's report, we determined a mental health evaluation was necessary. As Ofc. [NAME] approached to offer a transport, (A) took a step back, yelled "No!", and attempted to push Ofc. [NAME] away with both hands.

To prevent further resistance and ensure her safety for transport, I secured (A)'s right arm using a wrist control technique, while Ofc. [NAME] secured her left. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled against our grip, and tried to twist her body away, refusing to walk towards the patrol vehicle. We maintained the controlled escort hold, guiding her to the rear passenger door. (A) continued to brace her feet and pull backward, requiring Ofc. [NAME] and I to physically lift and place her into the rear seat of the patrol car. Once inside, she continued to verbally protest but ceased physical resistance. (A) was transported to St. [NAME]'s Hospital for evaluation.

On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Main St regarding a noise complaint for a large gathering. Upon arrival, I observed approximately 30-40 individuals in the front yard, several holding open containers of alcohol. I approached a group where the female subject, later identified as (A), was loudly arguing with another individual. I intervened, attempting to de-escalate the situation and obtain identification from both parties. (A) immediately became defensive, yelling "I ain't doing nothing wrong!" and refusing to provide her name. I gave multiple verbal commands for (A) to calm down and step away from the group. She ignored my commands, continued to yell, and attempted to push past me. Fearing the situation would escalate further, I advised (A) she was being detained and attempted to take her arm. (A) immediately pulled her arm away forcefully, tensing her body and bracing herself. Ofc. [NAME] then assisted, and we attempted to secure (A)'s arms behind her back. (A) actively resisted, pulling her arms free and thrashing her body. We were able to gain control of her left arm, but (A) continued to twist and kick, preventing us from securing her right arm. After several verbal warnings to stop resisting, Ofc. [NAME] applied a single closed-fist strike to (A)'s upper thigh. This allowed us to momentarily gain compliance and secure both of (A)'s wrists in handcuffs. (A) continued to yell and struggle as she was escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On 03/15/2024 at approximately 22:15 hours, officers responded to a report of a loud party and disturbance at 123 Elm Street. Upon arrival, I observed a large gathering of individuals, many appearing to be underage, in the front yard. As officers attempted to disperse the crowd, I observed a white female, later identified as (A) Jane Doe, age 18, yelling obscenities and refusing to comply with verbal commands to leave the property. (A) was actively attempting to push past Officer [NAME], who was establishing a perimeter.

I approached (A) and instructed her multiple times to calm down and step away from the area. (A) turned towards me, her face flushed, and shouted, "You can't tell me what to do!" She then attempted to walk past me. Due to her non-compliance and continued disruptive behavior, I informed (A) she was being detained. As I reached for her arm to guide her, (A) immediately tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and attempted to push me backward.

I utilized an escort hold on (A)'s left arm and directed her towards my patrol vehicle. (A) continued to resist by pulling her arm, twisting her body, and planting her feet, making it difficult to move her. Ofc. [NAME] assisted by securing (A)'s right arm. We then guided (A) to the rear of my patrol vehicle. She continued to tense her body and yell, refusing to sit in the patrol car. After several verbal commands to comply were ignored, Ofc. [NAME] and I carefully applied pressure to her shoulders, guiding her into the rear seat. Handcuffs were then applied without further physical resistance once she was seated.

On the above date and time, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to a report of a disturbance at the 1200 block of Elm Street. Upon arrival, we observed a Black female, later identified as S, age 38, yelling obscenities at passersby and blocking pedestrian traffic. S appeared heavily intoxicated, swaying and slurring her speech. We attempted to engage S, advising her to calm down and move along. S immediately became agitated, yelling, "I ain't going nowhere!" and began to walk aggressively towards Ofc. [NAME], clenching her fists.

Fearing S would assault Ofc. [NAME], I stepped between them and gave S verbal commands to step back and place her hands behind her back. S refused, shouting "Get your hands off me!" and attempted to push past me. I grabbed S's left arm in an attempt to gain control and guide her hands behind her back for handcuffing. S actively resisted, pulling her arm away with considerable force and twisting her body. Ofc. [NAME] then assisted by securing S's right arm. Due to S's continued violent resistance and refusal to comply, we performed a controlled takedown to the ground. S continued to struggle on the ground, kicking her legs and attempting to roll over, requiring both officers to maintain control before handcuffs could be applied. Once handcuffed, S continued to yell but ceased physical resistance.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 14:30 hours, officers responded to 123 Maple Street for a welfare check. Dispatch advised a 56-year-old female, later identified as (A), was reportedly yelling incoherently at neighbors and refusing to open her door. Upon arrival, I observed (A) standing on her porch, visibly agitated, speaking loudly to herself. I attempted to engage (A) verbally, identifying myself as law enforcement and asking if she needed assistance. (A) ignored my commands, turned her back, and attempted to re-enter her residence, stating "You can't come in here!" in an aggressive tone.

Fearing for her safety and the safety of others given the initial report of disorientation and agitation, I approached (A) as she reached her front door. I verbally ordered her to stop and turn around. (A) continued to ignore me and attempted to close the door. To prevent her from retreating into the residence and potentially escalating the situation further, I placed my left hand on her right upper arm and my right hand on her back to guide her away from the door. (A) immediately tensed up, began to pull away, and attempted to twist her body to break my grasp, repeatedly yelling "Get off me!" and "Leave me alone!"

I maintained my control hold and, with the assistance of Ofc. [NAME], we were able to safely escort (A) away from the doorway and towards the sidewalk. During the escort, (A) continued to pull her arms away and resist by tensing her body. We verbally instructed her to relax and comply. Due to her continued active resistance and agitation, Ofc. [NAME] applied an escort hold to her left arm while I maintained control of her right. We were able to secure her in handcuffs, at which point she continued to verbally protest but ceased active physical resistance. She was then safely transported for a mental health evaluation.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded to the area of Willow Creek Park for a report of an intoxicated female causing a disturbance. Upon arrival, I observed a White female, later identified as (A), sitting on a park bench yelling obscenities at passersby. (A) appeared heavily intoxicated, displaying slurred speech and an unsteady gait. I approached (A) and identified myself as police, advising her of the complaint. (A) immediately became defensive, stating, "I'm not doing anything wrong, leave me alone!" and attempted to stand up and walk away.

I gave (A) verbal commands to remain seated and explained she was being detained for public intoxication and disorderly conduct. (A) ignored my commands and actively tried to walk past me. I then placed my hand on her upper arm in an attempt to guide her back to the bench. (A) tensed her arm, pulled away, and began to flail her arms, yelling "Get off me!" and attempting to strike my arm. Due to her active resistance and continued attempts to flee, I initiated a control hold, placing her left arm behind her back. (A) continued to pull away and struggle, twisting her body and kicking her legs. Ofc. [NAME] arrived on scene and assisted in securing (A)'s right arm. We were able to control (A) and place her in handcuffs. (A) continued to verbally resist and pull against the handcuffs as she was escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On the above date and time, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to a noise complaint at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, we observed a large gathering with loud music and several individuals who appeared underage. We made contact with a female, later identified as (S), who was visibly intoxicated, slurring her words and holding an open container. I instructed (S) to provide identification and put down her drink. (S) refused, yelling, "I'm not doing anything wrong!" and attempted to walk back inside the residence. Ofc. [NAME] ordered her to stop, but (S) ignored the commands and continued towards the door.

I stepped in front of (S) to block her path and reached for her left arm to prevent her from evading. (S) immediately pulled her arm away, tensing her body and twisting to break free, screaming, "Get off me! You can't touch me!" Due to her active resistance, I applied a wristlock control technique to her left arm. (S) continued to pull away forcefully, trying to escape my grasp. Ofc. [NAME] assisted by securing her right arm. We gave repeated verbal commands to stop resisting and place her hands behind her back. (S) continued to struggle, kicking her legs and yelling. After a brief struggle, we were able to bring (S) to the ground in a controlled manner. She continued to tense her body and resist having the handcuffs applied but eventually complied after several more verbal commands. She was then secured in handcuffs and escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to 123 Elm St for a report of a disturbance. Dispatch advised a female, later identified as (A), was refusing to leave the residence and was yelling at the caller. Upon arrival, I made contact with the caller who stated (A) was intoxicated and had become aggressive after being asked to leave. I then approached (A), who was standing in the living room, actively yelling into a phone. I identified myself as law enforcement and explained the reason for my presence, asking (A) to calm down and step outside to speak. (A) ignored my commands, continued yelling, and began pacing aggressively.

I again instructed (A) to step outside. (A) turned towards me, stating "You can't make me do anything" and took a step closer, raising her voice. Due to her escalating behavior and the caller's statement of aggression, I informed (A) she was being placed under arrest for disorderly conduct. As I attempted to secure her left arm, (A) immediately tensed up, pulled her arm away, and began to twist her body, attempting to create distance. I maintained control of her arm and issued verbal commands to stop resisting and place her hands behind her back. (A) continued to pull away, yelling "Get off me!" and actively resisting my attempts to bring her arms behind her back. I utilized a wristlock control technique to gain compliance, which was met with further resistance. Ofc. [NAME] then assisted, securing (A)'s right arm, and we were able to apply handcuffs after a brief struggle. (A) continued to be verbally combative while being escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On the above date and time, I responded to a 911 call regarding a suspicious male attempting to break into vehicles in the apartment complex parking lot at 123 Elm St. Upon arrival, I observed a Black male, later identified as S (23), matching the description, actively pulling on car door handles. I exited my patrol vehicle and gave S verbal commands, "Police, show me your hands!" S immediately looked at me, then turned and began to walk away quickly, ignoring my repeated commands. I ran to catch up to S, again ordering him to stop and show his hands. S then broke into a sprint, attempting to flee through a breezeway. I initiated a foot pursuit, continually giving verbal commands to stop. As S exited the breezeway, I closed the distance and initiated a controlled takedown by grabbing S's left arm and turning him to the ground. S landed on his left side, actively resisting by pulling his arm away and attempting to push himself up. I delivered two open-hand strikes to S's left upper arm to gain compliance. S continued to tense up and pull his arm. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted by securing S's right arm. After a brief struggle, S was placed in handcuffs. S continued to be verbally uncooperative, yelling obscenities, but ceased physical resistance. S was then searched and transported to central booking.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 22:15 hours, I responded to 123 Main St regarding a report of a male refusing to leave the premises of a closed business. Upon arrival, I observed S standing near the entrance, yelling obscenities at a security guard. I approached S and identified myself as police, giving verbal commands for S to calm down and step away from the building. S ignored my commands, turned towards me, and began walking aggressively in my direction, stating, "I ain't going nowhere!"

I ordered S to stop and place his hands behind his back. S continued to advance, clenching his fists and adopting a fighting stance. Fearing for my safety and that of the security guard, I deployed my department-issued OC spray, aiming for S's face. The spray had a partial effect; S flinched but continued to resist, swinging his right arm towards me. I blocked the swing and, with the assistance of Ofc. [NAME], initiated a takedown to the ground. S actively resisted the takedown, tensing his body and attempting to push away. After a brief struggle, Ofc. [NAME] and I were able to gain control of S's arms and place him in handcuffs. S continued to yell and struggle even while cuffed, refusing to comply with orders to stand up. We then assisted S to his feet and escorted him to the patrol vehicle. S was charged with trespassing and resisting arrest.

On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Main St, a convenience store, for a report of an unwanted male causing a disturbance. Upon arrival, I observed a white male, later identified as (A), 28, yelling at the store clerk, his face flushed and speech slurred. I approached (A) and identified myself as police, instructing him to calm down and exit the store. (A) turned his aggression towards me, stating "I ain't going anywhere, pig!" and took a step closer, clenching his fists.

I gave multiple verbal commands for (A) to step outside and place his hands behind his back. (A) refused, yelling "Don't touch me!" and attempted to push past me. Fearing (A) would attempt to assault me or flee, I grabbed (A)'s left arm with my right hand and attempted to guide him out. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away forcefully, and swung his right elbow towards my chest. I quickly reacted by performing a straight armbar takedown, bringing (A) to the ground onto his stomach.

While on the ground, (A) continued to resist by tensing his body, tucking his arms underneath him, and attempting to roll over. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted by controlling (A)'s legs while I secured his left arm. After several firm verbal commands and applying pressure to his back, (A) eventually complied, and we were able to secure both hands in handcuffs behind his back. (A) continued to be verbally abusive but ceased active physical resistance. He was then escorted to my patrol vehicle.

On the above date and time, officers responded to a report of a disoriented female causing a disturbance outside the 'Fresh Foods' grocery store at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a Black female, later identified as (A), age 64, standing near the entrance, yelling obscenities at passing customers and blocking the flow of foot traffic. Ofc. [NAME] and I approached (A) and attempted to engage her verbally, asking if she needed assistance or medical attention. [NAME], making incidental contact with his chest. When Ofc. [NAME] gently placed his hand on her arm to guide her away, (A) tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and swung her open hand towards Ofc. [NAME], striking his uniform shirt sleeve.

Due to her continued erratic behavior, refusal to comply with lawful orders, and minor physical resistance, Ofc. [NAME] applied an escort hold to (A)'s right arm to safely guide her away from the busy entrance. (A) actively resisted the hold, pulling her arm, tensing her body, and continuing to shout. Narrative: On 11/15/23 at approximately 23:10 hours, officers responded to a report of a loud party and disturbance at 456 Maple Street. Upon arrival, a large group of individuals was observed blocking the sidewalk and playing excessively loud music. Officers gave multiple verbal commands for the group to disperse and clear the area. A female subject, later identified as (A), Race=BLACK, Sex=FEMALE, Age=20, refused to comply with orders. (A) began yelling at officers, stating "You can't make us leave!" and actively encouraged others to remain in place.

Narrative: On 11/15/23 at approximately 22:10 hours, I responded to the area of 45 Elm Street for a report of a highly intoxicated female attempting to enter parked vehicles. On 07/15/2023 at approximately 2315 hours, I responded to a report of a loud party and a disorderly female refusing to leave the premises at 123 Main Street. Upon arrival, I observed a large gathering and a female, later identified as (A), standing in the doorway, yelling obscenities at the residents. (A) appeared heavily intoxicated, slurring her words, and swaying. I attempted to engage (A) verbally, advising her to calm down and leave the property. Narrative:
On the above date and time, I responded to a report of a male causing a disturbance at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed S, a Black male, age 46, yelling obscenities at patrons outside the convenience store. S appeared highly agitated and possibly intoxicated. I approached S and gave clear verbal commands to calm down and step away from the building. S ignored my commands, turning towards me with a glare, stating "I ain't doing shit!" He then clenched his fists and took a bladed stance, posturing as if to fight. Fearing for my safety and that of Ofc. [NAME], who was assisting, I drew my department-issued taser and gave clear verbal commands: "Police! Get on the ground! Taser! Taser! Taser!" S continued to refuse, yelling "You ain't tasering me!" As S took a step forward, I deployed a drive stun to his left thigh. The taser deployment was effective, causing S to immediately drop to the ground. Ofc. [NAME] and I were then able to secure S in handcuffs without further incident. S continued to scream profanities but ceased resisting physically. He was then transported to the precinct for booking.

On 11/15/2023 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to a call for service regarding a disturbance at the intersection of Elm St and Main Ave. Dispatch advised of a white female yelling and throwing items in the street. Upon arrival, I observed the female, later identified as (A), standing in the middle of Elm St, screaming profanities at passing vehicles and attempting to impede traffic. Her speech was slurred, and she appeared heavily intoxicated.

I exited my patrol vehicle and attempted to make contact with (A). I gave her verbal commands to step out of the roadway and onto the sidewalk. (A) turned towards me, yelling "I ain't going anywhere!" and began walking aggressively towards my position. I repeated my commands, instructing her to stop and comply. (A) continued to advance, entering my personal space. Due to her aggressive demeanor and apparent intoxication, I advised her she was under arrest for disorderly conduct.

As I reached for her arm to gain control, (A) pulled away abruptly, spinning and attempting to strike me with her right hand. I blocked the attempt and utilized a wrist-lock technique to bring her arm behind her back. (A) immediately tensed up, actively pulling and twisting her body to resist handcuffing. I maintained control of her arm while delivering multiple verbal commands to "stop resisting" and "put your hands behind your back." Due to her continued active resistance, I performed a controlled take-down to the ground. (A) continued to struggle on the ground, kicking her legs and attempting to roll away. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted in securing (A)'s hands behind her back in handcuffs. Once handcuffed, (A) ceased her physical resistance but continued to yell obscenities. She was then escorted to my patrol vehicle.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2030 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to 123 Main St regarding a domestic disturbance. Dispatch advised a male, later identified as (A), was highly intoxicated, yelling, and throwing items inside the residence. Upon arrival, we heard loud shouting from within. (A) opened the door, his eyes bloodshot, breath smelling strongly of alcohol. He immediately became verbally aggressive, yelling "Get off my property!" and attempting to push the door closed. We ordered (A) to step outside and calm down, but he refused, instead stepping out onto the porch and advancing towards Ofc. [NAME], clenching his fists. Fearing for Ofc. [NAME] safety, I grabbed (A)'s left arm to create distance and gain control. (A) immediately tensed up, pulling his arm away forcefully and attempting to swing his right arm at me. I initiated a takedown, bringing (A) to the ground in a controlled manner. On the ground, (A) continued to struggle, tucking his hands beneath his chest and refusing to comply with orders to show his hands. Ofc. [NAME] delivered two closed-fist strikes to (A)'s left shoulder blade area to gain compliance. (A) then yelled "Okay, I'll stop!" and allowed his hands to be secured in handcuffs. He remained verbally combative during transport but did not physically resist further.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to 123 Main St for a report of a domestic disturbance. Dispatch advised a male subject was yelling at a female outside the residence. [NAME] and I approached, identifying ourselves as police. (S) turned towards us, his face flushed, and continued to yell, ignoring our presence. I gave multiple verbal commands for (S) to calm down and step off the porch. (S) yelled "I ain't doing nothing wrong!" and took a step towards Ofc. [NAME] in an aggressive manner, clenching his fists. Fearing for Ofc. [NAME] safety and my own, I grabbed (S)'s left arm in an attempt to gain control and de-escalate the situation. (S) immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away, and attempted to spin around. I maintained my grip and executed a straight armbar takedown to the ground. (S) landed on his stomach, continuing to struggle and attempt to push himself up. Ofc. On the above date and time, I responded to the report of a suspicious vehicle with a male occupant slumped over the wheel in the parking lot of 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a white male, later identified as [Subject's Name/A], asleep in the driver's seat of a blue sedan. I made verbal contact, knocking on the window. [A] woke up, appeared disoriented, and refused to roll down his window or acknowledge my presence for several moments. After repeated commands, [A] eventually cracked the window. I detected a strong odor of an alcoholic beverage emanating from the vehicle. I requested [A]'s identification and asked him to step out of the vehicle. [A] refused, stating "I haven't done anything, leave me alone" and attempted to roll his window back up.

Fearing [A] might attempt to flee or retrieve a weapon, I ordered him to open the door. When he continued to refuse, Ofc. [NAME] and I opened the door. [A] immediately tensed up, pulling his arm away from Ofc. [NAME] who was attempting to gain control of his left arm. [A] braced himself against the steering wheel and the driver's seat, actively resisting efforts to remove him from the vehicle. I applied a wrist-lock control technique to [A]'s right arm while Ofc. [NAME] secured his left arm. [A] continued to pull away, yelling obscenities. Due to his active resistance and refusal to comply, a controlled takedown was initiated, bringing [A] to the ground on his left side. Once on the ground, [A] continued to tuck his arms under his body. After several more verbal commands and a brief struggle, we were able to secure [A]'s hands in handcuffs. He was then assisted to his feet and escorted to my patrol vehicle.

On 03/12/2023 at approximately 1930 hours, I responded to 123 Elm Street for a welfare check requested by a concerned neighbor. Due to her agitated state and refusal to cooperate, and concern for her safety and the safety of others, I decided to take (A) into protective custody.

Ofc. [NAME] and I utilized a two-officer escort hold. (A) immediately tensed her body, pulling her arms away and trying to twist free. She continued to yell and actively resist being escorted from the doorway. We maintained control, guiding her outside to prevent her from falling. After a brief struggle, we were able to bring her to the patrol vehicle. (A) continued to verbally resist and pull her hands away as we attempted to place her in handcuffs. Due to her continued active resistance, I applied an arm-bar control technique to secure her left arm, while Ofc. [NAME] secured her right. (A) was then safely handcuffed and transported for evaluation.

On the above date and time, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to a report of a disturbance at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, we observed a male, later identified as (A), standing in the entryway of a closed business, yelling at passersby. After a brief struggle on the ground, we were able to secure (A)'s hands behind his back in handcuffs. (A) continued to verbally protest and yell obscenities while being escorted to the patrol vehicle. He was medically evaluated on scene due to his age and the physical nature of the arrest.

Narrative: On 11/15/23 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded to 742 Elm Street for a report of a male refusing to leave the premises of a local business. Upon arrival, I observed a Black male, later identified as (A), aged 51, standing directly in the doorway, blocking entry and exit. (A) was visibly agitated, yelling at the store clerk, and smelled strongly of an alcoholic beverage. I approached (A) and identified myself, advising him of the complaint and instructing him to step outside the business. Narrative:

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2030 hours, officers responded to the area of 123 Main St for a report of an intoxicated male causing a disturbance outside a convenience store. As I reached for his arm to secure him, (A) tensed up, pulled his arm away forcefully, and spun around, attempting to push past me. Ofc. [NAME] simultaneously moved to assist. On the above date and time, I responded to a call regarding a suspicious person loitering in the private parking lot of 123 Main St, a closed business. Narrative:

[NAME] to a report of a disturbance at the Quick Mart located at 123 Main St. Dispatch advised a male subject was refusing to leave the premises after being asked by management. I approached S and explained the reason for our presence, giving him clear verbal commands to exit the store. S ignored my commands, turned his back to me, and began to walk deeper into an aisle. I repeated my commands, stating that if he did not comply, he would be placed under arrest for trespass. S stopped, turned towards me, and balled his fists, stating loudly, "I ain't going nowhere!" His body language was aggressive, and he appeared agitated.

Fearing S would become combative, I attempted to gain control of his left arm to escort him out. S immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away, and began to pivot his body towards me. Ofc. S continued to struggle on the ground, attempting to push himself up, but Ofc. [NAME] and I were able to secure his hands behind his back in handcuffs. S continued to yell profanities but ceased physical resistance once restrained.

Narrative:
On the above date and time, I responded to the area of Main St and Elm Ave for a report of a disorderly male yelling at pedestrians near the bus stop. Upon arrival, I observed a male, later identified as S, a 59-year-old Black male, standing near the bus shelter, shouting incoherently and waving his arms. His clothing was disheveled, and he appeared agitated. I approached S and attempted to engage him, asking if he needed assistance. S immediately became defensive, yelling "Leave me alone!" and attempted to walk away, refusing my lawful orders to stop. As I attempted to guide him to the side to de-escalate the situation and ensure public safety, S suddenly pushed me in the chest with both hands, causing me to stumble back. Fearing for my safety and the safety of the public, I informed S he was under arrest for assault and battery on a police officer. S tensed up, pulling his arms away and actively resisting attempts to place his hands behind his back. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted. Due to S's continued active resistance, Ofc. [NAME] delivered a single open-hand strike to his upper back to gain compliance, which allowed me to secure his left wrist. We then guided S to the ground in a controlled manner, where he continued to tense his body but eventually allowed us to secure his hands in handcuffs. S was then assisted to his feet and transported to the precinct. No visible injuries were observed on S at the scene.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 1430 hours, I responded to 789 Elm Street for a report of a male refusing to leave private property after being asked by the property owner. Upon arrival, I observed a male, later identified as (A), sitting on the porch steps. The property owner, Ms. Jenkins, stated (A) was her estranged husband and was not allowed on the property. I approached (A) and explained the situation, advising him he needed to leave. (A) looked at me and stated, "I ain't going nowhere. This is my house." I reiterated the property owner's request and advised him that if he did not leave, he would be placed under arrest for trespassing. (A) crossed his arms and stared straight ahead, refusing to acknowledge my commands. After several attempts to gain compliance, I informed (A) he was under arrest. I took hold of his left arm to guide him up, but (A) immediately tensed up, pulling his arm away and leaning back into the steps. He stated, "Don't touch me!" I then utilized a wrist lock control technique on his left arm while Ofc. [NAME] secured his right arm. (A) continued to pull against us, verbally protesting and tensing his entire body, making it difficult to stand him up. We were eventually able to get him to his feet and secure handcuffs on him. (A) continued to be verbally defiant but ceased physical resistance once handcuffed. He was then escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 23:15 hours, I responded to 742 Maple St for a report of a domestic disturbance. I entered the residence and located (A) in the living room. He was yelling profanities and appeared heavily intoxicated, with slurred speech and unsteady balance. (A) immediately became verbally aggressive towards me, stating, "I'm not going anywhere, this is my house!" He then took a step towards me in an aggressive manner, clenching his fists.

Fearing for my safety and the safety of others present, I issued verbal commands for (A) to stop and place his hands behind his back. (A) ignored my commands, continuing to yell and tense his body. On 03/15/2023 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to a report of a highly intoxicated female refusing to leave "The Corner Pub" at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a white female, later identified as (A), standing near the entrance, yelling obscenities at the bouncer and patrons. I grabbed (A)'s left arm to guide her away from the entrance. (A) tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and began actively resisting by flailing her arms and attempting to strike me with her right hand. I blocked her attempt and delivered a control hold to her left arm, attempting to secure her for handcuffing. (A) continued to struggle, twisting her body and kicking her legs. Due to her active resistance and assaultive behavior, I initiated a controlled takedown to the ground. Once on the ground, (A) continued to thrash, attempting to roll over and bite my hand. Narrative:
On the above date and time, I responded to 742 Elm Street for a report of a male yelling at residents and refusing to leave the property. Upon arrival, I observed a male, later identified as (A), standing on the porch of the residence, actively yelling obscenities at an elderly female inside. I approached (A) and advised him of the complaint, instructing him to step off the porch and speak with me. (A) turned towards me, eyes bloodshot, and immediately became verbally confrontational, stating, "You can't tell me what to do, this is my house!" I informed (A) that the resident had requested his removal and he needed to comply or face arrest for trespassing. (A) refused, tensing his body and taking a defensive stance.

I gave a verbal command for (A) to place his hands behind his back. (A) yelled "Get away from me!" and attempted to push past me. Fearing a physical altercation, I initiated a control hold, grabbing (A)'s left arm and attempting to bring it behind his back. (A) actively resisted, pulling his arm away, twisting his torso, and attempting to pull free. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted in attempting to secure (A)'s right arm. (A) continued to struggle violently, spinning away from us and nearly striking Ofc. [NAME] with his elbow. I delivered a single closed-fist strike to (A)'s left bicep, which momentarily stunned him, allowing Ofc. [NAME] and I to gain control of both his arms. We then performed a controlled takedown to the ground. On the ground, (A) tucked his hands under his body, refusing to present them. After several commands to "stop resisting" and "give me your hands," I applied two knee strikes to (A)'s right lateral thigh. (A) then complied, presenting his hands, and was successfully handcuffed.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 23:15 hours, I responded to a report of a disorderly male outside "The Taproom" located at 145 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a white male, later identified as (A), standing in the middle of the sidewalk, yelling profanities at passersby and refusing to leave after being asked by bar staff. Narrative:
On 11/15/23 at approximately 1430 hours, I responded to the report of a disorderly person refusing to leave the main lobby of the Public Library at 123 Main Street. I approached (A) and introduced myself, explaining that she needed to leave the premises as requested by library staff. When I attempted to assist (A) to her feet by taking her left arm, she stiffened her body, pulled her arm away, and began to thrash her upper body from side to side, making it difficult to gain control. Once at the patrol car, (A) refused to enter the vehicle, requiring Ofc. [NAME] and I to apply minimal physical force to seat her inside. Handcuffs were applied for officer safety and to prevent further resistance.

Dispatch advised S, a 27-year-old Black female, was reportedly intoxicated and throwing objects inside the residence. Upon arrival, I observed S on the front porch, yelling into the house and appearing highly agitated. I attempted to make verbal contact, asking S to calm down and step away from the door. S immediately turned her attention to me, yelling, "You don't tell me what to do!" and began walking aggressively towards my position, ignoring multiple commands to stop.

Fearing S would physically confront me, I created distance and again ordered her to stop and put her hands behind her back. S clenched her fists and continued to advance, stating, "I'm not going anywhere with you!" As S reached within arm's length, I utilized an open-hand push to her chest to create separation. S stumbled backward but maintained her balance, immediately attempting to strike me with her right hand. I blocked the strike, and Ofc. [NAME] moved in to assist. Together, we secured S's arms, and she continued to actively resist by tensing her body and attempting to pull away. We were able to guide S to the ground onto her stomach, where we successfully applied handcuffs. S remained verbally defiant but ceased physical resistance once handcuffed. She was then escorted to the patrol vehicle without further incident.

Narrative: On 03/15/2023 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded to a 911 call reporting a domestic disturbance at 45 Elm Street. Dispatch advised that a female was reportedly yelling and throwing items inside the residence. Upon arrival, I observed a female, later identified as (S) [Race=BLACK, Sex=FEMALE, Age=24], standing on the porch, actively yelling into the open doorway of the residence. As I approached, (S) turned towards me, her face flushed and her hands clenched. She immediately began yelling at me, stating, "You can't do anything, get off my property!"

I attempted to de-escalate the situation, giving verbal commands for her to calm down and explain what was happening. (S) ignored my commands, continuing to scream and making aggressive gestures with her hands. She then attempted to re-enter the residence, stating she was going back inside and I couldn't stop her. Fearing the disturbance would escalate inside or that she might retrieve a weapon, I stepped forward and placed my hand on her arm, advising her she was not free to leave as I was investigating a domestic disturbance. (S) immediately tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and spun around, pushing me in the chest with both hands. Due to her physical resistance and assault on an officer, I initiated a physical control technique. I secured her left arm and attempted to guide her hands behind her back for handcuffing. (S) continued to resist, pulling her arm away, twisting her body, and kicking her legs. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted, taking control of her right arm. We were able to gain control of (S) and place her in handcuffs after a brief struggle on the porch. (S) continued to verbally protest and yell obscenities but ceased physical resistance once handcuffed. She was transported to the precinct for booking on charges of Disorderly Conduct and Resisting Arrest.

Narrative: On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Main St for a report of a highly intoxicated and disorderly female refusing to leave a licensed establishment. Upon arrival, I observed a white female, later identified as (A), yelling obscenities at bar staff and patrons on the sidewalk. (A) displayed signs of extreme intoxication, including slurred speech, bloodshot eyes, and an unsteady gait. I verbally engaged (A) and instructed her to calm down and provide identification. (A) refused, yelling, "I'm not doing anything wrong, leave me alone!" and attempted to walk past me.

Due to her continued disorderly conduct and public intoxication, I advised (A) she was under arrest. As I attempted to take hold of her left arm to place her in handcuffs, (A) actively resisted by pulling her arm away with considerable force and twisting her body. She then pushed me in the chest with both hands, causing me to stumble backward. Fearing further assault and her continued resistance, I initiated a controlled takedown, bringing (A) to the ground in a prone position. (A) continued to thrash her legs and attempted to pull her hands underneath her body. With the arrival of Ofc. [NAME], we were able to secure (A)'s hands behind her back in handcuffs. (A) remained verbally abusive while being escorted to the patrol vehicle but ceased active physical resistance once secured.

On 07/12/2023 at approximately 1430 hours, I responded to 123 Main Street regarding a disorderly female refusing to leave a business. Upon arrival, I observed a female, later identified as (A), standing near the entrance, yelling obscenities at staff and customers. Her eyes appeared bloodshot, and she was swaying slightly. I attempted to engage (A) verbally, asking her to calm down and explain the situation. (A) immediately became agitated, turning her aggression towards me, yelling "I ain't going anywhere!" and stepping closer in an aggressive manner. I gave multiple verbal commands for (A) to step back and comply with my orders to leave the premises. (A) refused, continuing to yell and clenched her fists. Fearing for the safety of myself and the public, I advised (A) she was under arrest for disorderly conduct. As I attempted to take her arm for an escort, (A) stiffened her body, pulled away forcefully, and spun around, attempting to evade my grasp. Due to her active resistance and continued aggressive demeanor, I utilized an armbar takedown to bring (A) to the ground in a controlled manner. On the ground, (A) continued to struggle, tucking her hands underneath her body. After several verbal commands to show her hands, and with the assistance of Ofc. [NAME], I was able to gain control of (A)'s arms and place her in handcuffs. (A) was then assisted to her feet and transported to booking without further incident.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2030 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to a report of a disturbance at 450 Main St (convenience store). Dispatch advised a female was refusing to leave the premises after being asked by store management. Upon arrival, we observed a Black female, later identified as (A), standing outside the store, yelling into the doorway. Store management pointed her out as the individual they wished to have trespassed.

I approached (A) and explained the complaint, requesting her to leave the property. (A) immediately became defensive, yelling "I ain't doing nothing wrong!" and refused to acknowledge my commands. She began pacing and continued to shout obscenities at the store entrance. After multiple verbal warnings to cease her behavior and leave, which she ignored, I informed (A) she was being placed under arrest for trespass.

As I attempted to take her left arm to place her in handcuffs, (A) tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and spun around, stating "Get off me!" Ofc. [NAME] then moved to assist, securing her right arm. (A) continued to pull and twist her body, attempting to break free from our grasp. Due to her active resistance, I applied an arm bar control technique to her left arm while Ofc. [NAME] maintained control of her right. We guided her against a nearby wall to stabilize her. She continued to verbalize her refusal to comply but ceased actively struggling against the joint control. We were then able to secure both of (A)'s wrists in handcuffs. She remained verbally abusive during the escort to the patrol vehicle but offered no further physical resistance.

On the above date and time, I responded to a report of a disturbance at 123 Main St, a convenience store. Dispatch advised a male, later identified as (A), was yelling at customers and refusing to leave the property. Upon arrival, I observed (A) standing near the entrance, shouting obscenities at a patron attempting to enter the store. I approached (A) and identified myself as police, instructing him to cease his behavior and step away from the entrance. (A) turned to me, his eyes bloodshot, smelling strongly of alcohol, and began yelling, "You can't tell me what to do!" He clenched his fists and took a step towards me. I gave multiple verbal commands for (A) to calm down and place his hands behind his back. (A) refused, stating, "I ain't going anywhere with you!" and attempted to push past me. Fearing he would assault me or other patrons, I initiated a control hold on (A)'s left arm. (A) immediately tensed up, twisting his body and actively pulling his arm away, attempting to break free. Ofc. [NAME] arrived to assist. We attempted to guide (A) to the ground to gain control. (A) continued to resist, flailing his arms and kicking his legs. Ofc. [NAME] delivered a single open-hand strike to (A)'s upper thigh to disrupt his balance, which allowed us to bring him to a prone position. While on the ground, (A) continued to tuck his hands under his body, refusing to present them for handcuffing. After several more verbal commands and a brief struggle, we were able to secure (A)'s hands in handcuffs. He remained verbally abusive during the transport to the precinct.

Narrative: On 11/15/23 at approximately 1430 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to 789 Elm Street, apartment complex, for a report of a trespasser refusing to leave the lobby area. Upon arrival, we were met by building manager, Mr. Thompson, who identified the subject as a resident, Mrs. Eleanor Vance, a 65-year-old Black female, who was causing a disturbance and refusing to return to her apartment after being asked to vacate a common area.

We approached Mrs. Vance, who was seated in a lobby chair, muttering to herself. We attempted to engage her, explaining the complaint and politely asking her to return to her apartment. Mrs. Vance immediately became agitated, stating "I ain't going nowhere" and "You can't make me!" Her voice was raised, and she began to wave her hands dismissively. We continued to give verbal commands for several minutes, attempting to de-escalate the situation.

When Mrs. Vance made a movement as if to stand and push past Ofc. [NAME], I placed my hand on her left arm, attempting a gentle escort hold to guide her. Mrs. Vance immediately tensed up, pulling her arm away sharply and yelling "Don't touch me!" She then attempted to swat my hand. Due to her continued non-compliance and escalating behavior, Ofc. [NAME] took her right arm while I maintained control of her left. We applied a controlled escort to direct Mrs. Vance out of the building. She continued to verbalize her refusal, occasionally pulling against our grip, but no further force was necessary to guide her to the patrol vehicle. She was then transported to the station for booking.

Narrative:
On 11/15/23 at approximately 2315 hours, I responded to 789 Main St (The Thirsty Crow bar) for a report of a highly intoxicated and disorderly female refusing to leave the premises. Upon arrival, I observed a White female, later identified as (A), standing near the bar, yelling loudly at staff and patrons. Her speech was slurred, and she was swaying noticeably. I approached (A) and advised her she needed to leave or she would be arrested for disorderly conduct. (A) responded by yelling "I'm not going anywhere, you can't make me!" and attempted to push past me. I placed my hand on her arm to guide her, at which point (A) tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and swung her open hand towards my face, narrowly missing. Ofc. [NAME] arrived to assist. We gave multiple verbal commands for (A) to comply and place her hands behind her back. (A) continued to resist, flailing her arms and attempting to kick Ofc. [NAME]. Due to her active resistance and potential for assault, I initiated a straight armbar takedown, bringing (A) to the ground onto her stomach. While on the ground, (A) continued to struggle, tucking her hands underneath her body. After several further verbal commands and a brief struggle, Ofc. [NAME] was able to secure her right wrist while I gained control of her left, and we successfully applied handcuffs. (A) was then escorted to the patrol vehicle, continuing to yell and spit.

On 04/12/2023 at approximately 22:15 hours, I responded with Officer [NAME] to a 911 call reporting a domestic disturbance at 123 Main St, Apt 3B. Upon arrival, we could hear loud yelling coming from inside the apartment. We knocked, and a male subject, later identified as (A), opened the door. (A) was visibly agitated, slurring his words, and smelled strongly of alcohol. We attempted to speak with (A) regarding the nature of the disturbance, but he immediately became verbally aggressive, yelling "You can't come in here, get off my property!" and attempting to close the door on us.

I ordered (A) to step outside and calm down multiple times, but he refused, instead stepping further into the doorway and blocking our path, clenching his fists. Due to his intoxication, aggressive demeanor, and refusal to comply, I informed (A) he was being detained. When I attempted to take his left arm to escort him, (A) tensed up, pulled away forcefully, and spun to face me, pushing his chest out. Fearing he was about to physically assault me, I initiated a straight arm bar control technique on his left arm while Officer [NAME] secured his right. (A) continued to actively resist by pulling his arms away and attempting to twist his body. We utilized a controlled takedown to bring (A) to the ground. Once on the ground, (A) continued to thrash and tuck his hands under his body, preventing handcuffing. Officer [NAME] delivered two knee strikes to (A)'s left thigh, which created enough compliance for me to secure his left wrist, and Officer [NAME] then secured his right. (A) was then placed in handcuffs.

Narrative:
On 11/15/23 at approximately 14:30 hours, I responded to a report of a shoplifting in progress at the "MegaMart" located at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, store security pointed out the suspect, identified as (A), a 47-year-old Black female, attempting to leave the store with unpaid merchandise. I approached (A) and identified myself as a police officer, instructing her to stop and return inside. (A) ignored my commands, stating, "I didn't do anything," and continued walking towards the exit. I stepped in front of (A) and verbally commanded her to stop and place her hands behind her back. (A) refused, attempting to push past me. When I attempted to gain control of her left arm, (A) tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and swung her right arm towards me, grazing my uniform shirt. Fearing she was attempting to strike me or flee, I utilized a control hold, sweeping her legs and bringing her to the ground in a controlled manner. On the ground, (A) continued to resist by pulling her arms underneath her body and refusing to present her hands. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted in securing (A)'s hands behind her back in handcuffs. (A) was then assisted to her feet and transported to the precinct for processing without further incident.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 1930 hours, I responded to the Main Street Library for a report of a male refusing to leave after closing. Library staff indicated they had repeatedly asked the subject, a 52-year-old Black male, to leave without success. I located S, seated at a table. I verbally instructed S to gather his belongings and exit the building, explaining the library was closed. S looked at me and stated, "I ain't going nowhere." I repeated my lawful order, advising S he would be arrested for trespass if he did not comply. S then stood up but turned his back to me, attempting to walk further into the library stacks. I grabbed S's left arm to guide him towards the exit. S immediately tensed his arm, pulled away forcefully, and began yelling, "Don't touch me! This is harassment!" Due to S's active resistance and refusal to comply with lawful orders, I performed a straight arm bar takedown to gain control. S continued to struggle on the ground, tensing his body and attempting to pull his arms free. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted in securing S's hands behind his back in handcuffs. S continued to yell obscenities throughout the process of being escorted out and placed in the patrol vehicle.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2215 hours, I was on patrol in the area of Elm St and Maple Ave, a known high-crime area for vehicle break-ins. Dispatch broadcast a description of a male, Black, wearing a black hoodie and dark pants, seen attempting to break into vehicles near 123 Elm St. I observed a subject, later identified as (A), matching this description walking quickly away from the reported address. I exited my patrol vehicle and gave verbal commands, "Stop, police!" (A) ignored my commands and continued walking, then began to run. I initiated a foot pursuit.

During the pursuit, (A) cut through a dark alley. As I closed the distance, I ordered him to stop and get on the ground. (A) abruptly turned, throwing his hands up in a defensive posture, yelling "Get away from me!" Fearing (A) might assault me or continue to flee, I delivered an open-hand strike to (A)'s left shoulder, causing him to stumble. I then executed a bear hug takedown, bringing (A) to the ground. (A) continued to actively struggle, attempting to push himself up and escape my grasp. I delivered two knee strikes to (A)'s side to gain compliance while simultaneously attempting to secure his arms. Officer [NAME] arrived and assisted by controlling (A)'s legs, allowing me to secure (A)'s left arm and Officer [NAME] to secure his right arm in handcuffs. Once handcuffed, (A) remained verbally agitated but ceased physical resistance.

On 11/15/20 at approximately 2330 hours, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to "The Corner Pub" for a report of an intoxicated female causing a disturbance and refusing to leave. Upon arrival, we observed a white female, later identified as (A), 31 years of age, yelling loudly at bar staff near the exit. She appeared heavily intoxicated, swaying and slurring her words.

I approached (A) and identified myself, giving verbal commands for her to calm down and exit the establishment. (A) immediately became verbally abusive, yelling "I'm not leaving, you can't touch me!" and continued to direct profanities at both officers and bar staff. When Ofc. [NAME] attempted to gently guide (A) by the arm towards the door, (A) tensed her body, pulled her arm away forcefully, and began to actively resist, flailing her arms and attempting to push Ofc. [NAME].

Due to her active resistance and continued refusal to comply, I secured (A)'s left arm and Ofc. [NAME] secured her right. (A) continued to struggle violently, twisting her torso, kicking her legs, and attempting to pull away from our grasp. To prevent further escalation and ensure officer safety, I performed a controlled takedown to the ground. (A) continued to resist on the ground, tucking her hands underneath her body. I delivered two open-hand strikes to her left deltoid area to gain compliance and access her arm. With Ofc. [NAME] assistance, we were able to bring (A)'s arms behind her back and apply handcuffs. (A) continued to yell obscenities but ceased physical resistance once handcuffed. She was then escorted to my patrol vehicle for transport to the precinct.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to 742 Elm Street for a report of a male causing a disturbance and refusing to leave the property. Upon arrival, I observed a male, later identified as [NAME] [NAME] (DOB: XX/XX/80), matching the description, yelling loudly at the property owner. I approached and identified myself as police, ordering [NAME] to stop yelling and step away from the residence. [NAME] ignored my commands, turned towards me, and stated, "I ain't going anywhere, this ain't your business." I repeated my orders for [NAME] to calm down and comply. [NAME] then took a step towards me, clenching his fists and continuing to yell. Due to his aggressive posture and refusal to comply, I informed [NAME] he was under arrest for disorderly conduct and attempted to grab his right arm to place him in handcuffs. [NAME] immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away forcefully, and spun around, attempting to create distance. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted. We both delivered verbal commands to stop resisting. [NAME] continued to pull away and struggle. I then performed a leg sweep, bringing [NAME] to the ground. He landed on his left side.
