Narrative:
On 11/15/2023 at approximately 14:30 hours, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to a report of a welfare check at 123 Elm Street. Dispatch advised an elderly female, later identified as (A), a 65-year-old White female, was yelling at neighbors and appeared disoriented. Upon arrival, we observed (A) standing inside her doorway, partially obscured. We identified ourselves as police and attempted to speak with her. (A) immediately became agitated, yelling "Get off my property!" and attempted to forcefully close the door. I placed my foot to prevent the door from fully closing, fearing for her safety given the dispatch information.

(A) then pushed against the door, attempting to force it shut. Ofc. [NAME] and I entered the threshold to prevent her from barricading herself inside and to assess her well-being. (A) screamed, "Don't touch me!" and swung her arm, making glancing contact with Ofc. [NAME] chest as she tried to retreat deeper into the residence. Fearing further escalation and to ensure her safety, I grabbed (A)'s right arm using a control hold, while Ofc. [NAME] secured her left arm. (A) continued to pull away, tensing her body and verbally resisting, but officers were able to guide her to the couch. Due to her agitated state and resistance, she was placed in handcuffs for officer safety and to facilitate a mental health evaluation. She continued to tense her arms while being handcuffed, but no further physical force was required. EMS was called to evaluate (A).

Narrative: On 03/12/2023 at approximately 23:15 hours, I responded to a report of a disorderly subject refusing to leave the premises of "The Saloon" bar at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a white male, later identified as (A) [White, Male, 25], standing outside the entrance, yelling obscenities at the bouncer and attempting to re-enter the establishment. His eyes were bloodshot, and he exhibited slurred speech, consistent with intoxication.

I approached (A) and identified myself as police, instructing him to calm down and leave the area. (A) immediately turned his aggression towards me, stating, "I'm not going anywhere, you can't tell me what to do!" He took a step closer, clenching his fists and puffing out his chest. Fearing a physical confrontation, I issued a verbal command for (A) to put his hands behind his back. (A) refused, yelling "No!" and pulling his arms tight to his chest.

Due to his continued non-compliance and aggressive posture, I initiated a control hold on (A)'s left arm, attempting to guide it behind his back. (A) actively resisted, pulling his arm away forcefully and twisting his body. Ofc. [NAME] arrived as backup and assisted in gaining control. We executed a controlled takedown to the ground to mitigate further resistance. (A) continued to struggle on the ground, kicking his legs and attempting to push up. After several seconds of active resistance, Ofc. [NAME] and I were able to secure (A)'s wrists in handcuffs. He remained verbally combative during the escort to the patrol vehicle but complied with orders to enter the rear seat.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 14:15 hours, officers responded to 123 Maple Dr. for a welfare check on (S), reported by a concerned neighbor who had not seen her in several days and noticed mail accumulating. Upon arrival, I knocked on the front door and announced "Police!" several times. After approximately five minutes, I observed movement inside and (S) partially opened the door, appearing disoriented and confused. Her clothing was disheveled, and she had a strong odor of stale urine. I explained the reason for our visit and requested to check on her well-being. (S) became agitated, stating "You can't come in here!" and attempted to close the door. Fearing for her safety and well-being, Ofc. [NAME] and I gently prevented the door from closing and entered the residence.

Inside, (S) began to yell, "Get out of my house!" and waved her arms erratically. We attempted to calm her down and offered medical assistance. (S) refused, tensing her body and attempting to push past Ofc. [NAME]. Due to her apparent disorientation and inability to care for herself, we determined she needed a medical evaluation. When I attempted to guide her towards the door, (S) stiffened her arm and pulled away forcefully, causing her to lose balance slightly. I utilized a two-hand escort hold on her upper arms to prevent a fall and guide her safely outside. She continued to verbally protest but did not physically resist further once outside. Paramedics from Medic 2 arrived and assumed care, transporting (S) to St. Jude's Hospital for evaluation. No injuries were observed to (S) or officers.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded to 456 Elm Street for a welfare check on a female reportedly screaming inside an apartment. Upon arrival, I made contact with the reporting party who stated the female, later identified as (A), a 34-year-old white female, was highly agitated and throwing items. As I approached the apartment door, I heard yelling. I knocked and announced my presence. (A) opened the door, appearing disheveled and heavily intoxicated, her eyes bloodshot.

I attempted to speak with (A) to assess her well-being and determine if she needed assistance. She immediately became verbally aggressive, yelling "Get out of my house!" and attempted to slam the door. I placed my foot to prevent the door from closing and gave verbal commands for her to calm down and step outside to speak with me. (A) refused, pushing against the door and attempting to shove me. Due to her aggressive behavior and clear intoxication, I determined she posed a danger to herself and potentially others.

I grabbed (A)'s left wrist to prevent her from re-entering the apartment and to escort her outside. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and began to twist her body, attempting to break free from my grasp. She continued to yell obscenities. I maintained control of her wrist and applied a slight amount of pressure to her radial nerve to gain compliance. (A) continued to struggle, pulling against my hold. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted by securing (A)'s right arm. With both officers applying control, we were able to maneuver (A) out of the doorway and place her against the wall where she was then placed in handcuffs for her safety and ours. She continued to be verbally resistive during the handcuffing process.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to 123 Main St regarding a report of a male refusing to leave the premises after being asked by management. Upon arrival, I observed a Black male, later identified as (S), standing in front of the establishment, yelling at the bouncer. I approached (S) and explained the complaint, advising him he needed to leave the property. (S) ignored my commands, took a step towards me, and clenched his fists. Fearing a physical confrontation, I placed my hands on (S)'s chest to create distance and again ordered him to step back. (S) then pushed my hands away and attempted to walk past me. I grabbed (S)'s left arm to prevent him from leaving and place him into custody for disorderly conduct and trespassing. (S) immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away, and began to twist his body, actively resisting my attempt to control him. Officer [NAME] arrived and assisted. We were able to take (S) to the ground in a controlled manner, where he continued to tense his body and pull his arms underneath him. After several verbal commands to stop resisting and show his hands, Ofc. [NAME] delivered one closed-hand strike to (S)'s left rib area. This strike was effective in gaining compliance. We were then able to secure (S)'s hands behind his back in handcuffs. (S) continued to verbally protest but ceased physical resistance.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2015 hours, I responded to 742 Elm Street for a report of a male causing a disturbance and refusing to leave the property. Upon arrival, I observed S (later identified as a Black Male, age 40) standing in the doorway, yelling obscenities at the homeowner. On 11/15/2023 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded to a report of a disorderly male refusing to leave the premises of "Quick Mart" located at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a White male, later identified as (S), age 32, yelling at the store clerk and attempting to walk behind the counter. [NAME] arrived and assisted by applying pressure to (S)'s upper back while I was finally able to extract his left arm. On 03/15/2023 at approximately 1430 hours, officers responded to the Public Library at 123 Main Street for a report of a disorderly female refusing to leave. Narrative: On the above date and time, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to 123 Main St (Quick-E-Mart) for a report of a male refusing to leave the premises. Upon arrival, we observed S, a Black male, standing near the counter, yelling at the store clerk. We approached S and issued verbal commands, advising him he needed to leave the store or he would be trespassed. S turned towards us, stating "I ain't going nowhere, you can't make me!" and began to loudly curse. S took a step back and tensed his body, refusing to comply with repeated orders to exit the store. I verbally ordered (A) to step back and place his hands behind his back. (A) ignored my commands, continuing to yell and advance. Fearing a physical assault, I initiated a controlled takedown, attempting to guide (A) to the ground. (A) actively resisted, pulling his arms away and struggling against my grip. Officer [NAME] arrived and assisted, attempting to secure (A)'s left arm. (A) continued to thrash, kicking his legs and attempting to push away from us. Due to his active resistance and potential to harm himself or officers, I delivered two open-hand palm strikes to (A)'s left shoulder blade. These strikes had a limited effect, and (A) continued to struggle. Officer [NAME] then applied a knee strike to (A)'s right thigh. This allowed us to gain control of (A)'s arms and complete the handcuffing procedure. (A) remained verbally abusive but ceased physical resistance once handcuffed. He was then escorted to my patrol vehicle without further incident.

On the above date and time, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to a report of a loud disturbance at 123 Main Street. Upon arrival, we observed a male subject, later identified as (A), standing on the porch, yelling into the residence. (A) appeared heavily intoxicated, slurring his words and swaying. We approached and identified ourselves, explaining the nature of our call. (A) immediately became agitated, stating, "I'm not doing anything wrong, leave me alone." He refused to provide identification and attempted to turn and re-enter the residence, ignoring our verbal commands to stop and speak with us.

As (A) reached for the doorknob, I stepped forward and placed my hand on his shoulder to prevent him from going inside, reiterating our commands. (A) tensed his body, pulled away sharply, and swung his right arm back, nearly striking Ofc. [NAME]. Perceiving this as active resistance and a potential assault, I initiated a takedown, bringing (A) to the ground in a controlled manner. (A) continued to struggle on the ground, attempting to push himself up and keep his hands under his body. Ofc. [NAME] assisted by securing (A)'s left arm while I gained control of his right. After several verbal commands to stop resisting, we were able to successfully apply handcuffs to (A)'s wrists behind his back. He continued to verbally protest but ceased physical resistance once secured. (A) was then assisted to his feet and escorted to our patrol vehicle.

On 07/12/2023 at approximately 22:15 hours, I responded to a report of a male causing a disturbance outside "The Local Tap" at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a white male, later identified as (A), yelling obscenities at patrons attempting to enter the establishment. His eyes were bloodshot, and he had a strong odor of alcohol emanating from his person. I approached (A) and gave verbal commands to calm down and leave the property. (A) turned towards me, clenched his fists, and stated, "I'm not going anywhere, cop!" He then took an aggressive step forward. Fearing a physical confrontation, I advised (A) he was under arrest for disorderly conduct and attempted to take control of his left arm. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away, and attempted to spin around. I maintained a grip on his arm while Ofc. [NAME] secured his right arm. (A) continued to resist, pulling his body away and attempting to kick backwards. Due to his active resistance, I performed a controlled takedown, bringing (A) to the ground onto his stomach. He continued to struggle on the ground, tucking his hands beneath his chest. After several verbal commands to show his hands, and with Ofc. [NAME] applying pressure to his shoulder, (A) eventually complied, and we were able to secure him in handcuffs. He was then assisted to his feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On 11/15/20 at approximately 2310 hours, I responded to a report of a disorderly female causing a disturbance outside of 'The Corner Pub' located at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a white female, later identified as (A), standing on the sidewalk, yelling profanities at patrons attempting to enter the establishment. Her speech was slurred, and she appeared heavily intoxicated. I approached (A) and attempted to engage her, advising her she needed to leave the area or she would be subject to arrest for disorderly conduct. (A) immediately became agitated, turning towards me and shouting "I'm not going anywhere, you can't make me!" She began to flail her arms. I gave multiple verbal commands for (A) to calm down and place her hands behind her back. She ignored these commands, instead attempting to push past me to re-enter the bar. Fearing she would escalate further or become a danger to herself or others, I took hold of her left arm to prevent her movement and guide her away from the entrance. As I attempted to gain control, (A) actively pulled her arm away, tensing her body and attempting to twist out of my grasp. I maintained my grip and, utilizing an arm bar takedown technique, brought (A) to the ground onto her stomach. She continued to struggle, yelling and kicking her legs. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted in securing (A)'s hands behind her back in handcuffs. Once cuffed, she continued to verbally abuse officers but ceased physical resistance. She was then escorted to my patrol vehicle.

On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Elmwood Ave for a report of a male refusing to leave a private residence after being asked by the homeowner. Dispatch advised the male, later identified as (A) [NAME] Thompson, 40, White male, was reportedly intoxicated and becoming agitated. Upon arrival, I observed (A) standing on the porch, yelling at a female who was attempting to close the front door. His eyes were bloodshot, speech slurred, and he smelled strongly of an alcoholic beverage.

I gave multiple verbal commands for (A) to step away from the door and speak with me. (A) ignored my commands, instead turning his aggressive language towards me, stating, "This is my house, you can't make me leave!" and took a step towards the female. Fearing for the homeowner's safety, I stepped between (A) and the door, instructing him to stop and comply. (A) then lunged past me, making contact with my chest with both hands.

Due to (A)'s active resistance and aggressive posture, I grabbed his left arm and attempted an escort hold to gain control. (A) immediately tensed up, pulling his arm away forcefully and attempting to spin around, yelling "Get off me!". As he continued to resist, I utilized a straight arm bar take-down, bringing (A) to the ground in a controlled manner. While on the ground, (A) continued to tuck his hands under his body, refusing to comply with orders to show his hands. Ofc. [NAME] assisted by applying pressure to (A)'s right wrist, which allowed me to secure his left hand in handcuffs. (A) continued to verbally protest and tense his body but eventually complied with orders to stand up after being handcuffed. He was then escorted to the patrol vehicle without further incident.

On 07/12/2023 at approximately 14:30 hours, I responded to 456 Elm Street for a report of a verbal domestic disturbance. Upon arrival, I made contact with the caller who identified herself as S, DOB 01/01/1971. S was standing in the doorway, yelling loudly and refusing to allow officers to enter to speak with the other party involved. S was visibly agitated, her face flushed, and she was pointing her finger at me, stating, "You ain't coming in here, this is my house!" I attempted to de-escalate the situation by explaining the nature of the call and requesting her cooperation. S continued to shout, blocking the doorway and refusing to step aside. After multiple verbal commands to step back and allow officers to investigate, S suddenly pushed my chest with both hands, attempting to prevent entry. At this point, I grabbed S's right arm with my left hand and her left arm with my right hand, utilizing a control hold to guide her away from the doorway. S tensed up, pulling her arms away and actively resisting my efforts to gain control. Due to her continued resistance and physical contact, Ofc. [NAME] assisted by securing S's left arm, and we were able to bring S's hands behind her back. S continued to pull and twist, but we were able to apply handcuffs. S remained verbally defiant throughout the process but ceased physical resistance once handcuffed. She was then escorted to the patrol vehicle without further incident.

On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Main St, the public library, regarding a male refusing to leave the premises. Upon arrival, I observed a White male, later identified as (A) [DOB: XX/XX/1959], seated in a chair near the main entrance. Library staff informed me (A) had been verbally abusive to patrons and was asked to leave multiple times. I approached (A) and introduced myself, advising him he was trespassing and needed to exit the building. (A) responded by stating, "I have a right to be here, I'm not moving." I issued several clear verbal commands for (A) to stand up and walk out. (A) remained seated, crossing his arms and shaking his head in defiance. Due to his continued non-compliance and the ongoing disturbance, I informed (A) he was under arrest for trespassing. As I reached for his left arm to guide him up, (A) immediately tensed his entire body, pulling his arm away sharply and yelling, "Get your hands off me!" Ofc. [NAME] arrived to assist. We each took one of (A)'s arms and, with controlled effort, attempted to lift him from the chair. (A) actively resisted by bracing his legs and pulling his arms inward. I applied a C-clamp grip to (A)'s left wrist, reiterating commands to stop resisting. This allowed Ofc. [NAME] to secure the first handcuff. We then gained control of his right arm, completing the handcuffing. (A) was then escorted out of the library and transported to booking without further physical resistance.

Narrative: On 11/15/23 at approximately 14:30 hours, I responded to 45 Elm Street for a welfare check on an elderly female, reported by family as being disoriented and refusing to answer the door. Upon arrival, I made contact with the subject, later identified as (A), who was standing in her doorway, appearing confused and agitated. (A) repeatedly stated, "You can't come in here," and attempted to close the door. After several attempts to de-escalate and explain our presence, (A) became increasingly defensive, tensing her body and refusing to step outside.

Ofc. [NAME] and I explained that we needed to ensure her well-being and offered to call paramedics. (A) then tried to push past me to re-enter her residence, stating, "I'm fine, leave me alone." Due to her apparent disorientation and refusal to cooperate, I placed my right hand on her left forearm and Ofc. [NAME] placed his left hand on her right forearm, attempting to guide her gently outside. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled her arms away, and began to twist her body, attempting to break free from our grasp. She continued to verbally resist, yelling "Let go of me!" I maintained a firm grip, and Ofc. [NAME] assisted in applying a control hold to prevent her from falling or re-entering the house. We slowly guided her to the porch steps, where she continued to resist by pulling back and attempting to sit down abruptly. After several verbal commands to cooperate, we were able to safely escort her to the awaiting ambulance for evaluation.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2030 hours, I responded to the area of Main St and Elm Ave for a report of a female causing a disturbance, yelling at passersby. Upon arrival, I observed a female, later identified as S, matching the description, standing in the middle of the sidewalk, actively shouting at people. I approached and attempted to engage S, asking her to move off the sidewalk and if she needed assistance. S immediately became verbally aggressive, stating, "I ain't doing shit, mind your business." I asked for her identification, which she refused, then turned and began to walk away. I gave verbal commands to stop and advised her she was being detained for disorderly conduct. S ignored my commands and continued walking. As I attempted to gain control of her left arm to prevent her from leaving, she actively pulled away, tensing her arm and twisting her body. She then swung her right elbow back towards my chest. To prevent further assault and secure S, I utilized a straight arm bar takedown, bringing her to the ground. She continued to tense and tuck her arms beneath her body, refusing to present her hands. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted by applying pressure to her upper back, which allowed me to secure her left wrist in handcuffs. Her right wrist was then secured. S continued to yell obscenities while being escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to 123 Main St for a report of a male refusing to leave private property. Upon arrival, I observed a white male, later identified as S, standing on the porch, yelling at the homeowner. I approached S and identified myself as police, instructing him to calm down and step off the property. S turned towards me, stating "I ain't going anywhere, this is my friend's house!" The homeowner confirmed S was not welcome and had been asked to leave multiple times. I advised S that he was trespassing and would be placed under arrest if he did not comply. S squared his shoulders, clenched his fists, and yelled, "Try it, pig!"

At this point, I attempted to take S into custody by grabbing his left arm. S immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away forcefully, and spun to face me. Fearing S would escalate to a physical assault, I initiated a straight arm bar takedown. S resisted the takedown, struggling against my grip, but I was able to bring him to the ground. While on the ground, S continued to actively resist, tucking his arms underneath his body and refusing verbal commands to show his hands. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted. Ofc. [NAME] applied pressure to S's brachial plexus, at which point S momentarily relaxed, allowing Ofc. [NAME] to secure his right hand. I then secured S's left hand, placing him in handcuffs. S continued to yell profanities but ceased physical resistance. He was then escorted to my patrol vehicle.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 2030 hours, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to a report of a disorderly female in Lincoln Park, described as a white female in her 40s, yelling at passersby. Upon arrival, we located a female matching the description, later identified as (A), standing near the playground. Her speech was slurred, and she appeared disoriented, swaying slightly.

We attempted to engage (A) in conversation regarding her well-being and the disturbance. (A) immediately became agitated, yelling "Leave me alone, I haven't done anything!" and refused to provide identification or acknowledge our questions. She then turned and attempted to walk rapidly away from us towards the street.

Fearing for her safety and the safety of others due to her impaired state, Ofc. [NAME] placed his hand on (A)'s arm to prevent her from entering traffic. (A) immediately pulled her arm away with force, twisting her body and yelling "Don't touch me!" She continued to pull away, flailing her arms to break free from Ofc. [NAME] grasp. I then moved to assist, attempting to secure her other arm. (A) actively resisted by tensing her body, attempting to pull her arms free, and kicking her legs. Due to her continued active resistance and the risk of her escaping into traffic, I delivered a single drive stun with my department-issued taser to her upper back. The drive stun was effective, causing (A) to cease resistance and drop to her knees. We were then able to secure her hands behind her back in handcuffs without further incident. (A) was transported to the hospital for evaluation.

Narrative:
On 03/15/2023 at approximately 22:15 hours, I responded to 123 Maple St regarding a domestic disturbance. Upon arrival, I made contact with the reporting party, Mr. [NAME] [NAME], who stated his wife, later identified as (A) Jane Doe, DOB: XX/XX/1985, was highly intoxicated and refusing to leave the residence after an argument. I observed (A) standing in the living room, visibly agitated, slurring her words, and smelling strongly of alcohol. I attempted to de-escalate the situation and explained that she needed to either calm down or leave for the night. (A) immediately became verbally aggressive, yelling "You can't make me leave my own house!" and advancing towards me. I gave multiple verbal commands for (A) to stop and step back, but she continued to approach, pushing past Mr. [NAME]. As she attempted to push past me, I utilized an open-hand push to her chest to create distance. (A) stumbled back but immediately lunged forward, attempting to strike me with her right hand. I blocked the strike and secured her right arm. Ofc. [NAME] arrived on scene and assisted in securing (A)'s left arm. (A) actively resisted by tensing her body and pulling her arms away. We were able to maneuver her arms behind her back and apply handcuffs. (A) continued to scream obscenities and kick her feet as we escorted her out of the residence and into the patrol vehicle.

Narrative:
On 03/15/2023 at approximately 2310 hours, I responded to 123 Elm Street for a report of a male attempting to open car doors. Upon arrival, I observed a white male, later identified as (A), matching the description, actively pulling on the door handle of a parked sedan. I exited my patrol vehicle and gave loud verbal commands for (A) to stop and show his hands. (A) turned towards me, appeared disoriented, and began yelling unintelligibly. He then turned his back and attempted to walk away.

I approached (A) and attempted to gain control of his left arm to prevent his escape and conduct a pat-down for weapons. (A) immediately tensed his arm, pulled away forcefully, and spun around, stating, "Get off me!" His actions created a reasonable belief that he intended to resist arrest and potentially flee. I then performed a wrist-lock takedown, bringing (A) to the ground onto his stomach. While on the ground, (A) continued to actively resist, tucking his hands under his chest and kicking his legs. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted. I delivered two open-hand palm heel strikes to (A)'s left bicep and shoulder area, which caused him to momentarily cease his resistance and expose his left hand. Ofc. [NAME] secured (A)'s right hand while I secured his left. (A) was then handcuffed without further incident. He was later transported to the precinct.

On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Oak Avenue for a report of a trespasser refusing to leave. Upon arrival, I observed a white female, later identified as (A), 58 years of age, sitting on the front porch steps. The homeowner was present and stated (A) had been asked to leave multiple times. I approached (A), who appeared disheveled and agitated. I introduced myself and explained that the homeowner wanted her to leave. (A) immediately became verbally abusive, yelling "I have every right to be here!" and refusing to acknowledge my commands.

I issued several clear verbal commands for (A) to stand up and gather her belongings. She refused, stating, "I'm not moving for anyone!" and crossed her arms. Due to her persistent non-compliance and the homeowner's request for her removal, I informed (A) that she was under arrest for trespassing. As I reached to take her arm to escort her, (A) tensed her body, pulled her arm away forcefully, and attempted to twist her torso from my grasp. Officer [NAME] then assisted by securing (A)'s other arm. (A) continued to pull and twist, actively resisting our attempts to guide her to a standing position. After a brief struggle, we were able to gain control of her arms and secure her hands behind her back in handcuffs. She continued to verbally protest but ceased physical resistance once restrained.

On 11/15/2023 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded to 123 Elm Street for a report of a domestic disturbance. Upon arrival, I made contact with the caller, Ms. Jane Doe, who stated her husband, Mr. [NAME] [NAME] (A), DOB: XX/XX/1978, was heavily intoxicated, verbally abusive, and refusing to leave the residence.

Upon entering the living room, I observed (A) standing near the fireplace, yelling at Ms. Doe. (A) was slurring his words and appeared highly agitated. I immediately gave verbal commands for (A) to calm down and step away from Ms. Doe. (A) turned his attention to me, stating, "You can't make me do anything!" and took a step forward, clenching his fists. Ofc. [NAME] simultaneously ordered (A) to stop and show his hands. (A) ignored our commands, continued to advance, and raised his right hand in an aggressive manner towards Ofc. [NAME].

Fearing for our safety and the safety of Ms. Doe, and perceiving an imminent assault, I drew my department-issued Taser X2 and gave a loud verbal warning, "Taser! Taser! Taser!" (A) momentarily paused but continued to stand in a confrontational stance. I then deployed the Taser, striking (A) in the chest area. (A) immediately fell to the ground, allowing Ofc. [NAME] and myself to move in and secure his hands behind his back in handcuffs. The Taser deployment was effective. (A) continued to groan and verbally resist being helped up but was ultimately placed in the rear of my patrol vehicle. EMS was requested to evaluate (A) on scene, per policy.

Narrative: On 11/15/2023 at approximately 2030 hours, I responded to 45 Elm Street for a report of a disturbance involving a highly agitated female. Upon arrival, I observed a white female, later identified as S (55 y/o), standing on her front porch, yelling obscenities at a neighbor across the street. S appeared highly agitated, her speech was slurred, and she was swaying slightly. I approached S and identified myself as a police officer, asking her to calm down and explain the situation. S immediately turned her aggression towards me, yelling, "Get off my property! I haven't done anything!" and refusing to answer questions or cease her yelling.

I repeatedly ordered S to cease her disorderly conduct and go inside her residence. S refused, stating, "I'm not going anywhere!" She then attempted to push past me to re-enter her house, but due to her continued public disturbance, I informed her she was being detained. As I reached for her left arm to gain control, S tensed up, pulled her arm away, and began flailing her free arm at my chest, striking my uniform. To prevent further assault and gain control, I applied an arm bar to S's left arm while Ofc. [NAME] secured her right arm. S continued to resist by pulling away and attempting to kick backwards. Due to S's active resistance, we performed a controlled takedown to the ground. On the ground, S struggled briefly before Ofc. [NAME] and I were able to secure her hands behind her back in handcuffs. S remained verbally defiant but ceased physical resistance once handcuffed. She was then assisted to her feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle for transport.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2015 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to 123 Elm St. for a report of a domestic disturbance. Dispatch advised a 51-year-old white male, identified as (S), was highly intoxicated and refusing to leave the residence. Upon arrival, we observed (S) in the living room, yelling at a female occupant. (S) had slurred speech and a strong odor of an alcoholic beverage emanating from his person. [NAME], stating, "You can't make me do shit!" and taking a step towards him with clenched fists. Fearing a physical assault, I stepped in front of (S) and ordered him to put his hands behind his back. (S) yelled "No!" and attempted to push past me. I grabbed (S)'s left arm to gain control, but (S) immediately tensed up, pulling his arm away forcefully and attempting to spin around. Ofc. [NAME] assisted by securing (S)'s right arm. (S) continued to struggle, actively pulling and twisting his body, refusing to comply with repeated orders to stop resisting. Due to his continued resistance and active attempts to break free, I performed a controlled take-down to the ground. (S) landed on his side and continued to struggle, attempting to push himself up. Ofc. [NAME] and I maintained control of his arms and applied handcuffs. (S) was then escorted to the patrol vehicle.

Narrative:
On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Main St (The Saloon) for a report of an intoxicated male refusing to leave the premises. Upon arrival, I observed S, later identified as a 47-year-old white male, standing near the bar, yelling loudly and slurring his words. Bar staff advised S had been asked to leave multiple times. I approached S and identified myself as police, instructing him to calm down and step outside. S immediately turned towards me, stating "I ain't going anywhere, copper!" and took a bladed stance, clenching his fists. Due to his aggressive posture and clear intoxication, I gave S multiple verbal commands to place his hands behind his back. S refused, stating "Don't touch me!" and attempted to push past me. I grabbed S's left arm, attempting to gain control for handcuffing. S actively resisted by tensing his arm and pulling away with significant force. I then applied an arm-bar control technique to guide S to the ground. S continued to resist, bracing his legs and attempting to twist his body away. After a brief struggle, I was able to take S to the ground in a controlled manner, where Ofc. [NAME] assisted in securing S's hands behind his back. S continued to yell profanities but ceased physical resistance once handcuffed. S was placed under arrest for Disorderly Conduct and Resisting Arrest.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 14:30 hours, I responded to 123 Main St, 'The Corner Store,' for a report of an unwanted person. Upon arrival, I made contact with the store owner who pointed out a white male, later identified as S (DOB: XX/XX/1963, 60 years old), sitting on a bench near the entrance, visibly intoxicated and yelling obscenities at passersby. The owner stated S had been asked to leave multiple times and was scaring customers. I approached S and identified myself as a police officer, asking him to stand up and leave the property. S responded by yelling "I ain't going nowhere!" and continued to curse. I issued several more verbal commands for S to comply. Due to S's continued refusal and his disruptive behavior, I informed him he was under arrest for trespassing. When I attempted to take S by the arm, he stiffened his body and pulled his arm away forcefully, stating "Don't touch me!" Ofc. [NAME] then assisted. We attempted a joint escort hold. S continued to actively resist by tensing his entire body, digging his heels into the ground, and attempting to pull free from our grasp. To gain control and prevent further resistance, I applied a wrist lock to S's left arm. S grunted in pain but momentarily ceased his active resistance, allowing Ofc. [NAME] to secure his right wrist in a handcuff. S then tensed up again, but with continued pressure from the wrist lock, we were able to secure the second handcuff. S was then escorted to the patrol vehicle, continuing to verbally protest. He was placed in the rear of my cruiser without further physical incident.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2030 hours, I responded with Officer [NAME] to a report of a male causing a disturbance at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, we observed a Black male, later identified as [A], standing in the doorway of the residence, yelling loudly. The reporting party stated [A] was intoxicated and refusing to leave.

As we approached, [A] turned his attention to us, yelling "You got no business here!" and began to walk back inside. I gave verbal commands for [A] to stop and speak with us. [A] ignored my commands, continuing to move into the residence. Officer [NAME] and I followed, attempting to de-escalate the situation verbally. [A] then turned abruptly, stepping towards Ofc. [NAME] in an aggressive manner, clenching his fists and stating, "I ain't going anywhere with you pigs!"

Fearing for Officer [NAME] safety and my own, I grabbed [A]'s right arm to prevent further aggression and to secure him. [A] immediately tensed up, pulling his arm away forcefully and attempting to spin out of my grasp. He continued to yell obscenities. I maintained my grip and, with Officer [NAME] assistance, we guided [A] to the ground. [A] continued to actively resist, tucking his arms under his body and refusing to present his hands for handcuffing. After several verbal commands to stop resisting and show his hands, I delivered two closed-fist strikes to [A]'s left side to gain compliance. [A] then complied, and we were able to secure him in handcuffs. [A] was placed under arrest for Disorderly Conduct and Resisting Arrest.

On the above date and time, I responded to 456 Elm Street for a report of a suspicious male attempting to open car doors in the apartment complex parking lot. Upon arrival, I observed a male, later identified as S (Race=BLACK, Sex=MALE, Age=20), matching the description, actively pulling on the door handle of a parked vehicle. As I exited my patrol vehicle, S saw me and immediately began to walk away quickly, ignoring my verbal commands to stop. I ordered S to stop again, stating he was being detained for investigation of attempted larceny. S turned, yelled "I didn't do nothing!" and began to run.

I initiated a foot pursuit, continually ordering S to stop. S cut through a row of parked cars before attempting to jump a fence at the rear of the complex. As S was mid-vault, I was able to grab his leg, causing him to fall to the ground on the other side. I quickly climbed over the fence. S immediately attempted to scramble to his feet, ignoring my commands to stay on the ground. Fearing S would continue to flee or resist, I utilized a knee strike to S's lower back to gain compliance, which caused him to fall back to the ground. I then secured S's left arm, while Ofc. [NAME], who had just caught up, secured S's right arm. S continued to tense his body and verbally protest, but was successfully handcuffed without further incident. S was then assisted to his feet and escorted back to my patrol vehicle.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 18:30 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to a call for service regarding an intoxicated female refusing to leave the public library at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, we observed a white female, later identified as (A), sitting on the floor near the entrance, yelling at library staff. Her speech was slurred, and she had a strong odor of an alcoholic beverage emanating from her person.

As Ofc. [NAME] took her left arm, I took her right. (A) immediately tensed her body, pulled her arms away, and began to thrash her legs, attempting to kick Ofc. [NAME]. [NAME] assistance, applied a wrist lock control technique to guide her to the ground to prevent further injury or aggression. After several verbal commands to show her hands, I delivered two open-hand strikes to her right upper arm to gain compliance. (A) then complied, allowing us to secure her hands in handcuffs. On 07/12/2023 at approximately 2315 hours, I responded to 123 Main Street regarding a noise complaint and a large party. Upon arrival, I observed a large gathering and loud music. Contact was made with the property owner who requested all individuals leave the premises due to a lease violation. Most partygoers complied.

I made contact with (A), later identified as a 19-year-old white female, who was standing on the front porch refusing to leave. (A) was verbally advised multiple times to exit the property. (A) responded by yelling "I'm not leaving!" and began swearing at officers. As I attempted to guide (A) by her left arm off the porch, she tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and attempted to retreat back into the residence.

Due to her active resistance and refusal to comply with lawful orders, I applied a wrist control technique to (A)'s left arm. (A) continued to pull away, twisting her body and kicking her legs. Officer [NAME] assisted by securing (A)'s right arm. We initiated a controlled takedown to the ground to gain compliance and prevent further resistance or escape. (A) continued to struggle on the ground, attempting to keep her hands tucked under her body. After several verbal commands to show her hands, Officer [NAME] applied a pressure point control technique to (A)'s neck to gain compliance, at which point (A) ceased active resistance and allowed officers to secure her hands in handcuffs. (A) was then escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Main St for a report of a male causing a disturbance and refusing to leave the premises of a convenience store. Upon arrival, I observed S (later identified as a 48-year-old Black male) inside the store, yelling at the clerk and appearing heavily intoxicated. I engaged S, advising him he needed to leave the property or he would be placed under arrest for trespass. S ignored these commands, instead taking a step towards me with clenched fists. Fearing S was preparing to assault me, I initiated a controlled takedown, bringing S to the ground. On 11/15/20 at approximately 02:15 hours, I responded to a call for a disorderly person in the area of 400 Main St. The caller reported a young female, matching the description of S, yelling and attempting to stop traffic. I re-secured S's left arm and applied a wristlock, directing her to turn around and place her hands behind her back. S continued to actively resist, pulling and twisting, yelling "Let go of me!" I maintained the wristlock and, due to her continued resistance and attempts to break free, executed a controlled takedown to the ground. S landed on her side and continued to struggle, tucking her hands under her body. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted by securing S's right arm. After a brief struggle on the ground, S's hands were secured in handcuffs. S continued to scream obscenities but ceased physical resistance. S was then assisted to her feet and transported to booking for disorderly conduct and resisting arrest.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2230 hours, I responded to 123 Main St for a report of a male subject refusing to leave the premises of a closed business. Narrative:
On 11/15/23 at approximately 1430 hours, I responded to a report of a disorderly female causing a disturbance at the public library located at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a white female, later identified as (A), age 27, standing on a table in the main reading area, yelling obscenities at patrons and library staff. I approached (A) and gave multiple verbal commands to step down from the table and to calm down. (A) refused, screaming "You can't tell me what to do!" and actively encouraging other patrons to join her. Due to (A)'s disruptive behavior and the potential danger of her falling from the table or inciting further disorder, I advised her she was under arrest for disorderly conduct.

As I attempted to take (A)'s arm to escort her from the table, she stiffened her body, pulled away, and actively resisted my grasp. (A) then swung her right arm towards my face, narrowly missing me. To prevent further assault and to safely take her into custody, I initiated a controlled takedown, bringing (A) to the floor. While on the ground, (A) continued to struggle, kicking her legs and attempting to push herself up. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted by controlling (A)'s legs while I secured her arms behind her back and applied handcuffs. (A) continued to scream and verbally resist but was physically restrained. On 11/15/2023 at approximately 2030 hours, I responded to 123 Main St for a report of a domestic disturbance. The caller stated a female, identified as (A), was intoxicated and refusing to leave the residence. On the above date and time, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to a 911 call regarding a loud party at 45 Elm St. Upon arrival, we observed a large gathering and loud music emanating from the residence. Narrative:
On 11/15/23 at approximately 1430 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to a report of a disorderly female refusing to leave the premises of the "Good Eats" diner at 45 Main St. Upon arrival, we observed a White female, later identified as (A), age 55, yelling at staff and patrons. (A) appeared disoriented and had a strong odor of alcohol emanating from her person. We attempted to engage (A) verbally, explaining that she needed to leave or face trespassing charges. (A) refused, stating "You can't make me leave!" and continued to shout obscenities. After several minutes of de-escalation attempts, (A) began to walk towards the kitchen area, which was restricted to staff. Fearing she might cause further disruption or injury to herself, I stepped in front of (A) and gave a verbal command to stop. (A) attempted to push past me. I then placed my hands on (A)'s upper arms to guide her towards the exit. (A) immediately tensed up, pulling her arms away forcefully and attempting to twist her body. I maintained my grip and Ofc. [NAME] assisted by securing (A)'s other arm. (A) continued to pull and thrash her body, refusing to walk. Due to her active resistance, Ofc. We maintained control and, with difficulty, were able to place her against the patrol vehicle. (A) continued to yell and actively resist handcuffing by pulling her hands away. On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Elm Street for a welfare check after a 911 caller reported a female screaming and throwing items inside the residence. S ignored my commands, pushing against the door and attempting to force it closed while continuing to yell obscenities. I grabbed S's right arm, applying a control hold to prevent her escape and ensure officer safety. S tensed her body, pulling her arm away vigorously and flailing her left arm. Ofc. [NAME] assisted by securing S's left arm. We were able to bring S's arms behind her back, despite her continued tensing and verbal resistance, and place her in handcuffs. S was then transported to St. Jude's Hospital for a mental health evaluation.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded to 742 Main Street for a report of an intoxicated male causing a disturbance outside a local business. Narrative:

S then attempted to stand up abruptly, swaying unsteadily, and raised her hands in a defensive posture. Fearing S would fall or become more combative, Ofc. Due to her continued resistance and risk of injury to herself or officers, I performed a controlled takedown to the ground. S was then placed in handcuffs without further incident. She continued to mumble incoherently but ceased active resistance. EMS was called to assess S prior to transport.

On the above date and time, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to a 911 call regarding an elderly male, later identified as (A), wandering disoriented in the roadway near Elm St. and Maple Ave. Upon arrival, we observed (A) standing in the middle of the intersection, yelling at passing vehicles and appearing confused. We approached (A) cautiously, identifying ourselves as police and attempting to engage him verbally. (A) turned towards us, his eyes wide and agitated, and began shouting "Get away from me! You're not real!" He then attempted to walk further into traffic, ignoring our commands to stop and move to the sidewalk.

Fearing for (A)'s safety and the safety of motorists, Ofc. [NAME] and I each took one of (A)'s arms to guide him off the street. Due to his active resistance and the immediate danger he posed to himself in traffic, I applied a control hold to (A)'s left wrist, while Ofc. [NAME] secured his right arm. (A) continued to struggle, pulling against our hold and attempting to kick, but we were able to maintain control and escort him safely to the curb. He was subsequently transported to St. Jude's Hospital for medical and mental health evaluation, where he continued to be verbally abusive but ceased physical resistance.

On the above date and time, I responded to a report of an intoxicated male refusing to leave the premises of "The Local Tap" at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a male, later identified as (A), a 54-year-old White male, standing outside the establishment, yelling obscenities at patrons and staff. His speech was slurred, and he smelled strongly of alcohol. I approached (A) and attempted to engage him in conversation, advising him he needed to leave the property. Fearing a physical altercation, I attempted to guide (A) away from the entrance using an escort hold on his left arm. [NAME], who was assisting, intervened, and we both attempted to gain control of (A)'s arms. [NAME] delivered a single open-hand strike to (A)'s upper back to break his resistance. This allowed us to apply handcuffs to (A) without further incident.

On the above date and time, I responded to a call for service at the Public Library regarding a disorderly patron refusing to leave. Narrative: On 11/15/23 at approximately 2230 hours, I responded with Officer [NAME] to a report of a disorderly male outside "The Rusty Mug" bar at 123 Main Street. On 11/15/23 at approximately 20:15 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to 123 Elm St. for a welfare check. On 07/12/2023 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded to a call for a welfare check on a female screaming and throwing objects in Elmwood Park. Narrative:
On 11/15/23 at approximately 2030 hours, officers responded to the area of Main St and Elm Ave for a report of an intoxicated female causing a disturbance. On the above date and time, I responded to a report of a disturbance at 123 Main St. involving a female yelling at patrons outside a convenience store. Narrative: On 1/15/2023 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to the Walmart parking lot at 123 Main St for a report of an unconscious male in a running vehicle. I grabbed (A)'s left arm and attempted an arm-bar take-down to remove him from the vehicle. After a brief struggle, we were able to successfully remove (A) from the vehicle and place him in handcuffs. (A) continued to scream obscenities but ceased physical resistance once restrained. He was then transported for medical evaluation.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2030 hours, I responded to 742 Oak St for a welfare check regarding a female, later identified as (A), who was reportedly disoriented and yelling at passersby. Upon arrival, I observed (A) standing near the sidewalk, visibly intoxicated, slurring her words, and shouting obscenities at no one in particular. Narrative:
On the above date and time, I responded to a report of a disorderly person causing a disturbance outside "The Local Tap" bar at 145 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a White male, later identified as S, age 22, yelling loudly and attempting to re-enter the establishment after being refused service. S appeared heavily intoxicated, his speech slurred, and he was swaying unsteadily. I approached S and issued verbal commands for him to calm down and step away from the door. S turned towards me, clenched his fists, and shouted, "I ain't doing shit, pig!" He took a step towards me in an aggressive manner.

Fearing S would become physically violent, I ordered him to place his hands behind his back. S refused, stating, "Get your hands off me!" and actively pulled his arms away when Ofc. [NAME] attempted to secure his left arm. S then spun around, attempting to push past me. I initiated a controlled takedown, bringing S to the ground onto his stomach. On 07/12/23 at approximately 2315 hours, I responded to a report of a disorderly female at "The Local Tap" located at 123 Main St. Dispatch advised the female was highly intoxicated, yelling at patrons, and refusing to leave. Upon arrival, I observed a white female, later identified as S, standing near the patio entrance, screaming obscenities at a bouncer. [NAME] arrived and assisted in securing S's arms behind her back, placing her in handcuffs. S continued to yell profanities but ceased physical resistance once restrained. She was then escorted to my patrol vehicle without further incident.

Narrative:
On 03/15/2023 at approximately 1430 hours, I responded to a shoplifting in progress call at the CVS located at 123 Main St. Dispatch advised that a Black female, later identified as S, age 33, was actively concealing items and refusing to leave the store. Upon arrival, I observed S near the exit, attempting to push past store security. I identified myself as police and instructed S to stop and place her hands behind her back. S immediately yelled, "I ain't doing shit!" and attempted to exit the store, pushing past me.

I grabbed S's left arm to prevent her departure and guide her to a position for handcuffing. S actively pulled her arm away, twisting her body and yelling obscenities. While on the ground, S continued to struggle, tucking her hands under her body and kicking her legs. Officer [NAME] arrived and assisted by securing S's lower body. After repeated verbal commands to "stop resisting" and "give me your hands," I delivered two closed-fist strikes to S's left upper thigh, which created a momentary opening. Officer [NAME] was then able to pull S's left arm out and secure it in handcuffs. I then secured S's right arm. S continued to scream and tense up but was eventually escorted to my patrol vehicle.

Narrative:

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2230 hours, I responded to a report of a disturbance at "The Corner Pub," located at 123 Main St. Dispatch advised an intoxicated female was refusing to leave after being cut off and was actively arguing with staff. Narrative: On 11/15/23 at approximately 2230 hours, I responded to a report of a highly intoxicated female causing a disturbance at Willow Creek Park, which was past closing hours. Narrative: On 11/15/23 at approximately 2230 hours, I responded to a report of a disturbance at "[NAME]'s Diner" located at 123 Main St. Dispatch advised an intoxicated male was yelling at staff and refusing to leave. Upon arrival, I observed a male, later identified as S (DOB: 01/01/1971), yelling profanities at the cashier and blocking the main entrance. I gave S verbal commands to calm down and step outside the establishment. S refused, stating loudly, "I ain't going anywhere, you can't make me!" On the above date and time, I responded to a report of an intoxicated male causing a disturbance at "The Corner Bistro," refusing to leave the premises. On 11/15/23 at approximately 14:30 hours, officers responded to 789 Maple Ave for a welfare check on an elderly female, later identified as (A), reported by a neighbor for erratic behavior and screaming in her front yard. On 03/15/2023 at approximately 1430 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to 123 Maple St. for a welfare check on a 51-year-old female, later identified as (A), reported by her daughter to be disoriented and refusing to take medication.
