I secured (A)'s right arm and, utilizing a straight arm bar takedown, brought her to the ground. Once on the ground, (A) continued to struggle, tucking her hands under her body and kicking her legs. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted by controlling (A)'s legs while I was able to gain control of her left arm. We successfully applied handcuffs to (A)'s wrists in the rear. (A) continued to verbally resist and yell during the process but ceased physical resistance once handcuffed. She was then escorted to my patrol vehicle without further incident.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 14:30 hours, I responded to the main branch of the Public Library for a report of a disorderly female refusing to leave. Upon arrival, I observed a female, later identified as S (Race: BLACK, Sex: FEMALE, Age: 49), sitting on the floor near the entrance, yelling obscenities at library staff and patrons. S was advised multiple times to cease her behavior and exit the premises. S refused, stating "I ain't going anywhere, you can't make me!" and continued to yell, drawing a crowd of onlookers. I informed S that if she did not comply, she would be placed under arrest for disorderly conduct and trespassing. S then attempted to stand up, but swayed unsteadily, still yelling at officers and staff. Due to her continued non-compliance, disruptive behavior, and refusal to leave, I attempted to take S into custody. As I reached for S's left arm to apply an escort hold, she pulled away violently, tensing her entire body and bracing herself against a nearby bookshelf. Ofc. [NAME] arrived to assist. We gave S further verbal commands to stop resisting and place her hands behind her back. S continued to struggle, twisting her body, pulling her arms away, and attempting to kick backwards. Ofc. [NAME] and I utilized an arm-bar control technique on S's left arm to gain compliance. S continued to pull away, verbally abusive, yelling "Get off me! I didn't do anything!" We were eventually able to secure S's left wrist in a handcuff, but she continued to resist with her right arm, pulling it away and tucking it under her body. After several more verbal commands and continued physical effort, we were able to secure both of S's wrists in handcuffs. S remained verbally abusive during the escort to the patrol vehicle.

On the above date and time, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to 700 Elm Street for a report of a male causing a disturbance outside a convenience store. Upon arrival, we observed (A) standing near the entrance, yelling obscenities at passersby. We approached (A) and identified ourselves as police. (A) immediately turned towards us, stating, "I ain't doing nothing, leave me alone!" We attempted to engage (A) in conversation and ascertain the nature of the disturbance. (A) became increasingly agitated, clenching his fists and stepping closer to Ofc. [NAME]. I instructed (A) to step back and calm down, but he refused, instead yelling, "You can't touch me!"

Due to his aggressive demeanor and refusal to comply, we informed (A) he was being detained for disorderly conduct. As Ofc. [NAME] attempted to secure (A)'s left arm, (A) forcefully pulled away, twisting his body and yelling. I moved to assist, attempting to gain control of (A)'s right arm. (A) continued to actively resist, tensing his entire body and pulling his arms inward, making it impossible to apply handcuffs. We initiated a standing takedown, bringing (A) to the ground onto his left side. (A) continued to struggle on the ground, attempting to push himself up and keep his hands tucked under his torso. After several verbal commands to show his hands, Ofc. [NAME] delivered two closed-hand strikes to (A)'s right bicep. This allowed us to successfully secure (A)'s hands behind his back with handcuffs. (A) remained verbally uncooperative during transport to booking.

Narrative:
On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Main St for a report of a domestic disturbance. Dispatch advised a male, later identified as (A), was yelling at his girlfriend and refusing to leave the residence. Upon arrival, I observed (A) standing in the doorway, actively yelling at a female inside. I gave several verbal commands for (A) to step outside and speak with me. (A) ignored my commands, continued to yell, and then attempted to push past the female back into the residence. Fearing the situation would escalate, I attempted to grab (A)'s left arm to guide him out. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away violently, and swung his left elbow backward, nearly striking my face. Due to (A)'s active resistance and aggressive behavior, I initiated a takedown, bringing (A) to the ground. On the ground, (A) continued to resist, tucking his arms underneath his body and kicking his legs. Ofc. [NAME] assisted by applying pressure to (A)'s shoulder blade while I secured his right arm. After several more verbal commands and continued struggle, we were able to gain control and place (A) in handcuffs. (A) continued to be verbally uncooperative during transport to booking.

On the above date and time, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to a 911 call regarding a disturbance at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, we observed a female, later identified as (A), standing outside apartment 2B, yelling loudly and refusing to disperse from the common area despite requests from neighbors. We approached (A) and attempted to ascertain the nature of the disturbance. (A) immediately became agitated, raising her voice and stating, "I ain't going nowhere, this ain't your business!"

I verbally instructed (A) to lower her voice and cease her disruptive behavior. She refused, continued to yell, and began to pace aggressively. After several attempts to de-escalate the situation and inform (A) she was causing a public disturbance, I advised her she would be issued a citation for disorderly conduct. I requested her identification, to which (A) replied, "I don't have to give you nothing!" and attempted to walk away from us towards the street.

As (A) turned, I reached out and grabbed her left arm to prevent her from leaving the scene. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and spun around, stating, "Get your hands off me!" Ofc. [NAME] then stepped in and secured (A)'s right arm. Due to her active resistance and refusal to comply, I performed a controlled takedown to the ground to safely apply handcuffs. (A) continued to struggle briefly on the ground, kicking her legs, before we were able to secure her wrists behind her back. She was then assisted to her feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle. (A) remained verbally abusive throughout the incident.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 0215 hours, I responded to a report of a suspicious person loitering in the parking lot of a closed hardware store at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a white male, later identified as (A), fitting the description, pacing near the rear entrance. As I approached, (A) immediately turned away, placing his hands in his pockets, and began walking briskly towards the street, ignoring my verbal command to "Stop, police!"

I accelerated my pace and again ordered (A) to stop and show his hands. (A) continued to walk, stating, "I didn't do anything." Fearing (A) might be concealing a weapon or attempting to flee, I moved to intercept him. As I reached him, I attempted to gain control of his left arm to conduct a pat-down. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away forcefully, and spun his body, attempting to break free from my grasp. I maintained control of his arm and, due to his active resistance and flight attempt, I initiated a straight-arm bar takedown.

(A) went to the ground on his left side. He continued to struggle, tucking his arms underneath his body and refusing to present them for handcuffing. Officer [NAME] arrived and assisted by applying pressure to (A)'s upper back while I delivered two closed-fist strikes to his left deltoid muscle. This allowed me to gain control of his left arm. We then secured both of (A)'s hands in handcuffs behind his back. (A) continued to verbally protest and yell obscenities but ceased physical resistance once handcuffed. He was then escorted to my patrol vehicle without further incident.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 14:10 hours, I responded to a report of a disturbance at the public library located at 45 Main St. Dispatch advised that a female patron was causing a disturbance and refusing to leave after being asked by library staff. Upon arrival, I made contact with library staff who pointed out the subject, later identified as (A), a 54-year-old Black female. (A) was loudly arguing with staff near the main entrance, accusing them of discrimination.

I approached (A) and attempted to de-escalate the situation, advising her that she needed to either calm down or leave the premises. (A) immediately turned her aggression towards me, yelling "I'm not going anywhere, you can't make me!" and stepping closer in an agitated manner. She continued to shout obscenities and refuse all verbal commands to step back or lower her voice. Due to her continued disruptive behavior and refusal to comply with lawful orders, I informed (A) she was under arrest for disorderly conduct and trespass.

When I attempted to take her arm to place her in handcuffs, (A) tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and spun her body, stating "Don't touch me!" Ofc. [NAME] then assisted, and we each took one of (A)'s arms. (A) continued to pull and twist, actively resisting our attempts to bring her hands behind her back. We maintained a firm grip on her arms, utilizing a control hold to prevent her from striking us or escaping. After a brief struggle, we were able to bring her hands together and apply handcuffs. (A) continued to yell and actively resist during the escort to the patrol vehicle, requiring a two-officer escort. She was safely secured in the rear of the patrol vehicle.

Narrative: On 03/15/2023 at approximately 1430 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to the Public Library at 123 Main St for a report of an unwanted person. Dispatch advised the subject, later identified as (A), a 61-year-old white female, was causing a disturbance and refusing to leave. Upon arrival, we observed (A) sitting in a chair in the lobby, yelling at library staff. Her speech was somewhat slurred, and she appeared agitated and disoriented. We approached (A) and attempted to engage her, explaining why we were there and asking her to exit the building. (A) immediately became verbally aggressive, yelling "You can't make me leave!" and "This is my library!" She refused all verbal commands to stand or exit. Due to her continued refusal and escalating agitation, Ofc. [NAME] and I informed (A) we would be escorting her out. As Ofc. [NAME] took her left arm, I took her right. (A) immediately tensed her body, pulled her arms away from our grasp, and attempted to push back into the chair. We applied a controlled escort hold, guiding her to her feet. (A) continued to resist by pulling her arms and stiffening her body, refusing to walk willingly. We maintained the escort hold and slowly maneuvered her towards the exit. Once outside, (A) continued to pull away, attempting to break free. To gain better control and prevent her from falling or striking us, we transitioned to a standing modified armbar. She was then guided to the patrol vehicle and secured in handcuffs for transport to the station for trespassing and further evaluation.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2110 hours, I responded to a call for service at the Public Library, 123 Main St, regarding a male refusing to leave after closing. Upon arrival, I made contact with the suspect, later identified as (A), a 64-year-old Black male, who was seated at a table in the reading room. Library staff advised me that (A) had been asked multiple times to leave as the library was closed, but he refused. I approached (A) and explained the situation, asking him to gather his belongings and exit the building. (A) stared blankly and stated, "I ain't going nowhere," then turned his back to me. I repeated my lawful order, advising (A) that he would be subject to arrest for trespassing if he did not comply. (A) began to raise his voice, yelling, "You can't make me leave!" and clenching his fists. Due to his continued non-compliance and escalating agitation, I advised (A) that he was under arrest. As I reached to take his arm, (A) tensed up and pulled away, attempting to stand and push past me. I applied an escort hold to his left arm, and Ofc. [NAME] assisted by securing his right arm. (A) continued to pull and twist, refusing to allow officers to bring his hands behind his back. We guided (A) towards the exit, but he dug his heels in and became dead weight. After several verbal commands to comply, Ofc. [NAME] and I executed a controlled takedown to the ground to safely secure (A) in handcuffs. (A) was then transported to the precinct.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 14:30 hours, I responded to 742 Elm Street for a welfare check regarding an elderly female, later identified as S, who was reportedly sleeping in the common hallway and refusing to leave. Upon arrival, I observed S, a Black female, approximately 60-70 years old, lying on a bench in the hallway, mumbling to herself. I attempted to engage S verbally, explaining why I was there and requesting her to stand up and exit the building. S ignored my commands, pulled her blanket over her head, and stated, "Leave me alone." After repeated attempts to gain compliance, Ofc. [NAME] and I advised S that she was trespassing and needed to be escorted out.

As Ofc. [NAME] attempted to gently guide S to a standing position by her arm, S tensed her body, pulled away, and began to flail her arms. S then yelled "Don't touch me!" and attempted to push Ofc. [NAME] away. Due to S's active resistance and refusal to comply with lawful orders, I assisted Ofc. [NAME] in securing S. We utilized an escort hold, placing one hand on S's upper back and the other on her arm, to guide her out of the building. S continued to tense her body and drag her feet, making it difficult to move her. Once outside, S again pulled away and attempted to walk back into the building. We maintained the escort hold and directed S towards the sidewalk. S then dropped to the ground, refusing to stand. We assisted S to her feet and continued to escort her to a safe location away from the property, where EMS was called to evaluate her. S was eventually transported to St. Jude's Hospital for evaluation without further incident or use of force.

Narrative: On 03/12/2023 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to a report of a disorderly male causing a disturbance outside "The Rusty Mug" bar at 145 Main Street. Upon arrival, I observed a White male, later identified as (A), standing in the middle of the sidewalk, yelling obscenities at passersby and attempting to block the entrance to the establishment. (A) appeared heavily intoxicated, with slurred speech and an unsteady gait.

I approached (A) and identified myself as a police officer, instructing him to cease his disruptive behavior and move off the sidewalk. (A) turned towards me, aggressively stating, "I ain't doing shit, pig!" and took a step closer, clenching his fists. I repeated my commands, advising (A) that he was obstructing the public way and would be arrested if he did not comply. (A) ignored my warnings, attempting to push past me into the bar.

At this point, I initiated an escort hold on (A)'s left arm to guide him away. (A) immediately tensed up, pulling his arm away from my grasp and attempting to spin around. Due to his continued resistance and aggressive posture, I performed a controlled takedown, bringing (A) to the ground in a prone position. (A) continued to struggle on the ground, tucking his hands beneath his chest and refusing to present them for handcuffing. Ofc. [NAME] arrived on scene and assisted. We applied pressure to (A)'s shoulders, eventually gaining control of his left arm. Once one handcuff was applied, (A) ceased actively resisting. Both handcuffs were then secured. (A) was subsequently placed under arrest for Disorderly Conduct and Resisting Arrest.

On the above date and time, I responded to a report of a disorderly person at the Public Library, 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a Black female, later identified as [Subject's Name], approximately 60 years old, yelling loudly and blocking an aisle, causing patrons to avoid the area. Library staff informed me they had asked her to leave multiple times, but she refused. I approached [Subject's Name] and verbally instructed her to cease her disruptive behavior and exit the premises. She turned to me, stating, "I ain't going nowhere, this is a public place!" and continued to shout. I advised her that if she did not comply, she would be trespassed and arrested. She ignored my commands and continued to raise her voice.

Due to her continued non-compliance and disruption, I informed [Subject's Name] she was under arrest for trespassing. I attempted to take her right arm to place her in handcuffs. [Subject's Name] immediately tensed her arm, pulled it away from my grasp, and began to lean back, refusing to move. Ofc. [NAME] arrived to assist. We both gave repeated verbal commands for her to comply and place her hands behind her back. [Subject's Name] continued to resist by stiffening her body and attempting to pull away. Ofc. [NAME] then secured her left arm while I maintained control of her right arm, applying a moderate amount of pressure to gain compliance. We were able to slowly guide her out of the library and secure her in handcuffs at the rear of the patrol vehicle. She continued to verbalize her displeasure but ceased physical resistance once handcuffed.

On the above date and time, I responded to the area of 1400 Elmwood Ave for a report of a male causing a disturbance, yelling at passersby and blocking pedestrian traffic. Upon arrival, I observed S (a 26-year-old Black male) standing in the middle of the sidewalk, yelling incoherently. I exited my patrol vehicle and attempted to make verbal contact with S, identifying myself as police and asking him to move to the side of the sidewalk. S ignored my commands, turned towards me, and began yelling, "I ain't doing shit, get out of my face!" while clenching his fists and taking a bladed stance.

Fearing S was preparing to physically assault me, I gave multiple verbal commands for S to calm down and comply with my orders to move. S continued to advance towards me aggressively. I then attempted to create distance and deployed a short burst of OC spray to S's face. S immediately recoiled, yelling, but did not fall or cease his aggressive posture. As Ofc. [NAME] arrived on scene, S lunged towards me. Ofc. [NAME] and I coordinated a takedown, bringing S to the ground in a controlled manner. S continued to actively resist on the ground, tucking his arms under his body and kicking his legs. Ofc. [NAME] applied pressure to S's shoulder while I gained control of his left arm, eventually securing S in handcuffs after a brief struggle. S continued to yell and spit after being secured. He was then escorted to my patrol vehicle for transport.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 14:30 hours, I responded to 456 Elm Street for a report of an unwanted person refusing to leave private property. Upon arrival, I observed a Black male, later identified as Mr. [NAME] Davis (DOB: 01/01/1960), standing near the entrance of the property, yelling at the homeowner. I approached Mr. Davis and identified myself, advising him he needed to leave the premises as requested by the property owner. Mr. Davis turned towards me, raised his voice, and stated, "I ain't going nowhere! This is a free country!" He appeared agitated, clenching his fists.

I issued several verbal commands for Mr. Davis to calm down and step away from the property. He continued to yell, taking a step towards me. Fearing he might attempt to assault me or the homeowner, I advised him he was under arrest for trespassing and disorderly conduct. Mr. Davis immediately tensed up, pulling his arms close to his body when I attempted to take his left arm. He actively resisted, twisting his torso and pulling away, yelling "Don't touch me!" Ofc. [NAME] arrived on scene and assisted. We utilized a two-officer escort hold to gain control of Mr. Davis's arms. He continued to brace and pull against our grasp. Due to his continued resistance, Ofc. [NAME] and I performed a controlled takedown to the ground to safely secure him in handcuffs. Once on the ground, Mr. Davis ceased resisting and was cooperative during handcuffing. He was then assisted back to his feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded to 123 Main St regarding a report of a male refusing to leave a private residence and causing a disturbance. Upon arrival, I made contact with the homeowner, who identified the male as (A), a 54-year-old White male, and stated he was intoxicated and yelling. I located (A) inside the living room, actively yelling profanities. I verbally identified myself as police and ordered (A) to calm down and step outside to speak with me. (A) immediately turned towards me, clenched his fists, and yelled, "You can't make me do anything!" He took a bladed stance and began advancing. Fearing for my safety and the safety of others present, I gave repeated commands for (A) to stop and show his hands. (A) ignored my commands and continued to approach. I deployed my department-issued taser to his center mass. The taser deployment was effective, causing (A) to immediately drop to the ground. Ofc. [NAME], who had just arrived, assisted in securing (A)'s hands behind his back while he was still on the ground. (A) was then rolled onto his side and checked for injuries. He continued to be verbally abusive but complied with being escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 2030 hours, I responded to a trespass complaint at the Main Street Community Center. Dispatch advised a female was refusing to leave the premises after closing. Upon arrival, I observed a Black female, later identified as (A), sitting in the lobby. I approached (A) and explained that the center was closed and she needed to leave. (A) immediately became agitated, stating, "I'm not going anywhere, this is my place!" and began to yell. I repeated my orders for her to exit the building, offering assistance if she needed a ride or direction. (A) stood up abruptly, clenched her fists, and attempted to walk past me towards an interior hallway, ignoring my commands to stop.

Fearing she would further barricade herself or cause damage, I placed my hand on her arm to guide her towards the exit. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled her arm away with considerable force, and attempted to push past me. Ofc. [NAME] assisted, and we attempted to gain control of (A)'s arms for an escort hold. (A) actively resisted, pulling her arms away, twisting her body, and yelling loudly. Due to her continued active resistance and refusal to comply with lawful orders, Ofc. [NAME] and I utilized a joint escort hold, applying pressure to her upper arms to prevent her from striking us or escaping. We escorted (A) out of the building and placed her against the patrol vehicle to conduct a pat-frisk for weapons, during which she continued to tense and verbally protest. She was subsequently transported to the station for booking.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded to a report of a disorderly female causing a disturbance in front of 789 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a white female, later identified as (A), fitting the description, yelling incoherently at pedestrians and stumbling near the curb. Her speech was slurred, and she had a strong odor of an alcoholic beverage emanating from her person.

I approached (A) and attempted to engage her, asking if she needed assistance and trying to ascertain her well-being. (A) immediately became verbally aggressive, shouting "Leave me alone!" and attempting to walk directly into oncoming traffic. For her safety and the safety of others, Ofc. [NAME] and I intervened to prevent her from entering the roadway.

(A) actively resisted our attempts to guide her back to the sidewalk. She pulled her arms away forcefully, tensed her body, and flailed her free arm towards Ofc. [NAME], making incidental contact with his chest. Due to her continued resistance and potential danger to herself, I applied a wrist control technique to her left arm while Ofc. [NAME] secured her right. (A) continued to struggle, attempting to twist free and kick backwards. To safely gain control and prevent further injury, I initiated a controlled takedown to the ground. Once on the ground, (A) continued to struggle briefly before Ofc. [NAME] and I were able to secure her hands in handcuffs behind her back. She remained verbally uncooperative but ceased physical resistance after being cuffed. She was then assisted to her feet and transported to the local detox facility.

On the above date and time, I responded to a domestic disturbance call at 123 Elm Street. Dispatch advised of an intoxicated male, later identified as (A), screaming at family members and throwing objects inside the residence. Upon arrival, I observed (A) standing on the front porch, red-faced and yelling obscenities into the house. He immediately turned his attention to me, shouting, "You got no business here!" and began to advance down the steps.

I issued several verbal commands for (A) to stop and place his hands behind his back. (A) ignored my commands, continued to approach, and clenched his fists, stating, "I ain't going anywhere with you!" Due to his aggressive posture, intoxication, and refusal to comply, I believed he posed a threat to officer safety and the safety of others. As he reached the bottom step, approximately ten feet from me, I deployed my department-issued Taser X2 in probe mode. Both probes made contact with (A)'s torso.

The Taser deployment was effective, causing (A) to immediately fall to the ground, yelling in pain. While he was incapacitated, Ofc. [NAME] and I moved in quickly to secure his hands behind his back. (A) continued to groan and verbally resist, but the Taser had incapacitated him enough to allow for safe handcuffing. He was then assisted to his feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle. No further force was necessary.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 1430 hours, I responded to 789 Main St (Convenience Mart) for a report of a disorderly male refusing to leave the premises. Upon arrival, I made contact with the store clerk who pointed out the subject, later identified as (A). (A) was observed yelling at another patron and appeared agitated, with slurred speech and an odor of alcohol. I verbally engaged (A), advising him he needed to leave the store as per the clerk’s request. (A) refused to comply, stating, "I'm not going anywhere, you can't make me."

After repeated verbal commands to leave, (A) remained defiant, clenching his fists and tensing his body. As I attempted to guide (A) by his left arm towards the exit, he actively pulled away and shoved my hand off his arm. Ofc. [NAME] then assisted, securing (A)'s right arm. (A) continued to brace his feet and resist being moved, pulling his arms forward against our grip. Due to his active resistance and refusal to comply, Ofc. [NAME] and I applied a modified escort hold, maintaining control of both of (A)'s arms. (A) continued to tense and twist his body. We then guided (A) to a seated position on the ground to safely apply handcuffs. (A) resisted being seated but was eventually secured in handcuffs without further incident. He was checked for injuries and transported to booking.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2030 hours, officers responded to the Main Street Library at 123 Main St for a report of a disorderly person. Library staff advised a 60-year-old White female, later identified as [Subject's Name], was refusing to leave after closing and was yelling at patrons. Upon arrival, I observed [Subject's Name] standing in the lobby, shouting incoherently at a librarian. I approached and attempted to engage her verbally, explaining the library was closed and she needed to exit the building. [Subject's Name] made eye contact but then turned her back to me, attempting to walk further into the closed section of the library. I issued several verbal commands to stop and exit, which she ignored.

Given her continued non-compliance and refusal to leave, I advised her she would be escorted out. As I gently took her left arm to guide her towards the exit, [Subject's Name] immediately tensed her entire body, pulled her arm away sharply, and dug her heels into the carpet, refusing to move. She began to yell, "You can't make me!" Ofc. [NAME] arrived to assist. We applied a two-officer escort hold, maintaining control of her arms and upper torso to prevent her from falling or striking out. [Subject's Name] continued to stiffen her body and actively resist walking, requiring us to physically maneuver her through the lobby and out the front doors. She was eventually placed in the rear of P-1 for transport to her residence, where family was contacted.

Narrative:
On the above date and time, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to 456 Elm Street for a report of a disorderly female refusing to leave a restaurant. Upon arrival, we observed a Black female, later identified as S, age 45, standing near the hostess stand, yelling at staff and pointing aggressively. She appeared highly agitated and smelled strongly of alcohol. We approached S and identified ourselves, asking her to calm down and step outside to speak with us. S immediately turned her aggression towards us, yelling, "I ain't going nowhere! You can't make me!" and swatting her hands in the air. Due to her disruptive behavior and level of intoxication, we informed S she was being placed under arrest for disorderly conduct. S responded by yelling "Don't touch me!" and actively pulling her arms close to her body, bracing herself against the hostess stand. I attempted to secure S's left arm, but she violently pulled away, twisting her body and attempting to push past Ofc. [NAME]. Due to her active resistance, I applied an escort hold to S's left arm. S continued to struggle, spinning and kicking her legs, refusing to comply with verbal commands to stop resisting. To prevent injury to S or officers, I performed a controlled takedown, guiding S to the ground onto her left side. S continued to thrash and keep her hands tucked under her body. After several commands, Ofc. [NAME] was able to gain control of S's right wrist, and I secured her left, placing her in handcuffs. S was then assisted to her feet and transported without further incident.

Narrative:
On 11/15/23 at approximately 2030 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to 123 Main St. for a domestic disturbance. Upon arrival, we observed a Black female, identified as S, age 29, yelling loudly and throwing items inside the residence. We attempted to make contact, and S opened the door, immediately becoming verbally abusive towards us, stating 'You can't make me leave!' We issued multiple verbal commands for her to calm down and step outside to speak with us. S refused, tensing her body and attempting to close the door on Ofc. [NAME]. As she tried to shut the door, I placed my foot in the doorway and verbally ordered her to stop resisting and step out. S then pushed against the door, attempting to force it closed, yelling "Get out of my house!" Fearing she would retreat further into the residence or escalate the situation, I grabbed her left arm with my right hand and Ofc. [NAME] secured her right arm. S began to pull away violently, twisting her body and yelling. We initiated a modified arm bar to gain control. S continued to tense and resist, attempting to pull her arms free and kick backwards. After several verbal commands to stop resisting, Ofc. [NAME] delivered one open-hand strike to S's upper arm to break her resistance. This strike was effective, and we were then able to complete the handcuffing procedure. S remained verbally combative but was secured and transported to the precinct for booking.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded to 123 Elm Street for a report of a domestic disturbance involving an intoxicated male refusing to leave the residence. Upon arrival, I made contact with the reporting party, Ms. Sarah Jenkins, who stated her husband, (A) [subject], was highly intoxicated and had been verbally aggressive. I observed (A) standing in the doorway, swaying slightly, with slurred speech.

I attempted to engage (A) in conversation, explaining the nature of our presence and requesting he step outside to speak with us. (A) immediately became agitated, yelling "I'm not going anywhere, this is my house!" and began to step back inside the residence. Fearing for the safety of Ms. Jenkins and her children who were inside, I gave repeated verbal commands for (A) to stop and step back outside. (A) ignored these commands, turning his back to me and attempting to close the door.

At this point, Ofc. [NAME] and I moved to prevent (A) from re-entering. I grabbed (A)'s left arm and Ofc. [NAME] secured his right. (A) immediately tensed up, twisting his body and pulling his arms away, yelling obscenities. He then forcefully shoved his right elbow backward, striking Ofc. [NAME] in the chest. Due to (A)'s active resistance and assaultive behavior, I delivered a single closed-fist strike to (A)'s left shoulder blade area to create separation and gain compliance. This strike caused (A) to briefly lose his balance, allowing Ofc. [NAME] and I to execute a controlled takedown to the ground. While on the ground, (A) continued to struggle, trying to push himself up, but we were able to secure his hands in handcuffs behind his back. (A) continued to yell and resist even after being cuffed, requiring us to maintain control until he was placed in the patrol vehicle.

Narrative:
On the above date and time, I responded to 789 Industrial Way for a report of a suspicious person inside a fenced, closed business. Upon arrival, I observed a white male, later identified as (A), standing near a loading dock. I exited my patrol vehicle and immediately gave verbal commands, "Police! Show me your hands!" (A) turned towards me, keeping his hands in his pockets, and began yelling, "I'm not doing anything wrong! Get away from me!" I repeated my commands for (A) to show his hands and asked him to identify himself. (A) continued to ignore my commands, started walking away from me towards the rear of the building, and stated, "I don't have to tell you anything!"

Fearing (A) might be attempting to flee or access a weapon, I closed the distance and attempted to grab his left arm to prevent further flight and conduct a pat-down for weapons. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away, and spun around, pushing me with his right hand in the chest area. At this point, I delivered a quick open-hand strike to (A)'s left shoulder to create distance and gain compliance. (A) stumbled back but remained defiant, adopting a fighting stance. Ofc. [NAME] arrived on scene and we both gave simultaneous commands for (A) to get on the ground. (A) refused, yelling "No!" and took a step towards Ofc. [NAME]. Seeing this aggressive movement, I quickly moved in and executed a leg sweep, taking (A) to the ground. (A) landed on his stomach and continued to struggle, tucking his arms underneath his body. Ofc. [NAME] applied pressure to (A)'s upper back while I worked to extract (A)'s left arm. After several seconds of struggle, during which (A) continued to tense and resist, we were able to secure both of (A)'s hands in handcuffs. (A) was then assisted to his feet and escorted to my patrol vehicle.

On 11/15/2023 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to a report of a disturbance at 450 Main St (Public Library). Dispatch advised a female, later identified as (S), was refusing to leave and yelling at staff. Upon arrival, we observed S, a white female, 33, standing near the entrance, visibly agitated and shouting obscenities towards a library employee.

I verbally engaged S, advising her she needed to leave the premises. S turned towards me, her eyes bloodshot, and loudly stated, "I'm not going anywhere, you can't make me!" She then attempted to walk past me. I extended my arm to block her path and reiterated the order to leave. S immediately tensed up, attempted to push my arm away, and began to pull her body backward, stating "Don't touch me!"

Per department policy, I informed S she was under arrest for trespassing and disorderly conduct. S continued to resist, pulling her arms away as I attempted to secure her left wrist for handcuffing. She actively resisted my grasp, twisting her body and kicking her feet. Ofc. [NAME] moved to assist, securing S's right arm. We utilized a joint manipulation technique to gain control of S's arms and brought her to the ground in a controlled manner due to her continued active resistance. While on the ground, S continued to struggle, yelling and attempting to pull her hands free. After a brief struggle, we were able to successfully apply handcuffs to S's wrists behind her back. S was then escorted to the patrol vehicle without further incident.

Narrative:
On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Main St (The Diner) for a report of an intoxicated female causing a disturbance and refusing to leave. Upon arrival, I observed a female, later identified as (A), yelling profanities at a restaurant employee and attempting to throw a glass of water. (A) appeared heavily intoxicated, exhibiting slurred speech and an unsteady gait. I verbally ordered (A) to calm down and exit the establishment. (A) ignored my commands, instead turning her aggression towards me, stating, "You can't make me leave!" and lunging slightly forward.

Fearing for the safety of staff and patrons, and due to (A)'s continued disruptive behavior, I informed her she was under arrest for disorderly conduct and trespass. As I attempted to take hold of her left arm to escort her out, (A) violently pulled away, twisting her body and tensing her arm. She then swung her right arm towards my chest, making glancing contact. To gain control, I applied a wrist lock to (A)'s left arm while Ofc. [NAME] simultaneously secured her right arm. (A) continued to struggle, pulling against our hold and attempting to kick backwards. Due to her active resistance, we initiated a controlled takedown to the ground. Once on the ground, (A) continued to thrash, but we were able to secure her hands behind her back in handcuffs. (A) was then assisted to her feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On the above date and time, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to 123 Elm St. for a report of a disorderly female refusing to leave a private business. Upon arrival, we observed a female, later identified as S, standing near the entrance, yelling at staff. S appeared agitated and was slurring her words. We approached and identified ourselves as police. I gave S verbal commands to calm down and step outside to speak with us. S refused, stating, "I ain't going anywhere, you can't make me!" and began to walk back further into the establishment. I reiterated my commands for S to stop and exit the building. S ignored my orders, continuing to yell and waving her hands dismissively. As I attempted to guide S by her left arm towards the exit, she tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and swung her right elbow back, narrowly missing my chest. Fearing further assault and her continued refusal to comply, I performed a controlled take-down to the ground. S continued to resist on the ground, attempting to pull her arms underneath her body. Ofc. [NAME] assisted by securing S's left arm while I secured her right. We were able to place S in handcuffs after a brief struggle. S was then escorted to the patrol vehicle, continuing to yell obscenities.

Narrative: On the above date and time, I responded to a call regarding a disorderly male at the bus stop located at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed S (later identified as [Subject's Name], Race=BLACK, Sex=MALE, Age=48) yelling profanities at passersby and obstructing the sidewalk. I gave multiple verbal commands for (A) to stand up and gather his belongings. (A) refused, stood abruptly, clenched his fists, and took a bladed stance towards me, stating, "Come at me, bro!" On 07/15/2023 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to the area of 123 Main St regarding a report of a male causing a disturbance and blocking traffic. On the above date and time, I responded to 456 Elm Ave for a report of a male causing a disturbance and refusing to leave a private property. Upon arrival, I observed a White male, later identified as (A), age 22, standing in the driveway, yelling at the homeowner. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away forcefully, and spun his body, actively resisting my attempt to control him. He continued to yell and actively tried to pull away from my grasp. Due to his continued resistance and refusal to comply, I transitioned to a controlled takedown to the ground. [NAME] arrived and assisted, giving loud verbal commands to "Stop resisting! Hands behind your back!" After a brief struggle, we were able to secure both of (A)'s hands behind his back and place him in handcuffs. (A) continued to be verbally combative but ceased physical resistance once restrained. On 11/15/23 at approximately 2030 hours, I responded with Ofc. On 11/15/23 at approximately 1430 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to a report of a disturbance at 742 Elm Street. On 11/15/23 at approximately 2030 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to 123 Elm St. for a report of a verbal domestic disturbance. Narrative:

Narrative: On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Main St. for a report of a male refusing to leave the premises of a public library after closing hours. Upon arrival, I made contact with the subject, S (later identified as [initials/name]), seated in the main reading area. Library staff indicated S had been asked to leave multiple times over the past 30 minutes. I advised S of the complaint and issued clear, verbal commands for him to gather his belongings and exit the building. S responded by stating, "I'm not going anywhere, I have a right to be here," and refused to acknowledge my lawful orders.

After several minutes of attempted de-escalation, S remained non-compliant, sitting rigidly and gripping the armrests of his chair. I informed S that he was being trespassed and would be arrested if he continued to refuse. S continued to ignore commands. Ofc. [NAME] and I then attempted to escort S from the chair. As Ofc. [NAME] took S's right arm, I took his left. S immediately tensed his body, pulling his arms away and attempting to stand abruptly while yelling "Don't touch me!" Due to S's active resistance and non-compliance, I applied a wrist-lock control hold to S's left arm, while Ofc. [NAME] maintained control of his right. S continued to struggle, twisting his torso and attempting to pull free. We were able to gain control and guide S to a standing position, then escorted him out of the building and to the rear of the patrol vehicle. S continued to tense up and resist being seated in the patrol car, requiring continued application of control holds until he was secured in the rear. S was placed under arrest for Trespassing and Resisting Arrest.

On 10/15/23 at approximately 1930 hours, I responded to the area of Main Street and Elm Avenue for a report of a male causing a disturbance. He continued to yell loudly, drawing attention from nearby pedestrians and disrupting the peace. Fearing S was preparing to assault me or others, I advised him he was under arrest for disorderly conduct and attempted to secure his left arm. S immediately tensed up, pulling his arm away forcefully and twisting his body to avoid my grasp.

Ofc. [NAME] arrived on scene and assisted. We gave S multiple clear verbal commands to stop resisting and place his hands behind his back. [NAME] was able to secure S's right arm while I maintained control of his left. We then performed a controlled takedown to the ground to gain better control, at which point he ceased active resistance and allowed us to place him in handcuffs. S continued to verbally abuse officers but remained compliant once handcuffed. He was then escorted to the patrol vehicle without further incident.

Narrative:
On 11/15/23 at approximately 1830 hours, I responded to the report of a disturbance at 728 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed (A), a 39-year-old Black female, standing in the doorway of a convenience store, yelling at the store clerk and blocking entry for other customers. I approached (A) and identified myself as a police officer, instructing her to step outside and calm down. (A) refused, stating "You can't make me!" and tensed her body, posturing as if to push past me. Fearing (A) would re-escalate the situation inside the crowded store, I took hold of (A)'s left arm to guide her outside. (A) immediately pulled her arm away with force, twisting her body and attempting to swing her right elbow towards my chest. I quickly secured her left arm in a control hold, while Ofc. After repeated verbal commands to stop resisting, Ofc. [NAME] delivered a knee strike to (A)'s upper thigh to gain compliance. This allowed us to secure (A)'s hands behind her back in handcuffs. (A) was then assisted to her feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle without further incident.

On 07/15/23 at approximately 2310 hours, I responded to a dispatch call regarding a male attempting to break into vehicles in the apartment complex parking lot at 456 Elm Street. Upon arrival, I observed a male, later identified as (S), fitting the description provided, attempting to open a car door. As I exited my patrol vehicle, I gave verbal commands, "Police! Stop right there! Show me your hands!" (S) made eye contact, then immediately turned and fled on foot through the parking lot. I initiated a foot pursuit, repeatedly ordering (S) to stop.

(S) ran between parked cars, ignoring all commands. As I closed the distance, (S) attempted to scale a fence. I grabbed (S) by his shirt to prevent him from escaping over the fence. (S) actively resisted, pulling his arms away and thrashing his body, attempting to break my grip. I delivered a controlled take-down to the ground, bringing (S) to a prone position. On the ground, (S) continued to resist, tucking his arms underneath his body and refusing to present them for handcuffing. Ofc. [NAME] arrived on scene and assisted. We gave multiple verbal commands for (S) to stop resisting and show his hands. Due to his continued non-compliance and active resistance, I delivered two closed-fist strikes to (S)'s right rib cage area. After the strikes, (S) partially complied, allowing Ofc. [NAME] to secure his right wrist in a handcuff. (S) then tensed up again, attempting to pull his left arm free. I applied pressure to his left shoulder blade until he released his arm, allowing us to complete handcuffing. (S) was then secured without further incident and transported.

Narrative:

After several minutes of verbal de-escalation and offering assistance, S remained non-compliant and refused to stand. Due to her apparent disorientation and refusal to leave private property, Officer [NAME] and I determined S needed to be escorted out. I took S's left arm and Ofc. [NAME] took her right. To overcome her active resistance and safely remove her, Ofc. [NAME] applied a controlled escort hold to S's right arm while I maintained control of her left. We were able to slowly lift S from the chair. S continued to resist by pulling and twisting her body. We guided her towards the exit, maintaining the escort holds to prevent her from falling or regaining her seated position. Once outside, S was placed into a patrol vehicle for transport to St. [NAME]'s Hospital for a mental health evaluation, where she was released to medical staff.

Narrative:

On 03/12/2023 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to a report of a suspicious male attempting to open car doors in the rear parking lot of 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a Black male, later identified as (S), matching the description, attempting to manipulate the door handle of a parked sedan. After multiple attempts to gain voluntary compliance, and with S refusing to acknowledge the trespass warning, Ofc. [NAME] and I approached S to physically escort him out. As Ofc. On 03/15/2023 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to a call regarding a trespasser at 123 Main St (Public Library), which had closed an hour prior. Dispatch advised a security guard reported an elderly female refusing to leave. Upon arrival, I observed S (identified as Ms. Eleanor Vance, DOB 1958) seated at a table, refusing to acknowledge the security guard. I repeated my orders, offering to assist her in gathering her belongings. S continued to refuse, clenching her hands and tensing her body. After several attempts to gain voluntary compliance, and with S showing no signs of leaving, I informed her she was under arrest for trespassing. I attempted to take her right arm to escort her out. S immediately tensed up, pulling her arm away and gripping the table edge. Ofc. [NAME] assisted, and we used a two-officer escort hold. S continued to pull away, verbally protesting loudly, "Don't touch me!" and attempting to brace her feet against the floor. Due to her active resistance, we transitioned to a standing escort hold, gently disengaging her grip from the table and guiding her towards the exit. S remained verbally abusive and passively resistant, requiring continuous physical guidance until she was secured in the rear of my patrol vehicle. No injuries were observed or reported.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2015 hours, officers responded to "The Corner Bar" at 123 Main St for a report of an unruly patron refusing to leave. Upon arrival, I observed a white female, later identified as Sarah Jenkins (DOB: XX/XX/75), age 48, yelling at the bartender and attempting to grab bottles from behind the bar. Her speech was slurred, and she appeared heavily intoxicated. I approached Jenkins and identified myself as police, giving verbal commands to step away from the bar and calm down. Jenkins turned towards me, her eyes bloodshot, and began yelling, "You can't tell me what to do! I'm not leaving!" As I attempted to guide her away from the bar with an open hand on her upper arm, Jenkins immediately tensed up, pulling her arm away violently. She then swung her purse, striking my left arm. She continued to yell obscenities and took a combative stance, clenching her fists. Fearing she would strike me again or assault the bartender, I initiated a control hold, attempting to secure her left arm for handcuffing. Jenkins actively resisted, pulling her arm free and pushing against my chest. Ofc. [NAME] then assisted, and we were able to gain control of her arms. She continued to kick and thrash, refusing to allow us to secure her hands. After several verbal commands to stop resisting, Ofc. [NAME] applied a single knee strike to her thigh, which caused her to momentarily buckle. This allowed us to bring her to the ground in a controlled manner, where we were finally able to secure her hands behind her back in handcuffs. Jenkins remained verbally abusive but ceased physical resistance once handcuffed. She was transported to the precinct for booking on charges of disorderly conduct, assault on an officer, and resisting arrest. She was medically cleared by EMS prior to transport.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 22:15 hours, I responded to a report of a disorderly female causing a disturbance at "The Saloon" bar, 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a white female, later identified as (A), 34 years old, yelling loudly at bar staff and patrons, appearing heavily intoxicated. Narrative: On 03/15/2023 at approximately 23:15 hours, I responded to a report of a disorderly female refusing to leave 'The Den' restaurant located at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a white female, later identified as (A), standing near the entrance, yelling obscenities at staff and other patrons. S initially refused to provide current insurance information, stating "I don't have to give you anything." I gave S multiple verbal commands to produce the requested documents and to remain calm. [NAME] arrived on scene and assisted. We were able to pull S from the vehicle. S continued to struggle, flailing his arms and kicking, refusing to place his hands behind his back. Ofc. [NAME] applied a single knee strike to S's thigh, and I utilized an arm bar to gain control. S was then brought to the ground and handcuffed without further incident. On 11/15/23 at approximately 23:15 hours, I responded with Ofc. With Ofc. [NAME] help, we were able to secure (A)'s hands in handcuffs. (A) continued to verbally resist while being escorted to the patrol vehicle, making threats to both officers. On the above date and time, I responded to a shoplifting in progress call at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a female, later identified as (A), fitting the suspect description, actively arguing with store management near the exit. I verbally instructed (A) to stop and place her hands behind her back, informing her she was under arrest for shoplifting. I then utilized an armbar control technique on (A)'s left arm to gain compliance. (A) continued to resist, actively pulling and thrashing her body, attempting to break free. Due to her active resistance, I performed a controlled takedown to the ground. (A) landed on her side and continued to struggle, tucking her hands under her body. Ofc. On 03/15/2023 at approximately 1430 hours, I responded to 123 Main St (SuperMart) for a report of a shoplifting in progress. (A) continued to struggle, pulling against my grip and refusing to cooperate with handcuffing. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted by securing (A)'s right arm. On 11/15/23 at approximately 1430 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to 123 Elm St for a welfare check on a female (A) reported by a neighbor to be disoriented and yelling at passersby. Upon arrival, we located (A) on her front porch, visibly agitated and mumbling incoherently. We attempted to engage (A) in conversation, explaining our presence and offering assistance. (A) became increasingly agitated, yelling "Get off my property!" and waving her arms. When Ofc. [NAME] attempted to offer a bottle of water, (A) slapped his hand away and attempted to stand, swaying unsteadily. Fearing for her safety and the safety of others due to her erratic behavior and refusal to calm down, we advised (A) she was being placed under protective custody for evaluation. (A) immediately tensed up, pulling her arms close to her chest and refusing to allow us to take her arms. I attempted an escort hold on (A)'s left arm, but she actively pulled away, twisting her body and attempting to retreat back towards the door. Ofc. [NAME] then secured (A)'s right arm. We utilized a controlled take-down to the ground, guiding (A) to a seated position to prevent a fall. (A) continued to resist by stiffening her body and refusing to unlock her arms. After several verbal commands to comply, Ofc. [NAME] and I were able to secure (A)'s hands behind her back in handcuffs. She was then assisted to her feet and transported to St. Jude's Hospital for evaluation.

On the above date and time, I responded to the 1400 block of Elm St for a report of a male attempting to break into vehicles. Dispatch advised the suspect was a young male wearing a black hoodie and dark pants. Upon arrival, I observed a male matching the description (A) attempting to open the door of a parked sedan. As I exited my patrol vehicle and identified myself, (A) immediately turned and fled on foot through a residential yard. I initiated a foot pursuit, giving repeated verbal commands to "Stop, police!" and "Get on the ground!". (A) ignored all commands, continuing to run.

After approximately 50 yards, I was able to close the distance and execute a bear hug takedown, bringing (A) to the ground. (A) landed on his stomach and immediately began to struggle, pulling his arms away and tucking them underneath his body to prevent handcuffing. I delivered two open-hand knee strikes to (A)'s left thigh, which had no immediate effect. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted, attempting to gain control of (A)'s right arm. (A) continued to tense his body and thrash. I then applied pressure to (A)'s mandibular angle, and (A) eventually complied by bringing his hands behind his back. He was then placed in handcuffs without further incident. (A) was transported to the precinct for booking.

Narrative: On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Main St, "The Corner Pub," for a report of an intoxicated male refusing to leave the premises. Upon arrival, I observed (A) (later identified as [NAME] [NAME], DOB XX/XX/XXXX) standing at the bar, yelling at the bartender. The bartender stated (A) was heavily intoxicated, refused to pay his tab, and was verbally abusive. I approached (A) and instructed him to calm down and step outside. (A) turned to me, slurring, "I ain't going anywhere, you can't make me." I gave several verbal commands for (A) to leave the establishment and comply with my orders. (A) squared his shoulders, clenched his fists, and took a step towards me, stating, "Get your hands off me, I'm not leaving." Due to (A)'s aggressive posture and continued refusal to comply, I initiated an escort hold on his left arm. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away forcefully, and attempted to spin around to face me. Fearing he would strike me or attempt to flee, I transitioned to a controlled takedown, bringing (A) to the ground. On the ground, (A) continued to stiffen his body and tucked his hands underneath himself, actively resisting attempts to handcuff him. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted by controlling (A)'s lower body. After repeated verbal commands to show his hands, we eventually gained control of (A)'s left arm and secured it in handcuffs. (A) was then rolled onto his stomach and his right arm was secured. He continued to verbally protest and yell obscenities throughout the handcuffing process. He was then assisted to his feet and escorted out of the establishment without further incident.

On the above date and time, I responded to 456 Elm St for a report of a male causing a disturbance inside a convenience store. Upon arrival, I observed a male, later identified as S, matching the description, actively yelling at the cashier and refusing to leave the premises. I made contact with S and advised him of the complaint, requesting him to exit the store. S immediately became verbally aggressive, yelling "I ain't going anywhere! You can't make me!" and squared his shoulders towards me in an aggressive posture. I gave S multiple verbal commands to calm down and step outside, but S refused, continuing to yell and advance towards me. Fearing S would escalate to a physical confrontation, I attempted to create distance and again ordered S to exit. S then took a step towards me, clenching his fists. I grabbed S's left arm to guide him out of the store. S immediately tensed his arm, pulled away forcefully, and spun around, attempting to break free from my grasp. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted by grabbing S's right arm. S continued to actively resist, pulling his arms inward and bracing his body against us. Due to S's active resistance and aggressive demeanor, Ofc. [NAME] performed a leg sweep, bringing S to the ground. S landed on his front and continued to tuck his hands under his body, refusing to present them for handcuffing. I delivered two open-hand strikes to S's left shoulder blade area, which allowed Ofc. [NAME] to gain control of S's left arm. We then secured S in handcuffs.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2030 hours, I responded to the area of 45 Main St. for a report of an intoxicated male causing a disturbance outside "The Local Tap" bar. Upon arrival, I observed a white male, later identified as S, age 56, yelling obscenities at patrons attempting to enter the establishment. S's speech was heavily slurred, and he was swaying noticeably, emitting a strong odor of an alcoholic beverage.

I approached S and advised him that he needed to cease his disruptive behavior and leave the area, or he would be placed under arrest for disorderly conduct. S immediately became agitated, yelling "I ain't going nowhere! You got no right to tell me what to do!" and took a bladed stance, clenching his fists. I issued several direct verbal commands for S to relax and comply. S ignored my commands and attempted to push past me. Fearing S would assault me or flee into the street, I grabbed his right arm to prevent his movement and informed him he was under arrest.

S immediately tensed up, pulling his arm away violently and attempting to spin out of my grasp. He continued to yell and actively resist. Due to his active resistance and refusal to comply, I performed a controlled takedown, bringing S to the ground in a prone position. S continued to struggle, attempting to push himself up and tuck his hands beneath his body. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted. We applied pressure to his upper back and delivered two closed-fist strikes to his left deltoid muscle to gain compliance. After approximately 10-15 seconds of active resistance, we were able to secure S's hands behind his back in handcuffs. S remained verbally abusive but ceased physical resistance once restrained. He was then assisted to his feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle without further incident.

Narrative: On 03/15/24 at approximately 2230 hours, I responded to a report of a highly intoxicated female causing a disturbance at "The Saloon" bar, 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed S (later identified as a 25-year-old White Female) outside the establishment yelling obscenities at patrons and attempting to re-enter the bar after being denied service. I attempted to gain control of S by taking her left arm to escort her away from the entrance. S actively pulled her arm away, tensing her body and attempting to spin around. Due to her active resistance and continued attempts to re-enter the bar, I initiated a controlled takedown to the ground. On the above date and time, I responded with Ofc. On 03/12/2023 at approximately 2330 hours, I responded to a report of a highly intoxicated male causing a disturbance outside "The Local Tap" bar at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a white male, later identified as (A), yelling obscenities at patrons and attempting to block the entrance. Narrative:
On 11/15/23 at approximately 2030 hours, I responded to 789 Maple St, a convenience store, for a report of a male refusing to leave the premises and harassing customers. I repeated my lawful order for (A) to leave the property. (A) refused, taking a step closer to me while clenching his fists. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away forcefully, and spun his body, attempting to create distance. I maintained control of his arm and, with the assistance of Ofc. [NAME], we applied an arm bar control technique to gain compliance. (A) continued to resist by pulling and tensing his muscles, but we were able to bring him to the ground in a controlled manner. Once on the ground, (A) ceased active resistance and was successfully handcuffed without further incident. He continued to be verbally abusive during transport.

On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Elm Street for a report of a male causing a disturbance inside a convenience store, refusing to leave the premises. Upon arrival, I observed a male, later identified as (A), fitting the description, yelling at the store clerk and blocking the exit. I approached (A) and advised him he needed to leave the premises immediately. (A) turned to me, his eyes bloodshot, and stated, "I ain't going nowhere, cop!" and took a step towards me. I gave several verbal commands for (A) to step back and comply with my orders to exit the store. (A) ignored my commands and continued to advance, clenching his fists and raising his voice. Fearing for my safety and the safety of the clerk, I deployed a single drive stun to (A)'s left thigh. The drive stun was ineffective, and (A) ripped the taser from his leg, dropping it to the ground. (A) then lunged at me, attempting to push past. I initiated a take-down maneuver, bringing (A) to the ground. (A) continued to struggle vigorously, flailing his arms and kicking his legs while on the ground. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted by securing (A)'s legs. I delivered two open-hand strikes to (A)'s upper back to gain compliance. After the strikes, (A) ceased resisting enough for Ofc. He continued to be verbally abusive but did not physically resist further.

Narrative: On 03/15/2023 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded to 123 Elm Street for a welfare check on an elderly male, later identified as (A), reported by a neighbor to be yelling incoherently inside his residence. Upon arrival, I made contact with (A) at his front door. (A) immediately became agitated, yelling "Get off my property!" and refusing to answer questions regarding his well-being. He appeared disheveled and smelled strongly of alcohol. I attempted to explain the reason for our presence and requested he step outside to speak with us. (A) refused, attempting to close the door. Fearing for his safety given the initial report and his current state, Ofc. [NAME] and I prevented the door from closing. (A) then pushed against the door, attempting to force it shut, and yelled "You're not coming in!" I gave multiple verbal commands for (A) to step back and comply. When he continued to push, Ofc. [NAME] applied an open-hand push to (A)'s chest to create distance and prevent the door from slamming on an officer. (A) stumbled backward but continued to be verbally combative, clenching his fists. I then grabbed (A)'s left arm in an escort hold to guide him outside. (A) tensed his arm and pulled away sharply. Ofc. Narrative:
On 03/15/2023 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded to a report of a highly intoxicated female causing a disturbance in Veterans Park. Upon arrival, I observed a female, later identified as (A), sitting on a park bench, yelling profanities at nearby families and attempting to drink from an open container of alcohol. Her speech was heavily slurred, and she appeared disoriented and unsteady. I approached (A) and attempted to engage her, asking for her name and if she needed assistance. (A) immediately became verbally aggressive, stating "Leave me alone, you pigs!" and refused to provide any identification. Due to her level of intoxication and disruptive behavior in a public space, I determined she was a danger to herself and others and informed her she was being taken into protective custody. As I attempted to assist (A) to her feet, she tensed her entire body, pulled her arms away, and attempted a low kick towards my shin. Ofc. [NAME] moved to assist, and we utilized a modified escort hold to gain control of her arms. (A) continued to resist by pulling against our grip and attempting to twist away, repeatedly yelling "Don't touch me!" We maintained control and, after a brief struggle, were able to guide her to the patrol vehicle. She continued to brace her feet and resist entering the rear passenger compartment, requiring Ofc. [NAME] and I to physically lift and place her inside. She was then transported to the detoxification center.

On the above date and time, I responded to a report of a disorderly male refusing to leave the Public Library at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a male, later identified as S, approximately 60 years old, yelling loudly at library staff near the circulation desk. S was gesturing erratically and appeared highly agitated. I approached S and identified myself, giving verbal orders to calm down and step away from the staff. S immediately turned his aggression towards me, stating, "I ain't going anywhere, you can't kick me out!" He then clenched his fists and took a step towards me.

Due to S's aggressive posture and refusal to comply, I advised him he was under arrest for disorderly conduct and attempted to take his left arm to place him in handcuffs. S immediately tensed his body, pulled his arm away forcefully, and spun to face Ofc. [NAME], who was assisting. Fearing S might attempt to strike or further resist, Ofc. [NAME] delivered a controlled, open-hand push to S's upper chest, causing S to stumble backward and lean against a nearby display. I then secured S's left arm in a bent armbar technique, while Ofc. [NAME] secured his right arm. S continued to pull and tense his muscles, yelling obscenities and refusing to bring his hands behind his back. After several verbal commands to stop resisting and a brief struggle, officers were able to gain control and secure S's hands in handcuffs. S continued to be verbally abusive but was physically compliant once restrained. S complained of minor wrist discomfort but refused medical attention.

On the above date and time, I responded to a call for a suspicious male, later identified as S, loitering in front of 45 Elm St, an area known for drug activity. Upon my arrival, S, who matched the provided description, made direct eye contact with my marked patrol unit and immediately turned, accelerating his pace away from the scene. I exited my vehicle and gave verbal commands for S to stop and identify himself. S ignored these commands and broke into a full sprint down Elm St. I initiated a foot pursuit.

S attempted to scale a chain-link fence at the rear of 47 Elm St. As he was attempting to clear the fence, I was able to close the distance and grab S by his left leg, pulling him back to the ground. S immediately rolled onto his stomach and began actively resisting, pulling his arms underneath him and tensing his body. I gave multiple verbal commands to "Stop resisting!" and "Show me your hands!" S continued to pull away and attempted to push himself up. Due to S's active resistance and attempts to regain his feet, I delivered two closed-fist strikes to S's upper back, which had a limited effect. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted, applying pressure to S's lower back. We were eventually able to gain control of S's arms and secure him in handcuffs. S remained verbally defiant, yelling profanities, but ceased physical resistance once handcuffed. He was then escorted to my patrol vehicle.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 14:30 hours, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to a report of a disorderly person refusing to leave the public library at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, we observed a female, later identified as (A), standing near the entrance, yelling obscenities at staff and patrons. Narrative:

Narrative: On 03/15/24 at approximately 1930 hours, I responded to a retail theft in progress at MegaMart, 123 Main St. Dispatch advised a white female, approximately 18-20 years old, wearing a red hoodie and jeans, was seen exiting the store with unpaid merchandise and last seen heading towards the rear parking lot. Narrative:

(S) refused, stating, "You can't make me do shit!" and took a step towards me in an aggressive manner, clenching his fists.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 1430 hours, I responded to the Stop & Shop at 123 Main St for a report of a disorderly male refusing to leave the premises. On 07/12/2023 at approximately 0230 hours, I responded to a 911 call regarding a suspicious male (S) attempting to open car doors in the area of 456 Oak Ave. Upon arrival, I observed S, later identified as [Subject's Name], DOB [Subject's DOB], pulling on the door handle of a parked sedan. Narrative: On 11/15/23 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded to a report of a disorderly male refusing to leave the premises of the 'Corner Pocket Pub' at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a White male, later identified as (A), standing near the entrance, yelling obscenities at the bouncer. (A) immediately turned towards me, stating "I ain't going anywhere, you can't make me!" and clenched his fists. I gave several clear verbal commands for (A) to calm down and comply with my orders to step outside.

(A) ignored my commands and attempted to re-enter the pub. Fearing he would cause further disturbance or potential harm to patrons, I placed my hand on (A)'s left arm to guide him out. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away forcefully, and spun around, pushing me slightly in the chest with both hands. Due to (A)'s physical resistance and assaultive behavior, I initiated an arm bar control technique on his left arm while simultaneously stepping back to create distance. (A) continued to resist, attempting to pull free and verbally threatening me. Ofc. [NAME] arrived on scene and assisted. We were able to gain control of (A)'s arms and, after a brief struggle where (A) continued to brace and pull away, we guided him to the ground in a controlled manner. Once on the ground, (A) complied with orders to place his hands behind his back and was successfully handcuffed without further incident. (A) was then assisted to his feet and escorted to my patrol vehicle.

On the above date and time, I responded to 456 Elm Street for a report of a male causing a disturbance, yelling at customers outside a convenience store. Upon arrival, I observed S (later identified as [Name], DOB [DOB]) standing in front of the store, shouting profanities and gesturing wildly. I exited my patrol vehicle and ordered S to stop yelling and approach me. S ignored my commands, turned towards me, and began to advance while continuing to shout aggressively, "I ain't going anywhere!"

I gave repeated verbal commands for S to stop and place his hands behind his back. S refused, stating, "I ain't doing shit!" and clenched his fists, taking a bladed stance. After several verbal commands and continued struggle, I applied two short bursts of OC spray to S's face. S then ceased resistance, allowing us to secure his hands in handcuffs. S was then placed in the rear of my patrol vehicle.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2215 hrs, I responded to the report of a disorderly female refusing to leave O'[NAME]'s Pub at 45 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a female, later identified as (S) [Race=WHITE, Sex=FEMALE, Age=31], standing near the bar, yelling loudly at the bartender. Narrative:

Narrative: On 03/15/2023 at approximately 22:15 hours, I responded to 789 Elm St for a report of a domestic disturbance. Upon arrival, I made contact with the complainant, who stated her 42-year-old mother, Ms. [NAME] (A), was intoxicated and refusing to leave the residence after an argument. I observed Ms. [NAME] standing in the doorway, yelling obscenities and visibly agitated. I attempted to speak with Ms. [NAME], explaining the complaint and advising her she needed to either calm down or leave the premises for the night. Ms. [NAME] refused, stating "I live here, I'm not going anywhere" and attempted to push past me to re-enter the house. I placed my hand on her arm to prevent her from re-entering, at which point she pulled her arm away aggressively and yelled "Don't touch me!". Due to her continued non-compliance, aggressive behavior, and potential for further disturbance, I informed Ms. [NAME] she was under arrest for disorderly conduct. As I attempted to secure her left arm, Ms. [NAME] tensed up, pulling away and attempting to twist her body. Ofc. [NAME] assisted by securing her right arm. We maintained control of Ms. [NAME]'s arms and, after a brief struggle where she continued to tense and resist, we were able to bring her hands behind her back and apply handcuffs. Ms. [NAME] continued to verbally protest but ceased physical resistance once handcuffed. She was then escorted to the patrol vehicle without further incident.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to 123 Maple St. for a report of a domestic disturbance where the caller stated her husband, later identified as (A), was heavily intoxicated and throwing furniture. Upon arrival, I made contact with the caller outside who confirmed (A) was still inside and agitated. As I entered the residence, I observed (A) in the living room, yelling into a disconnected phone. I verbally identified myself as police and ordered (A) to stop yelling and place his hands where I could see them. (A) immediately turned towards me, clenched his fists, and shouted, "Get out of my house! You have no right!" He took a step forward, ignoring repeated commands to stop and calm down. Due to his aggressive posture, intoxication, and refusal to comply, I perceived an imminent threat of assault.

I initiated a push-pull technique to create distance and gain control. (A) actively resisted, pulling away and attempting to swing his right arm towards me. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted. We utilized a joint manipulation technique on (A)'s left arm, guiding him to the ground in a controlled manner. On the ground, (A) continued to tense his body and pull his arms away, attempting to prevent handcuffing. After several verbal commands to stop resisting, Ofc. [NAME] applied a drive stun with his taser to (A)'s lower back. The taser application was effective, allowing us to secure (A)'s hands in handcuffs without further incident. (A) continued to be verbally abusive but ceased physical resistance. He was then escorted out of the residence.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 19:15 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to 123 Elm Street for a welfare check requested by a neighbor, reporting a female screaming inside the residence. Upon arrival, we heard a female voice yelling obscenities. We knocked and announced our presence. The door was opened by a female, later identified as (A), a 47-year-old white female. (A) immediately became agitated, slurring her words and smelling strongly of alcohol. She yelled, "Get off my property, I didn't call you!" and attempted to slam the door. Ofc. [NAME] placed his foot to prevent the door from closing, fearing for (A)'s safety given the initial report. (A) then pushed against the door, trying to force it shut, and began flailing her arms. I gave multiple verbal commands for (A) to step back and calm down. (A) ignored commands, yelling, "You can't touch me!" and swung her right arm, striking Ofc. [NAME] chest. At this point, I grabbed (A)'s right wrist and Ofc. [NAME] secured her left arm to prevent further assault. (A) continued to pull away, actively resisting our attempts to control her. Due to her continued resistance and assaultive behavior, I initiated a straight armbar takedown to bring (A) to the ground. (A) landed on her side and continued to struggle, kicking her legs. Ofc. [NAME] and I were able to secure her wrists in handcuffs after a brief struggle on the ground. (A) remained verbally uncooperative but stopped physical resistance once handcuffed. She was then assisted to her feet and transported to the precinct for booking on charges of assault and resisting arrest.

On 03/15/2024 at approximately 2330 hours, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to a report of a disorderly male at "The Saloon" bar, 123 Main St. Upon arrival, we were directed to (A), later identified as [NAME] [NAME], M/W, DOB: 01/01/1995, who was actively yelling at the bartender and refusing to leave after being cut off from service. I approached (A) and verbally instructed him to calm down and exit the establishment. (A) ignored my commands, turned towards me, and began yelling obscenities, stating, "I'm not going anywhere, you pigs!" Ofc. [NAME] and I attempted to escort (A) out by taking hold of his arms.
