Due to (A)'s active resistance and aggressive posture, I delivered a single open-hand strike to (A)'s left shoulder to create separation and gain control. This allowed Ofc. [NAME] to secure (A)'s right arm while I secured his left. (A) continued to struggle, twisting and kicking his feet, attempting to break free. We then initiated a controlled takedown to the ground to prevent further escalation and ensure officer safety. On the ground, (A) continued to actively resist handcuffing by tucking his hands under his chest. After several verbal commands to show his hands, Ofc. [NAME] applied pressure to (A)'s upper back while I was able to pry his left hand free and secure it in a handcuff. We then secured his right hand. (A) was then assisted to his feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle without further physical resistance.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 23:10 hours, I responded to a report of a suspicious male loitering near the playground area of Elmwood Park, which is closed after dusk. We delivered several knee strikes to (A)'s side and applied pressure point control to his neck to gain compliance. After several seconds, (A) screamed in pain and finally complied, allowing Ofc. [NAME] to secure his left wrist. I then secured his right wrist, placing him in handcuffs. (A) was then assisted to his feet and escorted to my patrol vehicle for transport. He was charged with trespassing and resisting arrest.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2030 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to a residence on Maple Street for a report of a disturbance. Narrative:

Narrative: On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Elm St for a report of a suspicious person peering into vehicles. Fearing S was preparing to assault me, I initiated a control hold on S's left arm. S actively resisted, tensing his body and attempting to pull away. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted. [NAME] delivered a knee strike to S's thigh, which had limited effect. I then utilized a straight arm bar takedown, bringing S to the ground. S then complied, extending his hands, and we were able to secure him in handcuffs. S continued to verbally protest but ceased physical resistance.

Narrative: On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Main St for a report of a male causing a disturbance, yelling at passersby. Narrative:

On 11/15/2023 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded to 789 Elm St regarding a domestic disturbance. We issued multiple verbal commands for S to place his hands behind his back. S continued to yell "Don't touch me!" and kept his hands clenched by his sides. Fearing he might strike an officer or flee, I grabbed S's left arm and Ofc. [NAME] secured his right. S actively resisted by pulling, twisting, and attempting to break our grip. We utilized a controlled take-down to bring S to the ground, where he continued to struggle, tucking his arms underneath his body. After several more verbal commands and a brief struggle, we were able to pry his hands free and secure him in handcuffs. S was then escorted to the patrol vehicle for transport.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to 45 Elm Street for a report of a highly intoxicated female causing a disturbance outside a residence. Upon arrival, I observed a white female, later identified as (A), sitting on the curb, yelling obscenities at passersby and refusing to move. (A) appeared heavily intoxicated, slurring her words and swaying. I approached (A) and attempted to engage her in conversation, advising her of the complaints and offering assistance. (A) immediately became agitated, yelling "I'm not going anywhere, leave me alone!" and attempting to stand up erratically.

Due to her level of intoxication and inability to care for herself, I determined (A) needed to be transported for evaluation. I gave repeated verbal commands for (A) to place her hands behind her back. (A) refused, tensing her body and pulling her arms away. When I attempted to guide her arms, (A) actively resisted, pulling away violently and kicking her legs. Ofc. [NAME] arrived to assist. We attempted a standing wristlock to gain control, but (A) continued to struggle, twisting her body. After several attempts, Ofc. [NAME] and I executed a controlled takedown to the ground. (A) continued to thrash and tuck her hands under her body, preventing handcuffing. I delivered two open-hand strikes to (A)'s left deltoid, which allowed Ofc. [NAME] to secure her left wrist. We then applied handcuffs without further incident. (A) was then assisted to her feet and transported to County Detox.

Narrative:
On 11/15/23 at approximately 1930 hours, I responded to 123 Main St (Convenience Store) for a report of a disturbance. Dispatch advised a female, later identified as (S), was refusing to leave the premises after being asked by management. Upon arrival, I observed (S), a 25-year-old Black female, standing near the counter, yelling at the store clerk. I approached (S) and attempted to de-escalate the situation, advising her that she needed to leave the private property or she would be trespassed. (S) turned her attention to me, yelling "I ain't going anywhere, you can't make me!" and began to walk away, further into the store. I gave multiple verbal commands for (S) to stop and exit the store, which she ignored. As I attempted to guide (S) towards the exit by placing my hand on her upper arm, she immediately tensed up and pulled away violently, swinging her arm back towards me. Fearing a strike, I initiated a control hold on (S)'s left arm. (S) continued to pull away, twisting her body and attempting to break free. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted, taking control of (S)'s right arm. We gave repeated commands for (S) to stop resisting and place her hands behind her back. (S) continued to thrash and kick her legs. Due to her active resistance, I delivered two short, controlled strikes to (S)'s left thigh to gain compliance. This allowed Ofc. [NAME] and I to bring (S) to the ground and successfully apply handcuffs. (S) continued to yell and struggle verbally even after being cuffed but ceased physical resistance. She was then escorted to the patrol vehicle.

Narrative: On 03/15/2023 at approximately 1430 hours, I responded to a report of a disoriented female walking in the roadway near the intersection of Elm St and Oak Ave. Upon arrival, I observed a white female, later identified as (A), Age 52, matching the description, attempting to step into active traffic. I approached (A) and attempted to engage her verbally, asking if she was okay and needed assistance. (A) appeared confused, mumbled incoherently, and attempted to walk past me into the street. I extended my arm to gently guide her away from traffic, at which point (A) tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and began yelling, "Don't touch me!" and "Leave me alone!" as she tried to dart into the lane of oncoming vehicles.

Fearing for her safety and the safety of motorists, I applied a wrist control hold to (A)'s left arm while Ofc. [NAME] secured her right arm. (A) actively resisted, pulling, twisting, and kicking her legs, attempting to break free and re-enter the roadway. Due to her continued active resistance and immediate danger, Ofc. [NAME] and I performed a controlled takedown to the ground. (A) continued to struggle on the ground, flailing her arms and legs, making it difficult to secure her hands. After several verbal commands to stop resisting, Ofc. [NAME] was able to secure (A)'s right wrist, and I secured her left wrist in handcuffs. She was then assisted to a seated position and evaluated by EMS.

On the above date and time, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to a welfare check at 123 Elm St. The reporting party, (A)'s daughter, stated her 62-year-old mother, (A), had been disoriented and uncommunicative for two days. Upon arrival, we observed (A) through a window, appearing confused and disheveled. After receiving a key from the daughter, we made entry, announcing our presence. (A) was located in the living room and immediately became agitated, yelling, "Get out of my house! You're not real police!"

We attempted to calm (A) and explain we were there to help, but she refused to listen, picking up a decorative plate and throwing it in our general direction, narrowly missing Ofc. [NAME]. (A) then lunged towards the hallway, flailing her arms and attempting to push past Ofc. [NAME]. To prevent further escalation and ensure her safety, Ofc. [NAME] applied an escort hold to (A)'s left arm. (A) actively resisted, pulling away, twisting her body, and kicking at our shins. I assisted by securing her right arm. Due to her continued active resistance and the risk of her falling or injuring herself, we performed a controlled seated take-down to a nearby chair, and secured her wrists with handcuffs. (A) continued to yell but ceased physical resistance. EMS was then called to evaluate (A) for medical and mental health concerns.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 1930 hours, I responded to 123 Elm Street for a welfare check on an elderly male, later identified as (A), who was reported by a neighbor to be yelling obscenities and throwing objects inside his residence. Upon arrival, I heard loud shouting coming from inside the residence. I knocked on the front door, announcing "Police!" several times. After a delay, (A) opened the door, appearing disheveled and smelling strongly of alcohol. His eyes were bloodshot, and he was visibly agitated.

I explained the reason for our presence and asked if he was alright. (A) immediately became defensive, yelling "Get off my property! I haven't done anything!" He attempted to slam the door shut. To prevent this, I placed my foot in the doorway. (A) then lunged forward, pushing against the door with both hands, attempting to force it closed and strike my foot. I gave verbal commands to "Stop resisting!" and "Step back!" which he ignored. Due to his aggressive behavior and the strong odor of alcohol, I determined it was necessary to secure (A) for his safety and ours.

I reached out and grabbed (A)'s left arm to gain control. (A) tensed up, pulling away violently, and began flailing his arms, attempting to strike me. Ofc. [NAME] arrived to assist. As I maintained control of (A)'s left arm, Ofc. [NAME] secured his right arm. (A) continued to struggle, yelling and twisting his body. We utilized a joint escort hold to move (A) away from the doorway and create space. He actively resisted being moved, digging his heels into the floor and attempting to pull free. We eventually managed to turn him around and brought him to the ground in a controlled manner, where he continued to tense his body and verbally resist handcuffing.

On the above date and time, I responded to 456 Elm St. for a 911 call reporting a male aggressively banging on a door and yelling. Upon arrival, I observed a male, later identified as S, matching the description, attempting to force open the front door of the residence. I gave S verbal commands to step away from the door and show me his hands. S ignored my commands, continued to pull on the door handle, and began yelling obscenities at me, stating, "Get out of my face!"

As I approached S to gain compliance, he suddenly turned towards me, tensing his body and clenching his fists in an aggressive posture. Fearing an imminent assault, I attempted to create distance while giving further commands to calm down. S then lunged forward, attempting to push past me. I utilized a two-hand push to S's chest to prevent him from advancing further into the residence. S continued to struggle, actively resisting my attempts to control him. Ofc. [NAME] arrived on scene and assisted. S continued to pull away, swinging his arms wildly. To prevent further escalation and ensure officer safety, I delivered a single open-hand strike to S's upper shoulder area. This created a momentary opening, allowing Ofc. [NAME] and I to secure S's arms and place him into handcuffs. S continued to be verbally abusive but ceased physical resistance once restrained.

On the above date and time, I responded to a report of a disoriented elderly female refusing to leave the premises of "The Corner Store" at 123 Main St after closing. Upon arrival, I observed S, a 65-year-old Black female, standing in the aisle, appearing agitated and confused. The store manager stated S had been asked to leave multiple times but refused. I attempted to engage S verbally, explaining the store was closed and she needed to exit. S responded by yelling, "I live here! You can't make me leave!" and began to walk further into the store, away from the exit.

As S ignored repeated commands, Ofc. [NAME] and I approached to guide her out. Ofc. [NAME] gently placed a hand on S's arm to direct her towards the door. S immediately tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and spun around, pushing Ofc. [NAME] hand away while shouting, "Get your hands off me!" S then attempted to strike Ofc. [NAME] arm with her purse. Due to S's active resistance and attempted assault, Ofc. [NAME] and I applied a joint control hold to S's arms to prevent further aggression and facilitate her removal. S continued to resist by tensing her body and pulling away, requiring a controlled escort out of the building. She was then safely secured in the rear of my patrol vehicle for transport and further evaluation.

Narrative: On the above date and time, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to 123 Main St. for a report of a male refusing to leave the front of a convenience store and harassing customers. Upon arrival, we observed a Black male, later identified as S, fitting the description, standing near the entrance, yelling obscenities at passersby. S appeared heavily intoxicated. We approached S and identified ourselves as police. We gave multiple verbal commands for S to cease his behavior and leave the property. S ignored our commands, instead turning towards us and stating, "I ain't going anywhere, you can't make me." His voice was raised, and he was visibly agitated. Due to his continued disorderly conduct and refusal to comply, we informed S he was under arrest.

When Ofc. [NAME] attempted to take hold of S's left arm, S immediately tensed his body and pulled his arm away, stating "Don't touch me!" I then attempted to secure S's right arm. S continued to pull away, stiffening his entire body and actively resisting our attempts to gain control of his arms. We instructed S to stop resisting and place his hands behind his back. S continued to pull and twist, attempting to break free from our grasp. Due to his active resistance and refusal to comply, I delivered a single open-hand strike to S's left shoulder blade to create a momentary distraction and facilitate handcuffing. This strike had a limited effect, and S continued to brace against us. Ofc. [NAME] then utilized a controlled takedown, bringing S to the ground onto his stomach. While on the ground, S continued to tense his body and tuck his hands beneath him. After repeated verbal commands, Ofc. [NAME] was able to secure S's left wrist, and I secured his right. Handcuffs were applied without further incident.

Narrative: On the above date and time, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to 456 Elm St. for a welfare check on a male reportedly yelling at passersby and refusing to leave the sidewalk after being asked by property owners. Upon arrival, we observed S (later identified as [Name], Age 54, Race Black, Male) standing on the sidewalk, actively yelling obscenities at an unoccupied vehicle.

I approached S and attempted to engage him in conversation, giving verbal orders to calm down and explain the situation. S ignored my commands, instead turning his aggressive posture towards Ofc. [NAME] and me, stating, "I ain't doing nothing wrong, leave me alone!" He continued to yell, his voice escalating. After several attempts to de-escalate and gain compliance, S remained verbally abusive and refused to provide identification or move from the private property entrance he was obstructing. Due to his continued disorderly conduct and refusal to comply, I informed S he was under arrest.

As I attempted to secure S's left arm to place him in handcuffs, S immediately tensed his entire body, pulled his arm away forcefully, and stepped back, creating distance. He then balled his fists and took a bladed stance, repeating, "Don't touch me!" Fearing S was preparing to physically resist or assault, Ofc. [NAME] simultaneously moved to secure S's right arm. S continued to resist by pulling away and attempting to twist his body. I performed an arm bar technique on S's left arm while Ofc. [NAME] maintained control of his right. We were able to bring S to the ground in a controlled manner. On the ground, S continued to tense and tuck his hands under his body, preventing handcuffing. After repeated verbal commands to show his hands, Ofc. [NAME] applied two closed-fist strikes to S's left rib area, which caused S to release his arm. We then successfully secured S in handcuffs. S continued to verbally protest but ceased physical resistance and was assisted to his feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle without further incident.

Narrative: On the above date and time, I responded to a 911 call regarding a male, later identified as S, causing a disturbance outside "The Corner Pub," yelling at patrons and refusing to leave. Upon arrival, I observed S, a Black male, approximately 44 years of age, actively yelling obscenities at individuals attempting to enter the establishment. I approached S, identified myself, and gave lawful orders to cease the disturbance and leave the property.

S turned towards me, eyes appearing bloodshot and glazed, clenching his fists and stating loudly, "I ain't going anywhere, pig!" S then took a deliberate step towards me, ignoring my commands to stop. Perceiving S as an immediate threat due to his aggressive posture and refusal to comply, I unholstered my agency-issued taser, issuing loud verbal commands: "Stop! Get on the ground! Taser! Taser!"

S continued to advance, ignoring all commands. I deployed the taser probes, striking S in the torso area. S immediately yelled and fell to the ground, appearing momentarily incapacitated. While S was affected by the taser cycle, Ofc. [NAME] moved in to secure S's hands. S continued to tense his body and attempt to pull his arms away even after the taser cycle ended. Ofc. [NAME] applied a wristlock, and with my assistance, we were able to successfully handcuff S. S remained verbally abusive and continued to struggle against our control, requiring a firm escort to the patrol vehicle.

On the above date and time, I responded to a report of a disorderly male refusing to leave "The Salty Dog" pub. Upon arrival, I observed S, an older white male, highly intoxicated and yelling at the bartender. S was swaying, slurring his words, and repeatedly stating, "I ain't going anywhere!" when asked to exit the establishment.

I attempted to engage S verbally, asking him to calm down and step outside. S ignored my commands, instead squaring his shoulders towards me, clenching his fists, and taking a small step forward. He then loudly stated, "You ain't touching me, copper!" His aggressive posture and refusal to comply led me to believe he was preparing to physically resist or attempt an assault.

Fearing for my safety and needing to gain control of the situation, I drew my department-issued Taser and presented it, aiming it at S's center mass. I issued a loud, clear command: "POLICE! Get on the ground now, or you will be TASED!" The immediate sight of the Taser and the direct verbal threat of deployment caused S to freeze. His clenched fists relaxed, and he slowly raised his hands. Ofc. [NAME] arrived as backup at this point. With Ofc. [NAME] providing cover, I was able to safely secure S in handcuffs without further physical resistance. S remained verbally uncooperative but complied with physical directions after the Taser presentation. He was transported to the precinct for booking on charges of Disorderly Conduct and Resisting Arrest.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 1430 hours, I responded to 700 Maple Street for a welfare check on an elderly female reportedly disoriented and blocking the sidewalk. Upon arrival, I observed a Black female, later identified as (A), age 63, sitting on a public bench but partially obstructing the pedestrian path, appearing confused and disheveled. I attempted to engage (A) verbally, asking if she needed assistance and requesting her to move to a safer location. (A) responded by mumbling incoherently and refused to acknowledge my requests, staring blankly ahead. After repeated attempts to gain her compliance, I advised (A) that she needed to move and that I would assist her. As I gently took her arm to guide her, (A) immediately tensed up, pulled her arm away, and began yelling, "Don't touch me!" and flailing her arms, nearly striking me. Fearing she might fall or injure herself/others, and due to her continued obstruction and agitated state, Ofc. [NAME] and I decided to physically escort her to the patrol vehicle for transport to a medical facility. (A) continued to verbally protest and resist by stiffening her body as we placed her into the rear passenger seat. She was transported to St. Jude's for evaluation.

Narrative:
On 11/15/23 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to the area of 400 Elm Street for a report of a loud disturbance and individuals loitering in front of a closed business. I instructed (A) to provide identification, explaining the loitering complaint. I advised (A) that she was being detained for investigation and stepped in front of her to prevent her departure. Due to her active resistance and refusal to comply, I utilized a wristlock control technique to secure her left arm. We then guided (A) to the ground in a controlled manner, where she continued to tense and resist. After several verbal commands to "Stop resisting!" and "Hands behind your back!", we were able to apply handcuffs. (A) was then assisted to her feet and transported to the precinct.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to a report of a disorderly male outside "The Taproom" at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a White male, later identified as (S), age 47, yelling obscenities at patrons attempting to enter the establishment. (S) appeared heavily intoxicated, swaying and slurring his words. I approached (S) and attempted to engage him verbally, advising him to calm down and leave the area. (S) immediately became confrontational, yelling "I ain't going nowhere!" and stepping aggressively towards me.

I gave multiple verbal commands for (S) to stop and put his hands behind his back. (S) ignored these commands, clenched his fists, and adopted a fighting stance, stating, "You ain't touching me!" Fearing for my safety and the safety of the public, I initiated a control hold, attempting to secure (S)'s right arm. Due to his continued resistance and aggressive posture, I performed a straight arm bar takedown to bring (S) to the ground. (S) landed on his side and continued to struggle, tucking his arms underneath his body to prevent handcuffing. Ofc. [NAME] arrived on scene and assisted. We utilized joint manipulation to gain control of (S)'s arms, and he was subsequently handcuffed in the prone position. (S) continued to yell and spit as he was escorted to the patrol vehicle.

Narrative: On 03/15/2023 at approximately 2030 hrs, I responded to the Corner Pub located at 123 Main St for a report of a disorderly male refusing to leave. Upon arrival, I observed S, later identified as [Subject's Name], W/M, Age 54, yelling at patrons near the entrance. S appeared heavily intoxicated with slurred speech and was unsteady on his feet. S immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away, and pushed me in the chest with both hands. Ofc. [NAME] then assisted, and we attempted a controlled takedown to the ground. S resisted by pulling his arms in and kicking his legs, refusing to go to the ground. After several verbal commands to stop resisting, Ofc. Narrative:

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 2230 hours, I responded to 123 Main St for a report of a highly intoxicated male refusing to leave the residence. Upon arrival, I made contact with the caller who stated her husband, later identified as S (White/Male/50), was yelling, breaking items, and refused to calm down or leave. Narrative: On 06/15/2024 at approximately 2230 hours, I was on proactive patrol in the area of 123 Main St, known for high drug activity and loitering complaints. I initiated a foot pursuit, continuously ordering S to stop. After approximately 50 yards, S stumbled near a dumpster. I closed the distance and attempted a controlled takedown by grabbing S's left arm and guiding him to the ground. S actively resisted the takedown, pulling his arm away violently and trying to regain his footing. While on the ground, S continued to struggle, tucking his arms underneath his body and refusing to present them for handcuffing despite multiple verbal commands to "Stop resisting" and "Show me your hands." Ofc. [NAME] arrived on scene and assisted. S continued to tense his body and actively fight our attempts to gain control. On 07/15/23 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to 1420 Elm St regarding a report of a male refusing to leave a private residence after being asked by the homeowner. Narrative:

On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Maple Ave for a report of a disturbance involving an intoxicated male refusing to leave the property. On 11/15/23 at approximately 23:10 hours, I responded to 789 Oak Street for a report of a loud disturbance. Upon arrival, I observed a female, later identified as S, standing on the porch yelling into the residence. S appeared highly agitated, pacing and gesturing wildly. I attempted to make contact with S and explain the nature of my call. S immediately turned her aggression towards me, yelling "I ain't doing shit!" and refusing to lower her voice. I gave S multiple verbal commands to calm down and step away from the door. S ignored my commands, instead attempting to push past me to re-enter the residence. Fearing S would continue the disturbance or potentially arm herself, I grabbed S's right arm to prevent her entry and create distance. S immediately tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and spun around, attempting to strike me with her free hand. Ofc. [NAME] then assisted by securing S's left arm. S continued to resist, pulling her arms and kicking her legs. We initiated a controlled takedown to the ground. S continued to struggle, yelling obscenities, but we were able to gain control and apply handcuffs behind her back. S remained verbally defiant and refused to walk independently to the patrol vehicle, requiring Ofc. [NAME] and I to assist her.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded to the area of 45 Main St. for a report of a highly intoxicated female yelling at passersby and refusing to leave the entrance of a convenience store. Upon arrival, I observed a White female, later identified as (A), standing near the entrance, visibly unsteady on her feet and shouting obscenities at individuals entering and exiting the store. I approached (A) and attempted to engage her in conversation, asking her name and if she needed medical assistance. (A) immediately became agitated, yelling "Leave me alone, I haven't done anything!" and refusing to provide identification or cooperate.

Due to her level of intoxication and disruptive behavior, I informed (A) that she was being placed under arrest for public intoxication and disorderly conduct. I gave verbal commands for her to place her hands behind her back. (A) refused, tensing her body and pulling her arms close to her chest. I then attempted to gain control of (A)'s left arm to apply handcuffs. (A) actively resisted by pulling away forcefully and bracing her body against the wall of the building. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted. We utilized a joint manipulation technique to gain control of (A)'s left arm. (A) continued to struggle, twisting her body and kicking her feet. After several verbal commands to stop resisting, Ofc. [NAME] and I performed a controlled take-down to the ground to safely secure her hands. (A) continued to resist on the ground by attempting to push up with her legs and yelling. Once on the ground, we were able to successfully apply handcuffs without further incident. (A) was then assisted to her feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle.

Narrative: On 11/15/23 at approximately 2310 hours, I responded to 123 Main St for a report of an intoxicated male causing a disturbance outside "The Local Tap". Upon arrival, I observed a white male, later identified as (A), standing in the doorway of the establishment, yelling obscenities at patrons and refusing to leave. (A) appeared heavily intoxicated, swaying and slurring his words. I approached (A) and attempted to engage him in conversation, advising him he needed to leave the premises or face arrest for trespassing. (A) immediately became agitated, turned towards me, and yelled, "I ain't going anywhere, pig!" He then clenched his fists and took a step forward in an aggressive manner. I gave multiple verbal commands for (A) to step back and place his hands behind his back. (A) refused, stating, "Make me!" and continued to advance towards me. Fearing for my safety and the safety of patrons, I deployed a short burst of OC spray towards (A)'s face. The spray made immediate contact, causing (A) to recoil, drop to his knees, and begin coughing. Ofc. [NAME] then moved in and secured (A)'s hands behind his back without further resistance. (A) continued to cough and complain of burning eyes but complied with handcuffing procedures. He was then escorted to my patrol vehicle for transport.

Narrative:
On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Main St for an unwanted person call. The caller stated a male, later identified as (A), refused to leave their property and was yelling. Upon arrival, I observed (A) standing on the porch, visibly agitated, yelling obscenities at the homeowner. I approached (A) and advised him of the complaint. I gave lawful orders for (A) to cease yelling and to leave the property. (A) refused, stating "I ain't going nowhere" and continued to yell. (A) then squared his shoulders towards me, clenched his fists, and took a step forward in an aggressive manner, stating "You ain't making me leave." Fearing (A) was preparing to assault me, I advised (A) he was under arrest. As I attempted to take physical control of (A)'s left arm, (A) tensed up, pulled his arm away, and attempted to push me back. (A) continued to resist by pulling and twisting his body, refusing to allow me to secure his arm for handcuffing. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted. We utilized a joint manipulation technique on (A)'s left arm, and after a brief struggle, were able to rotate him to the ground in a controlled manner, where he continued to tuck his hands underneath his chest. After several verbal commands to show his hands, Ofc. [NAME] applied pressure to (A)'s shoulder blade area. This allowed me to secure (A)'s left wrist in handcuffs. The right wrist was then secured without further incident. (A) was then assisted to his feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle. He remained verbally uncooperative but did not physically resist further.

Narrative:
On 11/15/23 at approximately 2230 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to 123 Main St. regarding a highly intoxicated male, later identified as (A), refusing to leave "The Corner Pub." Upon arrival, we observed (A) standing near the bar, yelling loudly at the bartender, his face flushed and speech slurred. We approached (A) and advised him he needed to leave the premises. (A) turned to us, stating, "I ain't going anywhere, you pigs!" and clenched his fists. I gave multiple verbal commands for (A) to calm down and step outside. (A) ignored these commands, instead attempting to push past Ofc. [NAME] to re-engage the bartender. At this point, I grabbed (A)'s left arm to guide him towards the exit. (A) immediately tensed his body, pulling his arm away forcefully and attempting to spin around towards me. Fearing (A) would strike an officer or continue to escalate, Ofc. [NAME] applied a control hold to (A)'s right arm while I maintained control of his left. (A) continued to struggle, actively pulling and twisting. Due to his continued resistance and attempts to break free, Ofc. [NAME] and I performed a controlled takedown to the floor. (A) landed on his side and continued to resist briefly before we were able to secure his hands behind his back in handcuffs. (A) was then assisted to his feet and escorted out of the establishment without further incident.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2330 hours, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to a report of a disorderly male outside "The Taproom" at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, we observed a white male, later identified as (A), yelling obscenities and attempting to push patrons near the entrance. (A) appeared heavily intoxicated, displaying slurred speech and an unsteady gait. We approached (A) and gave verbal commands to calm down and leave the area. (A) ignored our commands, turning his aggression towards us, yelling "You can't tell me what to do!" and stepping aggressively towards Ofc. [NAME]. Fearing for Ofc. [NAME] safety and to prevent further disturbance, I attempted to take physical control of (A)'s left arm to escort him away. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled his arm free, and attempted to swing his right arm towards my face. I blocked the swing and Ofc. [NAME] simultaneously grabbed (A)'s right arm. (A) continued to resist, thrashing his body and attempting to pull away. Due to (A)'s active resistance and aggressive behavior, I performed a controlled takedown, bringing (A) to the ground in a prone position. (A) continued to struggle on the ground, tucking his hands under his body and kicking his legs. Ofc. [NAME] applied pressure to (A)'s left wrist while I secured his right arm, allowing us to successfully apply handcuffs behind his back. (A) remained verbally uncooperative but ceased physical resistance once handcuffed. He was then escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On the above date and time, I responded to a report of shoplifting at Macy's department store, 123 Main St. Upon arrival, store security pointed out a female, later identified as (A), who matched the suspect description. (A) was observed attempting to exit the store with unpaid merchandise. I approached (A) and identified myself as a police officer, instructing her to stop and return to the loss prevention office for questioning. (A) immediately became verbally agitated, stating, "I didn't do anything, you can't stop me," and attempted to walk past me.

I placed my hand on (A)'s arm to prevent her departure and reiterate my lawful order. (A) pulled her arm away forcefully and continued to try and walk away, tensing her body and verbally refusing to comply with all commands. Due to her active resistance and attempt to flee with stolen property, I initiated a control hold on (A)'s left arm, attempting to guide her towards the wall. (A) actively resisted by pulling away, twisting her body, and shouting. Ofc. [NAME] arrived to assist. With Ofc. [NAME] help, we were able to gain control of (A)'s arms despite her continued struggle and place her in handcuffs. (A) continued to be verbally defiant but ceased physical resistance once handcuffed. She was then escorted to the patrol vehicle without further incident.

On 03/12/2023 at approximately 19:15 hours, I responded with Officer [NAME] to the area of 145 Main Street for a report of a suspicious person, described as a white female, loitering and yelling at passersby. Upon arrival, we observed the subject, later identified as (A), fitting the description. (A) was standing near the bus stop, actively yelling obscenities at no one in particular. As we approached, I attempted to engage (A) verbally, asking her name and if she needed assistance. (A) immediately became defensive, stating 'Leave me alone, I haven't done anything!' and began to walk away quickly, ignoring further commands to stop.

Due to her erratic behavior and the public disturbance, I advised (A) she was being detained for investigation. As I reached for her arm to prevent her from leaving, (A) tensed her body, pulled her arm away forcefully, and spun around, attempting to push me. Officer [NAME] moved to assist, and we both gained control of (A)'s arms. (A) continued to resist by pulling, kicking her legs, and verbally screaming. I delivered a single closed-fist strike to (A)'s right upper thigh to create separation and gain compliance. This allowed Officer [NAME] to secure (A)'s left arm while I secured her right. We then performed a controlled takedown to the ground, where (A) was placed in handcuffs without further incident. She continued to be verbally abusive but ceased physical resistance once restrained.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 0215 hours, I responded to a call for service regarding a male subject loitering and refusing to leave the doorway of 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed S (later identified as a 53-year-old Black male) sitting slumped against the storefront, obstructing the entrance. I made verbal contact, advising S that the business was closed and he needed to vacate the premises. S ignored my initial commands, staring blankly ahead. I repeated my orders, at which point S mumbled incoherently, smelled strongly of alcohol, and refused to stand up.

I then gave S a direct order to stand and provide identification. S responded by yelling "Leave me alone!" and attempting to push himself further into the corner, tensing his body. Due to S's continued non-compliance and resistance to move, Ofc. [NAME] and I attempted to assist S to his feet. As Ofc. [NAME] took S's left arm, S actively pulled away, twisting his body and saying "Don't touch me!" I then secured S's right arm in a wrist-lock control hold to prevent further resistance and guide him to a standing position. S continued to tense and slightly struggle against the hold but was eventually brought to his feet. He remained verbally uncooperative but ceased active physical resistance once standing. S was then escorted to my patrol vehicle and placed under arrest for trespassing and disorderly conduct. No further force was necessary.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 20:15 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to 789 Elm Street for a welfare check after a neighbor reported hearing yelling and loud banging, and expressed concern for the elderly resident. Upon arrival, we knocked and announced our presence multiple times. After several minutes, the resident, later identified as (A), Mr. [NAME] [NAME] (DOB: XX/XX/61), opened the door. (A) appeared disheveled and agitated, immediately yelling at us to "get off his property" and attempting to slam the door shut.

I quickly placed my foot to prevent the door from closing and gave verbal commands for (A) to step back and calm down. (A) continued to yell and actively pushed against the door, trying to force it closed. Due to concern for his well-being and the reported disturbance, Ofc. [NAME] and I entered the threshold. (A) immediately tensed his body, pulling his arms into his chest, and stated, "You're not touching me!" As Ofc. [NAME] attempted to gain control of (A)'s left arm for an escort hold, (A) spun away, almost losing his balance. Fearing a fall and continued resistance, I secured (A)'s right arm. We guided (A) against the nearest wall, giving continuous verbal commands to stop resisting and place his hands behind his back. (A) continued to tense and struggle for a brief moment before we were able to secure his wrists in handcuffs. He remained verbally combative but ceased physical resistance once restrained.

On the above date and time, I responded to 789 Elmwood Ave for a report of a suspicious person trying to open car doors in a residential neighborhood. Upon arrival, I observed a Black male, later identified as S, age 46, matching the description given by dispatch, attempting to open the door of a parked sedan. I exited my patrol vehicle and identified myself as a police officer, giving S verbal commands to show me his hands. S immediately turned towards me, his hands still in his pockets, and began walking away down the sidewalk, ignoring my orders.

I repeated my commands for S to stop and show his hands. S continued to walk away, increasing his pace, and yelled, "I ain't done nothing! Leave me alone!" I then accelerated to catch up to S and attempted to grab his left arm to stop him. S violently pulled his arm away, spinning around and pushing me backward with both hands. Fearing S was attempting to flee or assault me, I delivered a single open-hand strike to S's left shoulder to create distance and gain compliance. S stumbled but remained upright, continuing to resist by flailing his arms and twisting his body. I then executed a controlled takedown, bringing S to the ground in a prone position. S continued to tense his body and tuck his hands underneath him, refusing to present them for handcuffing. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted by applying pressure to S's back, allowing me to secure S's left wrist in handcuffs. S was then fully handcuffed and searched without further incident, although he remained verbally uncooperative.

On the above date and time, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to a report of a disturbance at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, we made contact with a male, later identified as (A), standing on the porch, yelling obscenities at the residents inside. The residents stated they wanted (A) removed from the property as he was intoxicated and had been banging on their door.

I approached (A) and advised him he needed to leave the property. (A) turned towards me, slurring his words, and stated, "I ain't going anywhere, this is my house!" despite the residents confirming he did not live there. I gave multiple verbal commands for (A) to step off the porch and leave the premises. (A) clenched his fists, took a bladed stance, and yelled, "You ain't making me do shit!"

Fearing (A) was preparing to assault me or Ofc. [NAME], I grabbed (A)'s left arm and attempted to guide him off the porch. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away forcefully, and spun to face me. He then pushed me in the chest with both hands. Ofc. [NAME] moved to assist, and we both attempted to gain control of (A)'s arms. (A) actively resisted, flailing his arms and attempting to break free. Due to his continued resistance and assaultive behavior, I performed a straight arm bar takedown, bringing (A) to the ground onto his stomach. While on the ground, (A) continued to tuck his arms under his body, refusing to present them for handcuffing. Ofc. [NAME] delivered two closed-fist strikes to (A)'s left side to gain compliance, after which (A) released his arm, allowing us to secure him in handcuffs.

On the above date and time, I responded to a call for service regarding a male subject passed out on a bench in front of 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed S (later identified as [Subject's Name], DOB [Subject's DOB], a 47-year-old Black male) lying unresponsive on a park bench. I attempted to rouse S by verbal commands and a gentle shake. S slowly stirred, appearing disoriented and heavily intoxicated.

When asked for identification and to stand up, S became verbally abusive, slurring obscenities and refusing to cooperate. S then attempted to push himself up, swinging his arm wildly in my direction, narrowly missing my face. Fearing S was attempting to strike me, I grabbed S's left arm to control him. S immediately tensed up, pulling his arm away forcefully and yelling, "Get off me!" He then attempted to stand, swaying precariously, and took a step towards me with clenched fists.

Due to S's combative posture and continued resistance, I deployed a single drive-stun from my department-issued Taser to S's upper back. The Taser deployment was effective, causing S to fall back onto the bench. Ofc. [NAME] then moved in and assisted in securing S's hands behind his back in handcuffs. S continued to yell profanities but ceased physical resistance. S was then transported to Central Booking for charges of Disorderly Conduct and Resisting Arrest.

On 06/15/2023 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to the report of a male refusing to leave the property of 123 Main St (a closed business). Upon arrival, I observed a B/M, later identified as [Subject's Name/A], age 37, standing near the entrance, yelling obscenities at the building. I exited my patrol vehicle and approached [A], advising him he was trespassing and needed to leave. [A] turned towards me, stating, "I ain't going anywhere, this is my spot!" and began to walk away from me, towards the street, ignoring repeated verbal commands to stop. I advised [A] that if he did not stop, he would be placed under arrest for trespassing. [A] continued to walk away, increasing his pace.

I then moved to intercept [A], placing my hand on his upper arm to stop him. [A] immediately tensed up, spun around, and aggressively pulled his arm away from my grasp, stating, "Get your hands off me!" He then bladed his body, clenching his fists and taking a fighting stance. Fearing [A] was preparing to assault me, I delivered a quick push to his chest, causing him to stumble backward. As he regained his balance, he lunged forward. To prevent an assault, I executed a straight arm bar takedown, bringing [A] to the ground in a controlled manner. [A] landed on his left side but continued to struggle, tucking his hands under his body. Ofc. [NAME] arrived on scene and assisted in pulling [A]'s arms out from under him. After a brief struggle, we were able to secure [A]'s hands in handcuffs behind his back. [A] remained verbally abusive throughout the process but ceased physical resistance once handcuffed. He was then escorted to my patrol vehicle.

Narrative:
On 11/15/23 at approximately 2030 hours, I responded to a report of a disorderly patron refusing to leave "The Corner Bistro" at 45 Main Street. Upon arrival, I observed a female, later identified as (A), yelling loudly at the restaurant manager in the dining area. (A) appeared heavily intoxicated, swaying and slurring her words. I approached (A) and identified myself as police, instructing her to calm down and step outside to speak with me. (A) immediately turned her aggression towards me, stating "I ain't going nowhere, you can't make me!" and began using profanity.

I issued several verbal commands for (A) to exit the establishment. She refused, stepping closer to me and clenching her fists. Fearing a physical altercation, I grabbed (A)'s left arm to guide her out. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and attempted to spin away from my grasp. I maintained control of her arm and, with the assistance of Ofc. [NAME], we initiated a controlled takedown to the floor. (A) continued to actively resist on the ground, kicking her legs and tucking her hands underneath her body. After several verbal commands to show her hands were ignored, Ofc. [NAME] applied a pressure point technique to (A)'s jaw, which caused her to momentarily comply, allowing us to secure her hands in handcuffs. (A) continued to verbally resist and yell profanities as she was escorted out.

On the above date and time, I responded to the area of 123 Main St. for a report of a disorderly female. Upon arrival, I observed a Black female, later identified as (A), Age 36, standing in front of 'The Corner Store' yelling loudly at passersby and blocking the entrance. I approached (A) and advised her to lower her voice and disperse from the private property. (A) immediately turned towards me, her face flushed, and began yelling, "You can't tell me what to do! I ain't moving for nobody!" Her voice was elevated, and she began to clench her fists and take small, aggressive steps in my direction. Due to her continued disorderly conduct and her aggressive posture, I informed (A) she was under arrest. I attempted to take physical control of her left arm to place her in handcuffs. (A) immediately tensed her arm, pulled away forcefully, and spun her body to evade my grasp. Ofc. [NAME] arrived to assist. We both gave verbal commands to (A) to stop resisting and place her hands behind her back. (A) continued to pull away, actively resisting our attempts to gain control of her arms and kicking her legs. After a brief struggle, Ofc. [NAME] was able to secure (A)'s left arm, and I secured her right. We performed a controlled takedown to the ground to facilitate handcuffing. On the ground, (A) continued to tense her body but we were able to successfully apply handcuffs to her behind her back. (A) was then assisted to her feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle, continuing to verbally protest. No further force was utilized after handcuffing.

Narrative:
On 11/15/2023 at approximately 2330 hours, I responded to 45 Elm Street for a report of a verbal domestic dispute. Upon arrival, I observed a white female, later identified as (A), age 23, standing on the front porch, yelling obscenities at a male individual inside the residence. (A) was visibly intoxicated, swaying and slurring her words. I attempted to de-escalate the situation and ordered (A) to calm down and step away from the door. (A) refused, stating, "I'm not going anywhere, he owes me money!" and continued to yell.

After repeated verbal commands to cease her disorderly conduct, which were ignored, I informed (A) she was under arrest for disorderly conduct and trespassing. I grabbed her left arm to place her in handcuffs. (A) immediately tensed her body, pulled her arm away forcefully, and spun around, attempting to evade my grasp. I maintained control of her left arm and, due to her active resistance and refusal to comply, performed a straight arm bar takedown, bringing (A) to the ground onto her left side. (A) continued to struggle on the ground, kicking her legs and attempting to push herself up. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted by controlling (A)'s legs. We were able to secure (A)'s hands behind her back in handcuffs after a brief struggle. (A) continued to be verbally abusive during transport but was no longer physically resistive.

On the above date and time, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to a call regarding a trespasser refusing to leave the premises of the public library at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, we observed a Black male, later identified as (A), sitting on a bench inside the entrance foyer, verbally arguing with library staff. Staff advised (A) had been asked to leave multiple times after closing and was causing a disturbance.

I approached (A) and explained the situation, advising him he needed to leave. (A) responded by yelling, "I ain't going nowhere! This is a public place!" His speech was slurred, and I detected an odor of alcohol. I issued several verbal commands for (A) to stand up and exit the building. (A) refused, tensing his body and gripping the bench. When I attempted to take his arm to escort him, (A) pulled away sharply and began to yell profanities.

Fearing escalation and given his continued refusal to comply, Ofc. [NAME] and I initiated a controlled escort hold. (A) actively resisted by pulling his arms away and pushing back against us. We transitioned to a modified takedown to gain control. As (A) was being brought to the ground, he continued to flail his arms. Once on the ground, (A) continued to tense up, refusing to place his hands behind his back. I applied a brief palm strike to his left bicep, and Ofc. [NAME] secured his right arm, allowing us to successfully handcuff (A) without further incident. (A) continued to verbally protest but ceased physical resistance.

Narrative:
On 11/15/23 at approximately 1430 hours, I responded to the Main Street Library for a report of a disorderly subject refusing to leave the premises. Upon arrival, I made contact with library staff who pointed out a male, later identified as (A), 63 YOA, who was loudly arguing with a librarian near the checkout desk. I approached (A) and observed him yelling, "I'm not going anywhere! You can't make me leave!" I introduced myself and explained the complaint, requesting that he lower his voice and exit the building. (A) turned to me, his face flushed, and stated, "I have a right to be here! You're not kicking me out!" He then crossed his arms and braced himself against a bookshelf. I gave multiple verbal commands for (A) to comply and leave. He refused, continuing to yell and draw attention. Due to his continued non-compliance and disruptive behavior, I informed (A) he was under arrest for trespassing. When I attempted to take his left arm to guide him out, (A) tensed his entire body, pulled his arm away, and stated, "Don't touch me!" Ofc. [NAME] then assisted by securing (A)'s right arm. We utilized a two-on-one control hold, applying slight pressure to his arms to gain compliance. (A) continued to verbally resist and tense up, but we were able to maneuver him away from the bookshelf and guide him towards the exit. Once outside, he was placed in handcuffs without further physical resistance. He continued to verbally protest during transport.

Narrative:
On the above date and time, I responded to a call for service regarding a male subject causing a disturbance and refusing to leave the premises of 789 Elm Avenue. Upon arrival, I observed a Black male, later identified as A, age 50, yelling at the business owner from the sidewalk. I approached A and identified myself, giving verbal commands to calm down and explain the situation. A immediately turned his aggression towards me, yelling, "You ain't got nothing to do with this!" and stepping aggressively towards my personal space. I gave A multiple verbal commands to step back and lower his voice, but he continued to advance and became verbally abusive, clenching his fists. Fearing A would become assaultive, I created distance and ordered him to put his hands behind his back. A refused, stating, "I'm not going to jail!" and began backing away while continuing to yell. Ofc. [NAME] arrived on scene and attempted to flank A. As Ofc. [NAME] moved, A suddenly turned and swung his right arm towards Ofc. [NAME] chest. I immediately intervened, grabbing A's right arm and performing a takedown to the ground. A continued to resist on the ground by tensing his body and attempting to pull his arms free. Ofc. [NAME] and I were able to secure A's hands behind his back after a brief struggle. A was then assisted to his feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On 07/12/2023 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to a report of a large disturbance in progress at Lincoln Park, near the bandstand. Upon arrival, I observed a crowd of approximately 50 individuals, with several engaged in a verbal altercation. I identified Subject (A), a 19-year-old Black female, as one of the primary instigators, actively yelling and pushing other individuals.

I approached Subject (A) and gave multiple verbal commands to cease her actions and disperse. Subject (A) ignored my commands, turned towards me, and began yelling, "I ain't going nowhere!" She continued to agitate the crowd and refused to comply with orders to step away. Due to her continued non-compliance and active participation in the disturbance, I advised Subject (A) that she was under arrest for disorderly conduct.

As I attempted to take her into custody, Subject (A) immediately tensed her body and pulled her left arm away from my grasp. She then attempted to pivot away from me, yelling "Get off me!" To prevent further resistance and secure her, I applied a wrist lock to her left arm, guiding her against a nearby fence. Subject (A) continued to pull and twist, actively resisting the control hold. With the assistance of Ofc. [NAME], who secured her right arm, we were able to bring Subject (A) to a standing cuffing position. She remained verbally combative during the handcuffing process but ceased active physical resistance once both handcuffs were applied. Subject (A) was then escorted to my patrol vehicle without further incident.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 22:15 hours, I responded to 123 Main St for a domestic disturbance. Upon arrival, I made contact with the reporting party, Ms. Jane Doe, who stated her estranged husband, Mr. [NAME] [NAME] (A), age 47, had forced entry into her residence and was intoxicated and verbally aggressive. I located (A) in the living room, actively yelling at Ms. Doe. I gave multiple verbal commands for (A) to calm down and step outside to speak with me, which he ignored. Instead, (A) took a step towards Ms. Doe, who appeared visibly distressed. I intervened, placing myself between them and again ordering (A) to step back. (A) then squared his shoulders, clenched his fists, and stated, "You're not touching me, I live here." Fearing for Ms. Doe's safety and given (A)'s aggressive posture, I attempted to guide (A) by his left arm towards the front door. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away forcefully, and pushed past me, attempting to re-approach Ms. Doe. I utilized a quick push to (A)'s upper chest to create distance, simultaneously drawing my Taser and giving a loud verbal command, "Taser! Get on the ground now!" (A) paused, looked at the Taser, and slowly knelt to the ground. Ofc. [NAME] then assisted in securing (A)'s hands behind his back without further physical resistance. (A) was then placed under arrest for domestic assault and battery and unlawful entry.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 1830 hours, I responded to a report of shoplifting at the 'Quick Stop' convenience store, 123 Main St. Dispatch advised the suspect was a young Black female, approximately 18-20 years old, wearing a black hoodie and jeans, last seen walking southbound on Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a female matching the description, later identified as (A), standing near the bus stop.

I approached (A) and identified myself as a police officer. I explained the reason for my contact and requested her identification. (A) immediately became defensive, stating loudly, "I didn't do anything, leave me alone!" and attempted to walk away from me. I gave multiple verbal commands for (A) to stop and to stay put, but she continued to disregard my orders, increasing her pace.

As (A) continued to walk away, I stepped in front of her to block her path. She then attempted to push past me. Fearing she was attempting to flee, I grabbed (A)'s left arm to prevent her escape and guide her towards my patrol vehicle. (A) immediately tensed her arm, pulled away forcefully, and began to twist her body, yelling "Get off me!" and "You can't touch me!"

With the assistance of Ofc. [NAME], who secured her right arm, we applied an escort hold. (A) continued to actively resist by pulling her arms and tensing her entire body, refusing to place her hands behind her back. After several verbal commands to stop resisting and repeated attempts, Ofc. [NAME] and I were able to overcome (A)'s resistance, secure her hands in handcuffs to the rear, and place her in the patrol vehicle.
