On the above date and time, I responded to 742 Industrial Way for a report of a suspicious person seen attempting to gain entry to a closed warehouse. Upon arrival, I observed a white male, later identified as (S), standing near a rear service door, holding a pry bar. I exited my patrol vehicle and immediately gave loud verbal commands, "Police! Drop the pry bar and show me your hands!" (S) looked in my direction, then quickly turned and began to walk away, ignoring my commands. I repeated my commands, increasing my volume, and began to follow (S). (S) then picked up his pace, attempting to flee. I closed the distance and grabbed (S)'s right arm to prevent his escape. (S) immediately tensed up, pulling his arm away from my grasp and swinging his left elbow backwards towards my chest. Fearing for my safety and to prevent further flight, I initiated a takedown by sweeping (S)'s legs while maintaining control of his right arm. (S) fell to the ground on his left side. He continued to resist by attempting to push himself up and keep his hands underneath his body, refusing to present them for handcuffing despite multiple verbal commands. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted, applying pressure to (S)'s shoulder while I secured his right arm. We were then able to pull (S)'s left arm out from under him and successfully apply handcuffs. (S) was then searched and secured in the patrol vehicle.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 2330 hours, I responded to 123 Elm St for a report of a loud party and disturbance. Upon arrival, I observed a large gathering of individuals in the front yard and heard loud music emanating from the residence. As I approached the property, I observed a white male, later identified as (A), standing on the porch yelling obscenities at another individual. (A) appeared heavily intoxicated, exhibiting slurred speech and swaying noticeably.

I approached (A) and identified myself as a police officer, advising him of the noise complaint and directing him to calm down. (A) immediately turned his aggression towards me, stating, "I ain't doing shit, pig!" and took a step forward in an aggressive manner. I gave (A) multiple verbal commands to step back and place his hands behind his back. (A) ignored these commands, clenched his fists, and continued to yell, "Get off my property!"

Fearing (A) was preparing to assault me, I attempted to gain control of his left arm for an escort hold. (A) actively resisted by pulling his arm away with significant force and attempted to spin around. Due to his active resistance and continued aggressive demeanor, I performed a straight arm bar takedown, bringing (A) to the ground in a controlled manner. While on the ground, (A) continued to tense his body and tucked his hands underneath him, refusing to present them for handcuffing. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted by applying pressure to (A)'s shoulder, which allowed me to secure his left wrist. We then successfully handcuffed (A) without further incident. (A) was placed under arrest for Disorderly Conduct and Resisting Arrest.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to a 911 call regarding a domestic disturbance at 123 Elm Street. Upon arrival, I observed a female, later identified as (S), standing in the doorway, yelling at a male inside the residence. The male party stated S was unwelcome and refused to leave. I gave S several verbal commands to step outside and speak with us, which she ignored, continuing to yell at the male and refusing to acknowledge our presence. When I attempted to guide S outside by placing my hand on her arm, S pulled away violently, stating "Get your hands off me!" and attempted to re-enter the residence. Fearing S would escalate the domestic dispute further, I grabbed S's right arm and Ofc. [NAME] secured her left arm. S tensed her entire body, pulling against our hold and attempting to break free. She began to kick backwards and swing her head. To gain control and prevent injury to S or officers, I performed a controlled takedown to the ground. S continued to resist on the ground, tucking her hands under her body. Ofc. [NAME] delivered two closed-fist strikes to S's side, which allowed me to secure her right wrist. With Ofc. [NAME] assistance, we were able to bring S's hands behind her back and apply handcuffs. S continued to scream and verbally assault officers during the handcuffing process and transport to the patrol vehicle.

Narrative: On 03/15/2024 at approximately 2330 hours, I responded to 123 Main St regarding a noise complaint. Upon arrival, I observed a large gathering with loud music emanating from the residence. I made contact with S (White, Male, 25), who was visibly intoxicated, yelling, and holding an open container. S was advised of the complaint and given verbal orders to lower the music and step outside to speak. S became immediately agitated, stating, "This is my property, I don't have to do anything!" and refused to comply with repeated orders. S then squared his shoulders, clenched his fists, and took a step towards Ofc. [NAME] in an aggressive manner, continuing to yell obscenities.

Fearing S was preparing to assault Ofc. [NAME], I initiated a control hold on S's left arm. S immediately tensed up, attempting to pull away and break my grip. I delivered two quick closed-fist strikes to S's left side to gain compliance, which proved ineffective. S continued to resist, pulling his arm and attempting to spin away. I then transitioned S to a controlled takedown to the ground. While on the ground, S continued to actively resist by tucking his hands beneath his body and tensing his core, preventing handcuffing. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted. After several joint lock manipulations and further verbal commands, S eventually complied, and was placed into handcuffs. S remained verbally abusive during transport to the precinct.

On the above date and time, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to a 911 call regarding a male, later identified as S, matching the description of a suspect peering into vehicles on Elm Street. Upon arrival, we observed S attempting to open the door of a parked sedan. As we approached, S immediately noticed our presence and attempted to walk away quickly, ignoring our verbal commands to stop and speak with us. I ordered S to stop and show his hands, to which he yelled, "I ain't got to do nothing!" and continued to walk away at a rapid pace.

Due to the nature of the call and S's evasive behavior, I attempted to block S's path. S then pushed past me, attempting to flee. Ofc. [NAME] grabbed S's left arm to prevent his escape. S immediately tensed his body and violently pulled his arm away from Ofc. [NAME], spinning around to face us with clenched fists. S continued to yell profanities and took an aggressive stance, posturing as if to fight. Fearing an imminent assault on myself or Ofc. [NAME], I delivered one closed-fist strike to S's left upper arm to gain control and break his aggressive posture. S flinched and momentarily lost balance.

This allowed Ofc. [NAME] and I to secure S's arms. S continued to actively resist by pulling and twisting his body, refusing to place his hands behind his back. We then utilized a controlled takedown to bring S to the ground, where we were finally able to gain control of his hands and apply handcuffs. S remained verbally defiant throughout the process but was physically subdued. S was then transported to booking.

On 11/15/20 at approximately 2015 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to a report of a disorderly female refusing to leave the premises of "The Corner Store" at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, we observed a Black female, later identified as (A) [Subject's Name], age 43, standing near the entrance, yelling obscenities at the store clerk. The clerk informed us that (A) had been asked to leave multiple times due to her disruptive behavior.

I approached (A) and identified myself as police, instructing her to calm down and exit the property. (A) immediately turned her aggression towards me, stating, "I ain't going anywhere, you can't make me!" and took a step closer to my personal space. Her demeanor was agitated, and she clenched her fists. I repeated my lawful order for her to leave the premises or she would be placed under arrest for trespassing. (A) responded by yelling louder and attempting to push past me back into the store.

At this point, Ofc. [NAME] and I attempted to gain control of (A)'s arms to escort her out. (A) actively resisted, pulling her arms away forcefully and tensing her entire body. She began to flail her arms and kick her legs towards Ofc. [NAME]. Due to her continued active resistance and aggression, I performed a controlled takedown to the ground. While on the ground, (A) continued to struggle, tucking her hands underneath her body. Ofc. [NAME] applied a knee strike to (A)'s left thigh, which created a momentary window to secure her left wrist. We then successfully handcuffed (A) behind her back. She remained verbally combative during the process but ceased physical resistance once restrained. (A) was then assisted to her feet and transported.

On the above date and time, I responded to the Main Street Public Library for a report of a male refusing to leave after closing. Upon arrival, I made contact with the subject, identified as a 62-year-old Black male (S). S was seated at a table, reading, and initially ignored verbal commands to gather his belongings and exit the building. After several attempts to engage, S looked up and stated, "I'm not leaving, I have a right to be here." I informed S that the library was closed and he was trespassing. S continued to refuse, clenching his jaw and avoiding eye contact. Ofc. [NAME] and I then attempted to escort S by taking his arms. S immediately tensed up, pulled his arms away, and became dead weight, refusing to move his feet. Due to S's continued non-compliance and active resistance to being escorted, Ofc. [NAME] and I initiated a controlled escort. S continued to resist by pulling his arms and leaning away from officers. To gain control and prevent a fall, I applied a wrist control technique to S's left arm while Ofc. [NAME] maintained control of S's right arm. S was then guided out of the library and placed in the rear of my patrol vehicle. S remained verbally defiant throughout the process but no further physical force was required once outside the building.

Narrative:
On 03/12/2023 at approximately 23:15 hours, I responded to a report of a suspicious male loitering in the closed parking lot of "The Hardware Store" at 123 Main Street. Upon arrival, I observed a white male, later identified as (A) [NAME] [NAME], age 22, sitting on a curb near the entrance. The business was clearly marked as closed. I approached (A) and asked him what he was doing. (A) immediately became defensive, stating, "None of your business, I'm just chilling." I explained that the business was closed and he was trespassing. I requested his identification. (A) refused, stating he didn't have to provide anything and started to stand up, attempting to walk away.

I ordered (A) to stop and advised him he was being detained for trespassing and failure to identify. (A) continued to walk away, ignoring my commands. I then grabbed (A)'s left arm to prevent him from leaving. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away forcefully, and spun around, pushing me in the chest with both hands. I stumbled backward slightly. Fearing (A) would continue to resist or attempt to flee, I initiated a takedown. I secured (A)'s left arm and performed a straight armbar takedown, bringing him to the ground in a prone position. (A) continued to struggle, tucking his arms under his body and refusing to present his hands. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted. We delivered several palm heel strikes to (A)'s side to gain compliance. After several strikes, (A) released his arms, and we were able to secure him in handcuffs. (A) continued to yell obscenities while being cuffed but ceased physical resistance.

Narrative: On 11/15/23 at approximately 2310 hours, I responded to a call for service at "The Corner Pub" regarding an intoxicated female refusing to leave the premises. Upon arrival, I observed (A) yelling loudly at bar staff and patrons, causing a significant disturbance. Her speech was slurred, and she appeared heavily intoxicated. I approached (A) and attempted to engage her verbally, advising her she needed to leave or she would be arrested for disorderly conduct. (A) immediately turned her aggression towards me, yelling, "I'm not going anywhere, you can't make me!" and began to flail her arms.

I gave multiple verbal commands for (A) to calm down and place her hands behind her back. (A) refused, taking a bladed stance and clenching her fists. Fearing she was preparing to strike, I attempted to gain control of her left arm to escort her out. (A) actively pulled away, twisting her body and attempting to pull her arm free. Ofc. [NAME] arrived to assist. With Ofc. [NAME], I attempted a modified armbar to gain control of (A)'s left arm. (A) continued to struggle violently, kicking her legs and yelling obscenities. Due to her active resistance, I performed a controlled takedown, bringing (A) to the ground onto her stomach. She continued to tense her body and attempt to keep her hands tucked under her torso. Ofc. [NAME] and I applied pressure to her upper back and used leverage to bring her hands behind her back. She was eventually handcuffed after a brief struggle. (A) continued to yell and curse during transport to the precinct.

Narrative:
On 03/15/2023 at approximately 22:15 hours, I responded with Officer [NAME] to the report of a disorderly male at "The Saloon" bar, 123 Main St. Upon arrival, we observed a white male, later identified as (A), standing in front of the establishment, yelling profanities at patrons attempting to enter and exit. (A) appeared heavily intoxicated, swaying and slurring his words. I approached (A) and identified myself, advising him that he needed to leave the premises. (A) immediately became agitated, yelling "I ain't going anywhere, this is a free country!" and took a step towards me in an aggressive manner.

I gave multiple verbal commands for (A) to step back and calm down, which he ignored. Due to his continued aggressive posture, public intoxication, and refusal to comply, I informed (A) he was under arrest for disorderly conduct. As I attempted to grasp his left arm to place him in handcuffs, (A) tensed his body, pulled his arm away forcefully, and spun around, attempting to create distance. Officer [NAME] then moved to assist. (A) actively resisted our attempts to control his arms, bracing his body and pulling away. After several verbal warnings to stop resisting, I utilized a straight arm bar takedown, bringing (A) to the ground in a controlled manner. On the ground, (A) continued to tuck his hands beneath his chest, refusing to present them. Officer [NAME] applied pressure to his upper back while I secured his left arm. After a brief struggle, we were able to successfully handcuff (A) without further incident. He was then escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 14:30 hours, I responded to 72 Elm Street for a welfare check requested by a concerned neighbor. The neighbor reported that (A), later identified as Ms. Clara Jenkins (DOB: XX/XX/1971), had been yelling incoherently for several hours and throwing objects inside her apartment. Upon arrival, I made contact with (A) at her front door. She opened the door partially and immediately became verbally agitated, shouting "Get off my property!" and attempting to close the door. I explained my presence and requested to check on her well-being. (A) refused to cooperate, continued to yell, and attempted to push the door shut. Fearing for her safety and the possibility of a mental health crisis, I placed my foot in the doorframe to prevent it from closing completely. (A) then began to push forcefully against the door, trying to pin my foot. I gave several verbal commands for her to stop resisting and step away from the door. (A) ignored my commands and continued to push. Due to her continued resistance and the confined space, I initiated a door-frame entry. I used an open-hand push to her shoulder to create space and prevent her from closing the door on me. This allowed me to gain entry and prevent her from retreating further into the apartment. Once inside, (A) continued to scream and flail her arms, refusing to comply with orders to calm down. Ofc. [NAME] arrived as backup and we were able to secure (A) in handcuffs for her safety and ours, after a brief struggle where she tensed her arms and pulled away. She was transported to St. [NAME]'s Hospital for evaluation.

On the above date and time, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to a report of an unwanted person refusing to leave the premises of the Family Dollar located at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, we observed S (later identified as [Name Redacted], DOB [Date Redacted], Age 51) standing near the entrance, yelling obscenities at store employees. We approached S and advised him he needed to leave the property. S turned towards us, stating "I ain't going nowhere, you can't make me." S appeared agitated, his fists clenched, and he began to take a step towards Ofc. [NAME]. Fearing S was preparing to physically confront us, I gave S verbal commands to step back and place his hands behind his back. S ignored my commands, instead taking another aggressive step forward and stating, "Get out of my face." At this point, I initiated a control hold, grabbing S's left arm while Ofc. [NAME] secured his right. S immediately tensed up, pulling his arms away and attempting to twist his body free. We were able to maintain control, and after a brief struggle, Ofc. [NAME] performed a controlled takedown to the ground. S continued to resist on the ground, tucking his hands under his body. I delivered two knee strikes to S's left thigh, which created enough compliance for Ofc. [NAME] to secure S's left hand in handcuffs. We then rolled S onto his side, and I secured his right hand. S was then assisted to his feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle.

Narrative:
On 07/12/23 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to 123 Main St for a report of a highly intoxicated female causing a disturbance outside a residential building. Upon arrival, I observed a white female, later identified as (A), age 45, yelling profanities at passersby and attempting to kick a trash can. Her movements were unsteady, and she displayed signs of severe intoxication. I approached (A) and attempted to engage her, advising her of the disturbance complaint. (A) immediately became verbally aggressive, yelling "I haven't done anything wrong!" and refusing to provide identification. I gave repeated verbal commands for (A) to calm down and cease her disorderly behavior. (A) ignored my commands and attempted to walk away, stumbling into the street. Fearing for her safety and the safety of others, I moved to prevent her from entering traffic. As I reached for her arm to guide her to the sidewalk, (A) spun around abruptly, flailing her arms and striking my chest with an open hand. I immediately transitioned to a control hold, securing (A)'s left arm to prevent further assaultive behavior. (A) continued to pull away and tense her body, refusing to comply with orders to place her hands behind her back. Ofc. [NAME] arrived on scene and assisted in securing (A)'s right arm. We executed a controlled takedown to the ground to safely apply handcuffs, as (A) was actively resisting. Once on the ground, (A) continued to thrash her legs but we were able to successfully apply handcuffs to the rear. (A) was then assisted to her feet and transported to the precinct for booking on charges of disorderly conduct and assault on a police officer.

On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Main Street Library for a report of a disorderly person refusing to leave after closing hours. Upon arrival, I observed S, an elderly male matching the description, seated in a chair near the entrance, ignoring repeated requests from library staff to exit the building. I approached S, identified myself as a police officer, and informed him that the library was closed and he needed to leave the premises. S looked at me, then back at the wall, and mumbled, "I ain't going nowhere." I reiterated my lawful order, explaining that if he did not comply, he would be subject to arrest for trespassing. S then clenched his jaw, crossed his arms tightly across his chest, and stated loudly, "You can't make me leave, I'm waiting for my ride." Ofc. [NAME] arrived to assist. We attempted a two-officer escort hold to guide S out of his chair. S immediately tensed his entire body, pulled his arms inward, and dug his feet into the floor, refusing to stand. He began yelling "Get your hands off me!" I delivered multiple verbal commands for S to relax and comply. Due to S's active physical resistance, Ofc. [NAME] and I initiated a controlled takedown to the floor. S continued to resist by attempting to roll away and keep his hands tucked under his torso. After a brief struggle, we were able to secure S's hands behind his back in handcuffs. S continued to verbally protest but ceased physical resistance.

Narrative:
On the above date and time, I responded to a report of a disorderly male outside the 7-Eleven at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a white male, later identified as (S), age 27, yelling profanities at passersby and attempting to block the entrance to the store. S appeared heavily intoxicated, swaying and slurring his words. I approached S and issued verbal commands to cease his behavior and leave the area. S turned towards me, aggressively stating, "I ain't going nowhere, cop!" and took a step forward.

Due to S's continued disorderly conduct, intoxication, and aggressive posture, I advised him he was under arrest for disorderly conduct. As I attempted to secure S's left arm, he immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away, and attempted to spin around. Ofc. [NAME] simultaneously attempted to control S's right arm. S continued to resist, pulling his arms into his chest and trying to pull away from our grasp. I utilized an arm bar control technique on S's left arm, while Ofc. [NAME] maintained control of his right arm, and we guided S to the ground in a controlled manner. S continued to struggle on the ground, attempting to push himself up. After several verbal commands to stop resisting, Ofc. [NAME] placed S's right arm behind his back, and I secured his left arm, completing the handcuffing process. S was then escorted to the patrol vehicle without further incident.

On 11/15/20 at approximately 14:30 hours, I responded to 456 Elm Street for a welfare check on an elderly female reported to be disoriented and verbally aggressive towards neighbors. Upon arrival, I located S, a 59-year-old Black female, standing in her driveway yelling at passersby. I attempted to engage S in conversation to assess her well-being and determine if she needed assistance. S immediately became hostile, yelling, "Get off my property! You ain't got no business here!" and refused to answer any questions.

After several attempts to de-escalate the situation and explain my presence, S continued to yell and began walking aggressively towards me. I gave S verbal commands to stop and maintain distance, but she ignored them. S then raised her right hand as if to strike me. Fearing an assault, I utilized an open-hand push to S's chest to create distance. S stumbled backward but regained her balance and continued to advance, swinging her arms wildly and shouting profanities. Officer [NAME] arrived on scene and assisted. We gave S verbal commands to stop resisting and place her hands behind her back. S refused, actively pulling away and tensing her body. Officer [NAME] applied a wrist lock to S's left arm, and I secured her right arm. We guided S to the ground to safely gain control and apply handcuffs. S continued to struggle on the ground by kicking her legs and arching her back, but we were able to secure her in handcuffs. S was then assisted to her feet and transported for a mental health evaluation.

Narrative:
On the above date and time, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to a report of a disturbance at 456 Elm Street. Upon arrival, we observed a black female, later identified as S (age 25), yelling at restaurant staff and refusing to leave the premises. S was actively impeding business operations and causing a public disturbance. We attempted to de-escalate the situation by giving S multiple verbal commands to calm down and exit the establishment. S ignored our commands, instead turning her aggression towards officers, yelling obscenities and stating, "I'm not going anywhere!"

Due to S's continued disruptive behavior and refusal to comply, she was advised she was under arrest for disorderly conduct and trespassing. I attempted to take S's left arm to escort her out of the restaurant. S immediately tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and attempted to push past me. She then swung her right arm towards my chest, making contact. In response to S's active resistance and assaultive behavior, I secured her left arm in a wrist-lock and Ofc. [NAME] moved to secure her right arm. S continued to struggle, twisting her body and attempting to kick. We executed a controlled takedown to the ground to gain better control. On the ground, S continued to resist, refusing to present her hands. After several more verbal commands and continued struggle, Ofc. [NAME] was able to secure S's left hand, and I secured her right. S was then successfully handcuffed in the prone position. Once handcuffed, S continued to yell but ceased physical resistance. She was then assisted to her feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle.

Narrative: On the above date and time, I responded to a report of a male trespassing on private property at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, Ofc. [NAME] and I observed S, a Black male, age 44, standing in the doorway of a vacant building, matching the description provided by dispatch. I approached S and asked him to step outside and identify himself. S immediately became agitated, yelling "I ain't doing shit, this ain't your business!" and refused to move. I gave repeated verbal commands for S to exit the building and provide identification, which he ignored, instead taking a step further inside.

Seeing S's non-compliance and attempt to retreat further into the building, I grabbed S's left arm to escort him out. S immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away forcefully, and spun around, pushing me in the chest with both hands. Ofc. [NAME] then moved to assist, attempting to gain control of S's right arm. S continued to actively resist, pulling his arms away and bracing his body. Due to S's active resistance and assault on an officer, I delivered an open-hand strike to S's upper back to create separation and gain compliance. S stumbled forward but continued to struggle. Ofc. [NAME] then performed a leg sweep, bringing S to the ground onto his stomach. S continued to keep his hands tucked under his body, refusing to comply with orders to show his hands. I delivered two knee strikes to S's left outer thigh. S then presented his hands, and we were able to secure him in handcuffs without further incident. S was subsequently arrested for trespassing, resisting arrest, and assault on a police officer.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 14:10 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to a report of a disturbance at "The Daily Grind" coffee shop located at 123 Main St. Dispatch advised a female subject was refusing to leave after being asked by management due to disruptive behavior. Upon arrival, we observed a white female, later identified as (A), sitting at a table, yelling at staff and other patrons.

We approached (A) and identified ourselves as police officers. We attempted to de-escalate the situation, explaining the complaint and asking her to leave the premises. (A) immediately became verbally aggressive towards us, stating "I'm not going anywhere, you can't make me!" and using profanity. She refused multiple lawful orders to stand up and exit the establishment. Due to her continued disruption and refusal to comply, we informed (A) she was under arrest for trespass.

As Ofc. [NAME] reached for (A)'s left arm to escort her, (A) tensed her body, pulled her arm away forcefully, and attempted to push Ofc. [NAME]. I then grasped (A)'s right arm, and together we applied an escort hold. (A) continued to pull against our grip, verbally resisting and attempting to twist her body away. We maintained control and guided her towards the exit. While doing so, (A) attempted to kick backwards towards my shins. I adjusted my grip to prevent further assault and we were able to bring her outside and secure her hands in handcuffs without further incident. She continued to yell and struggle slightly as she was placed into the patrol vehicle.

Narrative:
On 11/15/23 at approximately 2010 hours, I responded to a report of a disturbance at the 7-Eleven located at 45 Main Street. Dispatch advised an intoxicated male, later identified as (A), was yelling at employees and refusing to leave the premises. Upon arrival, I observed (A) standing near the counter, red-faced and slurring his words, shouting obscenities at the clerk. Narrative: On 03/15/23 at approximately 2015 hours, I responded to 789 Elm Street for a welfare check concerning a female, later identified as (A), who was reportedly yelling incoherently in her front yard and appeared disoriented. Upon my arrival, (A) was observed standing near the curb, shouting at passing cars. I approached (A) and attempted to engage her in conversation to assess her well-being. (A) immediately became verbally aggressive, yelling "Get away from me!" and repeatedly cursing at me. She refused to provide identification or state her name, and her speech was slurred. Due to her agitated state and potential danger to herself, I advised (A) that she needed to be evaluated by EMS.

I attempted to guide (A) towards the ambulance that had arrived. (A) violently pulled her arm away, tensing her body and stepping back. She then swung her right arm towards my chest, striking my uniform. At this point, Ofc. [NAME] assisted, and we initiated an escort hold on (A)'s arms to prevent further assault and ensure her safety. (A) continued to actively resist, pulling her arms away and dropping her weight, refusing to walk. We then initiated a controlled takedown to place (A) on the ground, where she continued to struggle, flailing her legs. After several verbal commands to stop resisting, Ofc. [NAME] and I were able to secure (A)'s hands behind her back in handcuffs. She was then escorted to the awaiting ambulance for medical evaluation.

On the above date and time, I responded to 345 Maple Ave for a report of a male individual yelling and attempting to stop traffic. Upon arrival, I observed a white male, later identified as (A), standing in the roadway, shouting at passing vehicles. I approached (A) and gave him verbal commands to exit the roadway and move to the sidewalk. (A) turned towards me, his eyes bloodshot, and yelled, "I ain't doing shit for you!" He then took a step towards me, clenching his fists.

Due to (A)'s aggressive demeanor and failure to comply with lawful orders, I informed him he was under arrest for disorderly conduct. As I reached for his arm to effect the arrest, (A) tensed his body, pulled his arm away, and attempted to spin away from me. I maintained my grip on his left arm and, with the assistance of Ofc. [NAME] who had arrived on scene, we attempted to guide (A) to the ground. (A) actively resisted, pulling, pushing, and attempting to kick backwards. After several verbal commands to stop resisting, Ofc. [NAME] applied a quick burst of pepper spray to (A)'s face. (A) immediately recoiled, allowing us to complete a controlled takedown to the ground. While on the ground, (A) continued to struggle briefly but then complied with commands to place his hands behind his back. He was secured in handcuffs without further incident and escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 2330 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to 123 Main St. for a report of a loud party and a disturbance in the street. Upon arrival, we observed a large group gathered, with several individuals yelling. I made contact with S, later identified as [Subject's Name], who was standing in the middle of the street, visibly agitated and shouting at another individual.

I ordered S to step to the sidewalk and lower his voice. S ignored my commands, turned his back, and began to walk away, stating "I ain't doing shit, you can't tell me what to do." I repeated my orders and informed S he was being detained for disorderly conduct. S continued to walk away, increasing his pace as he approached a nearby yard.

As S attempted to enter the yard, I moved to intercept him. I grabbed S's right arm to prevent his escape and guide him towards the patrol vehicle. S immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away forcefully, and spun around, pushing me in the chest with both hands. Fearing S would flee or continue to assault me, I initiated a take-down maneuver, bringing S to the ground in a controlled manner. S continued to resist on the ground, tucking his arms under his body and refusing to present his hands for handcuffing. Ofc. [NAME] assisted by applying pressure to S's shoulder while I delivered two open-hand strikes to S's left bicep. After the strikes, S briefly relaxed his arm, allowing Ofc. [NAME] to secure his left wrist. S then complied with orders to present his right hand, and he was successfully handcuffed without further incident. S was then assisted to his feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On the above date and time, I responded to a report of a disorderly male at the corner of Main St and Elm Ave. Upon arrival, I observed S, a 63-year-old Black male, yelling at pedestrians and refusing to move from the bus stop. S appeared disoriented and agitated, waving his arms erratically. I approached S and attempted to engage him verbally, explaining that he needed to vacate the area as he was blocking pedestrian traffic and causing a disturbance. S responded by yelling "Leave me alone! You can't tell me what to do!" and clenched his fists. Ofc. [NAME] arrived to assist. We continued to give S verbal commands to calm down and move along. S then took a step towards the street, ignoring our warnings about oncoming traffic. Fearing for his safety, I attempted to gently guide S away from the street by placing my hand on his arm. S immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away forcefully, and pushed me with his free hand. I then utilized a control hold (wrist lock) to gain compliance and prevent him from entering the roadway. S continued to resist, twisting his body and pulling away, requiring Ofc. [NAME] to assist in securing his other arm. We were able to safely escort S to the sidewalk and then into the rear of my patrol vehicle for transport to the precinct, where he could be evaluated by mental health professionals. S remained verbally uncooperative but ceased physical resistance once secured.

Narrative:
On 11/15/2023 at approximately 22:15 hours, I responded to 123 Main St, Apt 4B, for a welfare check regarding a female screaming within the apartment. Upon arrival, I heard loud yelling and what sounded like objects being thrown from inside. I knocked on the door several times, announcing "Police!" The door was eventually opened by a female, later identified as (S), who appeared highly agitated, disheveled, and smelled strongly of alcohol. S immediately yelled, "What do you want? I'm fine, get off my property!" I attempted to explain the reason for our presence, giving verbal commands for S to step out of the apartment so we could ascertain her safety. S refused, attempting to close the door on me. Fearing for S's safety and the potential for a domestic incident, I placed my foot to prevent the door from closing and reached for S's left arm to guide her out. S immediately pulled her arm away, yelling "Don't touch me!" and attempted to push past me. Due to S's active resistance and agitated state, I executed a wrist lock and guided S to the ground to gain control. S continued to tense up and pull her arms away from my grasp. Ofc. [NAME] assisted by securing S's right arm. S was then placed into handcuffs without further incident, although she continued to be verbally abusive. S was transported to the precinct for booking on charges of resisting arrest and disorderly conduct.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 1430 hours, I responded to a report of a disorderly subject at the Main Street Public Library. Library staff identified the subject as a Black male, later identified as Mr. [NAME] Jenkins (DOB: XX/XX/1962), who was reportedly yelling at patrons and refusing to leave.

Upon arrival, I observed Mr. Jenkins standing in the main lobby, shouting about "unfair treatment." I approached Mr. Jenkins and requested he lower his voice and exit the premises, explaining the library's policy. Mr. Jenkins immediately became agitated, stating, "I'm not going anywhere, I pay my taxes!" He began to walk rapidly towards me, gesticulating wildly with his hands and raising his voice further, stating, "You think you can tell me what to do?"

Fearing he was preparing to physically confront me, I issued a verbal command to "Stop right there, Mr. Jenkins!" He ignored this command and continued to advance. At this point, I placed my right hand on Mr. Jenkins' left bicep and my left hand on his forearm, attempting to guide him towards the exit using an escort hold. Mr. Jenkins immediately tensed his arm, pulled away, and began to twist his body, refusing to walk. He continued to yell, "Get your hands off me!" Due to his active resistance and refusal to comply, Ofc. [NAME] assisted by securing Mr. Jenkins' right arm. We maintained the escort hold and, with combined effort, were able to guide Mr. Jenkins out of the library and place him against the exterior wall for handcuffing. He continued to verbally resist and tense up, but we secured him in handcuffs without further physical struggle. Mr. Jenkins was charged with Disorderly Conduct and Trespassing.

On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Main St for a report of a domestic disturbance. Upon arrival, I observed a Black female, later identified as (A), standing on the porch, yelling loudly at another individual inside the residence. (A) appeared highly agitated, gesturing wildly with her hands and refusing to calm down despite verbal requests from myself and Ofc. [NAME]. I repeatedly ordered (A) to step away from the doorway and speak with us, but she ignored commands, continuing to scream and attempting to push past us to re-enter the house.

As (A) made a sudden movement towards the door, I placed my left hand on her right arm and attempted to guide her away to create distance. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and spun around, stating "Get off me, I ain't doing nothing!" She then raised her hands, clenching her fists, and stepped towards me in an aggressive manner. Fearing an assault, I initiated an arm bar takedown, bringing (A) to the ground. (A) continued to resist, thrashing her legs and attempting to push herself up. Ofc. [NAME] assisted by securing (A)'s legs while I gained control of her arms. After a brief struggle, we were able to secure (A)'s hands behind her back in handcuffs. (A) continued to verbally protest but ceased physical resistance once restrained. She was then escorted to the patrol vehicle without further incident.

On 03/15/2024 at approximately 22:15 hours, I responded to 123 Elm Street for a reported domestic disturbance. Dispatch advised a male subject, later identified as (A), White, Male, DOB XX/XX/1992, was yelling and throwing objects inside the residence. Upon arrival, I made contact with (A) standing on the porch. (A) appeared heavily intoxicated, his speech was slurred, and he was swaying. I attempted to de-escalate the situation and ascertain the welfare of other occupants. (A) immediately became verbally aggressive, yelling "I'm not going anywhere" and attempting to push past me to re-enter the residence.

I gave multiple verbal commands for (A) to stop and place his hands behind his back. (A) ignored these commands, stating, "Get your hands off me!" and actively pulled his left arm away as I attempted to gain control. Due to (A)'s continued non-compliance, agitated state, and attempts to re-enter the residence while verbally threatening, I initiated a physical control technique. I secured (A)'s left arm and guided him away from the door. (A) actively resisted, tensing his body and pulling against my grasp. I utilized a wrist lock and applied downward pressure to bring (A) to a kneeling position. (A) continued to struggle, refusing to present his right hand for handcuffing. Officer [NAME] arrived and assisted by securing (A)'s right arm. Once both hands were secured, (A) was placed in handcuffs without further incident. On the above date and time, I responded to Lincoln Park for a report of a male refusing to leave after closing hours. Upon arrival, I observed S, a 62-year-old Black male, sitting on a park bench near the entrance, visibly agitated and yelling at passersby. I approached S and identified myself, advising him the park was closed and he needed to vacate the premises. S immediately became verbally abusive, stating, "I pay my taxes, I ain't going anywhere!" and refused to acknowledge my commands to stand up.

After multiple verbal warnings to comply or face arrest for trespassing, S remained seated, crossing his arms and glaring. I informed S he was under arrest for trespassing. As I attempted to take S's left arm to escort him, S tensed his entire body, pulling his arm away forcefully and stating, "Don't touch me!" Ofc. [NAME] then moved to assist. We both took an arm, and S continued to actively pull away, refusing to stand or place his hands behind his back. Due to S's continued active resistance, I delivered two short downward palm strikes to S's left shoulder blade. This disengagement technique created a momentary break in his resistance, allowing Ofc. [NAME] and I to gain control of S's arms and place him into handcuffs. S continued to yell but complied with being escorted to the patrol vehicle without further incident.

On the above date and time, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to a report of a domestic disturbance at 123 Main St. Dispatch advised of screaming and yelling from within the residence. After several attempts, we observed a male, later identified as (S), open the door slightly. [NAME] gave verbal commands for (S) to calm down and step outside. (S) refused, tensing his body and pushing against the door with his shoulder, attempting to force it shut. [NAME] then grabbed (S)'s right arm. (S) continued to struggle, pulling his arms free and pushing back against both officers. I delivered a single closed-fist strike to (S)'s left bicep to break his resistance, which caused him to momentarily flinch and release tension. We were then able to secure his arms and place him in handcuffs. (S) continued to verbally protest but ceased active resistance once handcuffed. He was then escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On the above date and time, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to the Public Library for a report of a disturbance. Staff advised a female patron was refusing to leave after being asked multiple times. On 11/15/23 at approximately 1430 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to a report of a male refusing to leave the property at 45 Elm Street. We gave (A) several verbal commands to exit the property and identify himself. (A) ignored our commands, continued to yell obscenities, and began to walk back towards the front door of the residence. (A) immediately tensed up, pulling his arms away from our grasp and attempting to twist his body. He yelled, "Get your hands off me!" We maintained control of his arms, utilizing a modified escort hold to prevent him from regaining his balance or re-entering the residence. We slowly guided him down the porch steps and towards the sidewalk. (A) continued to verbally resist and pull against our hold, but no further physical force was applied. Once on the sidewalk, (A) eventually complied with orders to sit on the curb and provided identification. He was then issued a trespass warning and transported to a local shelter due to his intoxicated state.

Narrative: On 11/15/23 at approximately 1430 hours, I responded to 789 Elm Street for a welfare check on a tenant, identified as (S), a 55-year-old Black female. The landlord reported S had not been seen in several days and was refusing to answer the door or communicate, expressing concern for her well-being. Upon arrival, I made contact with the landlord who stated S had become increasingly withdrawn and was exhibiting unusual behavior. After repeated attempts to get S to open the door with no response, and hearing movement inside, the landlord provided officers with a key out of concern for S's safety.

Ofc. [NAME] and I entered the apartment and located S in the living room. S appeared disoriented and agitated, yelling "Get out of my house!" and waving her hands erratically. We attempted to verbally de-escalate the situation, explaining we were there to check on her and ensure her safety. S ignored our commands and began attempting to push past Ofc. [NAME], stating she was "leaving." Due to S's agitated state and concerns for her safety attempting to leave the residence into a busy street, Ofc. [NAME] applied an escort hold to S's left arm to prevent her from exiting. S actively pulled away, tensing her body and attempting to twist out of Ofc. [NAME] grasp. I then assisted by securing S's right arm. S continued to pull and resist, verbally yelling and attempting to kick at our legs. We guided S to a seated position on the couch to prevent further struggle and to allow EMS to evaluate her. S was eventually calmed down and transported by ambulance for evaluation. No further force was necessary after she was seated.

On 07/12/23 at approximately 22:15 hours, I responded to 45 Elm Street for a report of a disorderly male refusing to leave a private residence after being asked by the homeowner (his son). I attempted to engage S in conversation, advising him he needed to leave the property or face arrest for trespassing. I gave S multiple lawful orders to step outside and place his hands behind his back. S ignored these commands, tensing his body and stating, "I'm not going anywhere." Due to S's continued non-compliance and refusal to leave the private property, I informed him he was under arrest.

As I approached S to take him into custody, he stiffened his arms and pulled away, attempting to retreat further into the residence. Ofc. On 03/15/2023 at approximately 1430 hours, I responded to 123 Main St, 'Corner Market,' for a report of a male refusing to leave the premises after being asked by management. Narrative: On 11/15/23 at approximately 2330 hours, I initiated a traffic stop on a vehicle for operating with an expired registration sticker near the intersection of Elm St and Maple Ave. Upon contact with the driver, later identified as (A), I detected a strong odor of an alcoholic beverage emanating from the vehicle and observed (A) to have slurred speech and bloodshot eyes. (A) refused, actively bracing himself against the door frame and pulling his arms away when I attempted to open the door. Due to (A)'s active resistance and signs of intoxication, Ofc. [NAME] and I moved to extract him from the vehicle. (A) continued to pull away, flailing his arms and kicking his legs. Ofc. [NAME] delivered a single open-hand strike to (A)'s thigh, which allowed us to pull him from the driver's seat. (A) continued to struggle on the ground, refusing to present his hands for handcuffing until Ofc. [NAME] applied a pressure point control technique to his jaw. (A) was then secured in handcuffs.

On 07/15/2023 at approximately 22:10 hours, I responded to a report of a highly intoxicated female causing a disturbance outside the 7-Eleven at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a white female, later identified as (A), DOB: XX/XX/85, yelling obscenities at passersby and attempting to block the entrance to the store. On the above date and time, I responded to a call for service regarding a male refusing to leave the premises of a closed business at 1450 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a male, later identified as (A), matching the description, standing near the entrance. Narrative: On the above date and time, I responded to a report of a disorderly subject refusing to leave the premises of the 7-Eleven at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed S, a Black male, age 61, yelling at the store clerk and refusing to exit the store despite repeated requests. Fearing for her immediate safety and given her apparent mental state, I applied a firm grip to her left arm to prevent her from closing the door and secure her for evaluation. (A) tensed up and pulled her arm away, yelling "Get off me!" Ofc. [NAME] assisted by securing her right arm. We then utilized an escort hold to guide (A) out of the residence and to the waiting ambulance. She continued to verbally protest but ceased physical resistance once outside. On 03/15/2024 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded to a report of a disorderly subject at the "Corner Store" located at 123 Main St. Dispatch advised that a female was refusing to leave the premises after being asked by staff due to her erratic behavior and suspected intoxication. Upon arrival, I observed a White female, later identified as A. [NAME] (DOB 01/01/1980), fitting the description, yelling at the store clerk near the counter.

I approached [NAME] and identified myself as a police officer, explaining the reason for my presence and advising her that she needed to leave the store. I placed my hand on her arm, attempting to guide her out of the store while giving verbal commands to comply. [NAME] tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and spun around, pushing me lightly in the chest with both hands.

Due to her active resistance and physical contact, I initiated an escort hold on her left arm. [NAME] continued to struggle, pulling against my grip and refusing to walk willingly. I advised her that she was under arrest for disorderly conduct and resisting arrest. With Ofc. [NAME] assistance, who secured her right arm, we were able to guide [NAME] out of the store and towards my patrol vehicle. She continued to tense her body and attempt to pull away, requiring continuous physical control to place her in the rear of the patrol car. Once inside, she continued to verbally abuse officers.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 1430 hours, I responded to 742 Elm Street for a welfare check on an elderly male, later identified as S, reported to be yelling at neighbors and brandishing a walking stick. Upon arrival, I observed S on his front porch, holding a wooden walking stick approximately three feet long, and shouting obscenities at an empty street. Ofc. [NAME] and I approached cautiously, identifying ourselves and attempting to engage S in conversation. I issued several verbal commands for S to drop the stick and calm down, explaining we were there to help. S ignored these commands, taking a step towards Ofc. On 11/15/23 at approximately 2330 hours, I responded to 145 Main Street (O'[NAME]'s Pub) for a report of an intoxicated male refusing to leave and causing a disturbance. Upon arrival, I observed a White male, later identified as (A), standing near the entrance, yelling obscenities at the bouncer and patrons. (A) appeared heavily intoxicated, swaying and slurring his words. I approached (A) and identified myself as a police officer, instructing him to calm down and step outside to discuss the situation. (A) tensed up, pulled his arm away violently, and took a bladed stance, clenching his fists. Fearing (A) was preparing to assault me, I delivered a quick push to his chest, creating distance. Ofc. (A) actively struggled, twisting his body and pulling against our grip. We were able to maneuver (A) to the ground in a controlled manner, where he continued to thrash his legs. After a brief struggle, we successfully applied handcuffs. (A) was then assisted to his feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle, still verbally abusive.

On the above date and time, I responded to the area of 123 Elm Street for a report of a disturbance involving an intoxicated male refusing to leave a convenience store. Upon arrival, I observed a white male, later identified as (A), standing near the counter, yelling obscenities at the clerk. (A) appeared heavily intoxicated, his speech was slurred, and he was swaying noticeably. I approached (A) and attempted to engage him verbally, advising him he needed to leave the premises. (A) immediately became agitated, turning his aggression towards me, stating, "I ain't going anywhere, you can't make me!" He then took a step towards me in an aggressive manner.

Due to his aggressive demeanor and refusal to comply, I informed (A) he was under arrest for trespassing and disorderly conduct. I gave clear verbal commands to turn around and place his hands behind his back. (A) yelled "No!" and actively pulled his left arm away as I attempted to secure it. Ofc. The drive-stun was effective, causing (A) to momentarily cease resistance, allowing Ofc. [NAME] and I to secure his hands in handcuffs. (A) was then assisted to his feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On the above date and time, I responded to a 911 call reporting a male causing a disturbance and refusing to leave the premises of 789 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed S, later identified as [Subject's Name/initials], a 28-year-old Black male, matching the description, yelling at a store employee. On 11/15/23 at approximately 2330 hours, I responded to 45 Elm St for a report of a suspicious male attempting to open car doors. Upon arrival, I observed a male matching the description, later identified as (S), walking quickly down the sidewalk. I exited my patrol vehicle and made verbal contact, stating "Excuse me sir, can I speak with you for a moment?" (S) looked back, mumbled "I ain't doing nothing," and continued walking away at an increased pace. I ordered (S) to stop and show me his hands. (S) ignored my commands and began to jog. After approximately 50 yards, (S) stumbled and I was able to close the distance. I grabbed (S)'s right arm to prevent further flight and ordered him to place his hands behind his back. (S) immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away forcefully, and spun around, stating "Get off me, I didn't do anything!" Due to (S)'s active resistance and refusal to comply, I performed an arm bar takedown, bringing (S) to the ground in a controlled manner. We delivered several verbal commands to "Stop resisting, put your hands behind your back." Ofc. [NAME] applied a knee strike to (S)'s thigh, which caused (S) to momentarily relax his arm. I was then able to secure (S)'s right wrist in a handcuff. With continued effort, we secured the left wrist. (S) was then searched, transported to booking, and charged with Resisting Arrest and Attempted Breaking and Entering of a Motor Vehicle.

On the above date and time, I responded to 700 Main St for a report of a male refusing to leave a private business after being asked by management. Narrative:

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 14:30 hours, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to a report of an unwanted person at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, we observed a female, later identified as (A), a 56-year-old Black female, sitting on the porch steps, refusing to leave after being asked by the property owner. On the above date and time, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to 123 Elm St for a reported verbal domestic dispute. Narrative: On 11/15/23 at approximately 1430 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to a 911 call regarding a welfare check at 789 Maple Drive. The caller, a neighbor, reported her 65-year-old father, Mr. Arthur [NAME] (A), was disoriented and had been yelling incoherently from his porch for several hours. Upon arrival, we located (A) standing on his front porch, visibly agitated and mumbling to himself. His clothes were disheveled, and he appeared confused.

We attempted to engage (A) in conversation, explaining we were there to ensure his well-being. (A) immediately became defensive, yelling "You're not coming in here!" and waving his arms erratically. He refused to answer basic questions about his name or the date. When Ofc. [NAME] attempted to approach closer to assess his condition, (A) stepped back, tensed his body, and stated, "Don't touch me! I'll fight you!" Fearing for (A)'s safety due to his clear disorientation and potential to fall or wander into the street, I gave multiple verbal commands for him to calm down and cooperate.

(A) ignored my commands and began to move rapidly towards the porch steps, attempting to descend. To prevent him from potentially falling or leaving the property in his disoriented state, I took hold of (A)'s left arm in an escort hold. [NAME] then secured (A)'s right arm, and we utilized a two-officer escort hold to guide him back to a seated position on his porch swing. (A) continued to verbally protest but ceased active physical resistance. EMS was called and transported (A) to St. Jude's Hospital for medical evaluation. No injuries were reported to (A) or officers.

Narrative: On 03/15/2023 at approximately 23:15 hours, I responded to a call for service regarding a disorderly female refusing to leave Willow Creek Park after closing hours. On the above date and time, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to a 911 call regarding a domestic disturbance at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, we observed a White male, later identified as (A), yelling aggressively at a female in the doorway. Narrative:

Narrative: On 11/15/23 at approximately 2015 hours, officers responded to the Public Library at 123 Main St for a report of a disorderly female refusing to leave after closing. Upon arrival, I observed a female (later identified as [A], DOB 01/01/62, White, Female) seated at a table in the main reading area, despite library staff having informed her multiple times that the library was closed. I approached [A] and explained that the library was closed and she needed to leave. [A] looked up briefly, mumbled "I'm not finished," and returned to looking at her book. I repeated the instruction several times, clearly stating she was trespassing and would be arrested if she did not comply. [A] continued to ignore my commands.

After approximately 5 minutes of verbal de-escalation attempts, [A] still refused to move. Ofc. [NAME] and I decided to physically escort [A] out. I took [A]'s right arm, and Ofc. [NAME] took her left arm. As we attempted to guide her from the chair, [A] tensed her body, locked her legs, and pulled her arms away, refusing to stand. We utilized a controlled escort hold, applying minimal pressure to her upper arms to overcome her passive resistance. [A] continued to verbally protest, stating "You can't make me," but did not strike or kick. Due to her continued resistance, we had to physically lift her from the chair and guide her towards the exit. We escorted [A] to the front door and then to the patrol vehicle. She was placed in handcuffs without further incident once at the patrol car, then transported to the station for trespassing. No injuries were observed to [A] or officers.

Narrative: On the above date and time, I responded to 456 Elm Street for a report of a suspicious male attempting to open car doors in a residential parking lot. Upon arrival, I observed a Black male, later identified as [Subject's Name/initials], matching the description, walking between vehicles. I exited my patrol vehicle and identified myself as police, instructing [Subject] to stop and show me his hands. [Subject] immediately turned and began walking away at a quick pace, ignoring my commands. I ordered him to stop several more times, but he continued to evade.

I initiated a foot pursuit, closing the distance as [Subject] attempted to climb a fence into an adjacent yard. As he was halfway over the fence, I grabbed his left leg to prevent him from escaping. [Subject] actively resisted, kicking and twisting his body violently, yelling "Get off me!" and refusing to comply with my orders to stop resisting. Due to his continued resistance and attempts to escape, I delivered a single open-hand strike to his upper thigh to gain compliance. This caused [Subject] to lose his balance and he fell to the ground on the opposite side of the fence. I quickly climbed over and moved to secure him. While on the ground, [Subject] continued to tense his body and attempt to pull his arms under his chest. I applied a knee strike to his mid-back, which allowed me to secure his left arm. With the assistance of Ofc. Green, who arrived moments later, we were able to fully secure [Subject] in handcuffs. He was then assisted to his feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 1930 hours, I responded to 789 Main St (Grocery Store) for a report of a disorderly person refusing to leave the premises. Upon arrival, I made contact with store management who pointed out a female, later identified as (A), who was actively yelling at staff and customers near the checkout aisles. I approached (A) and identified myself as a police officer, explaining the complaint and requesting her to leave the store. (A) immediately became verbally aggressive towards me, stating "I ain't going nowhere, you can't make me leave." She continued to use profanity and draw attention from other patrons. I issued several lawful orders for (A) to exit the store. (A) refused, crossed her arms tightly across her chest, and took a defiant, wide stance. Due to her continued disturbance and refusal to comply, I informed (A) she was under arrest for disorderly conduct and trespass. As I attempted to take her left arm to escort her out, (A) tensed her entire body, pulled her arm away forcefully, and attempted to push past me. Ofc. [NAME] then assisted by securing (A)'s right arm. (A) continued to pull and twist her torso, actively resisting our attempts to move her, yelling loudly "Get off me!" We utilized a joint escort hold to guide (A) towards the exit. She actively resisted walking, dragging her feet and attempting to brace against the door frame. After a brief struggle, we were able to bring (A) outside and secure her in handcuffs. She remained verbally combative during the entire process.

Narrative:
On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Main Street for a report of a highly intoxicated female causing a disturbance outside a convenience store. Upon arrival, I observed S (later identified as [Name], 57 y/o White female) yelling incoherently at passersby, displaying slurred speech, and a strong odor of an alcoholic beverage. I attempted to engage S verbally, asking for her name and if she needed medical assistance. S immediately became agitated, yelling "Leave me alone!" and attempting to walk into oncoming traffic.

Fearing for her safety and the safety of others, I informed S she was being detained for public intoxication and grabbed her left arm to guide her away from the street. S actively resisted by pulling her arm away forcefully, tensing her body, and pushing against my chest with her free hand. Officer [NAME] arrived and assisted, attempting to secure S's right arm. S continued to struggle, twisting her body and kicking her legs. Due to her active resistance and continued attempts to break free, Officer [NAME] and I performed a controlled take-down to the ground to gain control. S continued to resist on the ground, attempting to keep her hands tucked under her body. After several verbal commands to "stop resisting" and "give us your hands," we were able to secure S's hands behind her back in handcuffs. S sustained minor abrasions to her left elbow during the take-down. EMS was requested for evaluation due to intoxication and minor injuries.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 23:15 hours, I responded to the area of 123 Main St. for a report of a male causing a disturbance outside "The Local Tavern." Upon arrival, I observed a White male, later identified as (A), age 25, yelling obscenities at passersby and refusing to leave the establishment's entrance despite requests from bar staff. (A) appeared heavily intoxicated, displaying slurred speech, bloodshot eyes, and an unsteady gait.

I approached (A) and advised him of the complaints, ordering him to cease his disruptive behavior and leave the area. (A) immediately became verbally aggressive, yelling "I ain't going anywhere!" and taking a combative stance by blading his body and clenching his fists. Due to his continued disorderly conduct and refusal to comply, I informed (A) he was under arrest. As I attempted to secure his left arm, (A) tensed up, pulling his arm away forcefully and attempting to spin away from my grasp.

Officer [NAME] arrived to assist. We delivered multiple verbal commands for (A) to stop resisting and place his hands behind his back. (A) continued to pull away, actively resisting our attempts to gain control. Officer [NAME] secured (A)'s right arm while I maintained control of his left. Due to his continued active resistance, I utilized a straight arm bar takedown, bringing (A) to the ground in a controlled manner. While on the ground, (A) continued to tense his body and attempt to pull his arms free. After a brief struggle, Officer [NAME] and I were able to secure (A)'s hands in handcuffs behind his back. (A) was then assisted to his feet and transported without further incident.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 1430 hours, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to 123 Elm Street for a welfare check. The caller reported their 52-year-old mother, identified as S, was exhibiting signs of disorientation, yelling at neighbors, and refusing to answer the door. Upon arrival, we heard S yelling from inside the residence. After repeated verbal commands, S partially opened the door, appearing agitated and confused. S immediately began yelling at officers to leave her property, stating, "I don't need your help! Get out!"

Officers attempted to explain the reason for our presence and offered assistance. S continued to yell, attempting to close the door multiple times. Fearing for S's safety given the reported disorientation, I placed my foot in the doorway to prevent S from closing it completely. S then pushed the door with force, making physical contact with my arm, and attempted to retreat further into the house. Due to S's physical resistance and clear intent to prevent officers from assessing her welfare, Ofc. [NAME] and I entered the residence. S spun around, flailing her arms, and attempted to push Ofc. [NAME]. I secured S's left arm in a control hold, while Ofc. [NAME] secured her right arm. S continued to pull away and tense up, refusing to comply with verbal commands to relax. Officers performed a controlled takedown to the living room couch to prevent further struggle and potential injury. Once seated, S continued to actively resist, leading to the application of handcuffs for her safety and officer safety. S was subsequently transported for a mental health evaluation.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 14:30 hours, officers responded to 123 Elm Street for a report of an unwanted person, later identified as (A), a 60-year-old white female. The caller, the property owner, stated (A) was refusing to leave after being asked multiple times and was yelling at customers. Upon arrival, I observed (A) standing in the doorway, verbally confronting the property owner.

I attempted to de-escalate the situation and explained to (A) that she needed to leave the premises. (A) responded by yelling, "I'm not going anywhere, this is public property!" and attempted to push past me back into the building. I placed my hands on her arms to guide her out, but (A) tensed up, pulled her arms away forcefully, and then swung her right arm, striking my left forearm. Due to her continued resistance and minor assault, I initiated a wrist lock control technique on her right arm. (A) continued to pull away and verbally resist, shouting obscenities. Ofc. [NAME] assisted by securing (A)'s left arm. We were able to gain control and place (A) in handcuffs behind her back. She continued to verbalize her displeasure but ceased physical resistance once handcuffed. (A) was then escorted to my patrol vehicle without further incident and transported to the station for processing.

Narrative: On 11/15/2023 at approximately 1930 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to the city bus terminal regarding a disorderly person refusing to leave the premises. Upon arrival, we observed a Black female, later identified as S, age 65, yelling at a security guard near the main entrance. S appeared agitated and was shouting "I have a right to be here!" when approached. We attempted to de-escalate the situation, giving S multiple verbal commands to calm down and exit the terminal as it was closing. S refused, stating she wouldn't leave and attempted to sit on a nearby bench.

When S ignored further commands to stand and exit, I took S's left arm to guide her towards the exit. S immediately tensed her body, pulled her arm away forcefully, and began to flail her arms, striking my forearm. Due to this active resistance and minor assault, Ofc. [NAME] applied a wrist control technique to S's right arm to gain compliance. S dropped to her knees, continuing to pull and yell obscenities. To prevent S from falling uncontrollably and to safely secure her, we initiated a controlled takedown to the ground. S was then secured in handcuffs in the prone position. Once cuffed, S ceased physical resistance but continued to verbally protest. S was assisted back to her feet, checked for injuries, and transported to the precinct for booking.

On the above date and time, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to a 911 call regarding a male causing a disturbance at the corner of Main St and Elm Ave. The caller reported a male, later identified as S, yelling obscenities at pedestrians and blocking the sidewalk. Upon arrival, we observed S matching the description, actively yelling at a woman pushing a stroller.

I approached S and identified myself as police, giving verbal commands to cease his behavior and step to the side. S immediately turned his aggression towards me, yelling "I ain't doing shit!" and advancing slightly. I ordered S to stop and place his hands behind his back. S refused, stating "You can't touch me" and clenching his fists. Due to his aggressive posture and non-compliance, I informed S he was under arrest for disorderly conduct.

As Ofc. [NAME] attempted to grab S's left arm, S violently pulled away, twisting his body and attempting to swing his right elbow back towards Ofc. [NAME]. I then secured S's right arm, and together we initiated a control hold. S continued to actively resist, tensing his body and trying to pull free. We guided S to the ground in a controlled manner, where he continued to struggle, tucking his hands beneath his chest. I delivered two open-hand strikes to S's side, which allowed Ofc. [NAME] to secure S's left wrist in handcuffs. I then secured S's right wrist. S continued to yell but ceased physical resistance once handcuffed. He was then escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On the above date and time, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to 123 Elm Street for a welfare check. Dispatch advised a neighbor reported a male, later identified as (S) [Race=WHITE, Sex=MALE, Age=65], was yelling incoherent statements from his porch and appeared disoriented. Upon arrival, we observed (S) standing on his porch, highly agitated and gesturing wildly. I attempted to engage (S) verbally, explaining our presence and asking if he needed assistance. (S) immediately became defensive, yelling, "Get off my property! You're not allowed here!" and refused to provide identification or calm down.

After several attempts to de-escalate and ensure his well-being, (S) made a sudden movement towards the front door, attempting to go back inside while continuing to yell. Concerned for his safety and our inability to assess his condition, Ofc. [NAME] and I moved to prevent him from barricading himself inside. As I reached for (S)'s arm to guide him away from the door and conduct a pat-down for weapons, (S) tensed up, pulled his arm away forcefully, and attempted to push past me. (S) continued to verbally resist and tense his body, refusing to walk. On 11/15/23 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to 123 Main St regarding a report of a male causing a disturbance inside a restaurant. Upon arrival, I observed a White male, later identified as [Subject's Name/A], 44, yelling at staff and refusing to leave. I approached (A) and identified myself as police, instructing him to step outside. (A) turned towards me, stating "I ain't going anywhere, pig," and took a bladed stance. I gave repeated verbal commands for (A) to place his hands behind his back, but he refused, clenching his fists. Fearing (A) was preparing to assault me or other patrons, I attempted to gain control of his left arm. (A) immediately tensed up, pulling his arm away forcefully and attempting to spin around. Ofc. [NAME] simultaneously grabbed (A)'s right arm. Due to (A)'s active resistance, Ofc. [NAME] and I initiated a controlled takedown to the ground. (A) continued to struggle on the ground, tucking his arms underneath his body and refusing to release them for handcuffing. I delivered a single knee strike to (A)'s left thigh, which caused him to momentarily cease resistance, allowing Ofc. [NAME] to secure his right wrist. I then applied pressure to (A)'s mandibular angle, causing him to bring his left arm out from under his body. We were then able to successfully handcuff (A) without further incident. (A) was placed under arrest for disorderly conduct and resisting arrest.

Narrative: On the above date and time, I responded to a report of a disturbance at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a female, later identified as (A), yelling loudly at a store employee and blocking the entrance. (A) matched the description provided by dispatch. I approached (A) and gave verbal commands for her to calm down and step away from the entrance. (A) ignored my commands, turned towards me, and began yelling, "You can't tell me what to do!" while taking a step forward.

Due to (A)'s aggressive posture and refusal to comply, I attempted to create distance and guide her away by taking hold of her left arm. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and attempted to spin around, actively resisting my control. She then swung her right arm towards my chest. Ofc. [NAME], who was assisting, secured (A)'s right arm. As (A) continued to actively resist, twisting her body and attempting to pull free, Ofc. [NAME] and I performed a controlled takedown to the ground to gain compliance and prevent further assault.

On the ground, (A) continued to struggle, tucking her hands under her body to prevent handcuffing. Ofc. [NAME] delivered two closed-fist strikes to (A)'s upper back/shoulder area to overcome her active resistance. After the strikes, (A) momentarily relaxed, allowing officers to secure her hands in handcuffs.
