Narrative:
On 11/15/23 at approximately 2215 hours, I (Ofc. [NAME]) responded with Ofc. [NAME] to a 911 call reporting a domestic disturbance at 123 Main St. The caller reported a male, later identified as S, yelling and throwing objects inside the residence. Upon arrival, I observed S through a window, highly agitated and yelling into a phone. A female party was visible in the background, appearing distressed. I knocked and announced "Police." S opened the door slightly, immediately becoming verbally abusive, stating "You have no right to be here!" and attempting to close the door. Fearing for the safety of the female, Ofc. [NAME] and I pushed the door open to prevent S from barricading himself. We gave S multiple verbal commands to step outside and place his hands behind his back. S refused, yelling "Get out of my house!" and tensed his body, pulling his arms into his chest. He then took a bladed stance, clenching his fists. Fearing S was preparing to assault us, Ofc. [NAME] attempted a wristlock control technique on S's left arm. S actively resisted, pulling away and attempting to spin out of Ofc. [NAME] grip. I then moved in and secured S's right arm, attempting to bring both arms behind his back. S continued to struggle violently, pulling, kicking, and attempting to headbutt Ofc. [NAME]. Due to S's continued violent resistance, I delivered two closed-hand strikes to S's right upper thigh, which caused S to momentarily lose balance and relax his grip. This allowed Ofc. [NAME] and I to gain control of S's arms and bring him to the ground in a controlled manner. Once on the ground, S continued to tense and resist, but with combined efforts, we were able to secure his hands in handcuffs. S remained verbally aggressive during transport but complied with further orders. S complained of minor pain to his thigh but refused medical attention.

On the above date and time, I responded to 1420 Main St for a report of a male trespassing and refusing to leave a private parking lot. Upon arrival, I observed a Black male, later identified as (S), standing next to a vehicle, yelling loudly and appearing agitated. (S) matched the description provided by dispatch. I approached (S) and identified myself, advising him that the property owner wanted him to leave. (S) immediately became verbally aggressive, stating "I'm not going anywhere, you can't make me!" and began pacing erratically. I gave repeated verbal commands for (S) to calm down and comply with my orders to vacate the property. (S) ignored these commands, continued to shout obscenities, and clenched his fists, taking a bladed stance towards me. Fearing an imminent physical altercation, I presented my department-issued taser and gave clear verbal warnings to "Stop resisting, or you will be tased!" (S) paused momentarily but then began to back away slowly, still yelling and refusing to fully comply. As Ofc. [NAME] arrived, we attempted to guide (S) off the property using an escort hold. (S) immediately tensed his body, pulled his arms away, and attempted to spin out of our grasp. Due to his active resistance, Ofc. [NAME] applied a straight arm bar control technique, and I assisted by securing (S)'s other arm. (S) continued to struggle, requiring both officers to apply force to bring him under control and place him in handcuffs.

Narrative:
On 11/15/23 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded to 123 Elm St for a welfare check. Dispatch reported a caller was concerned about their neighbor, (A), who had been screaming inside her residence for several hours. Upon arrival, I observed (A) standing in her doorway, visibly intoxicated, slurring her words, and yelling incomprehensibly. I attempted to engage (A) in conversation, explaining the nature of my visit and offering assistance. (A) immediately became agitated, yelling "Get off my property!" and attempting to close the door. Fearing for her safety and due to the ongoing disturbance, I placed my foot in the doorframe to prevent it from closing fully. (A) then pushed against the door with her full body weight, attempting to force it shut, nearly trapping my foot. I instructed (A) to stop resisting and step back. She refused, continuing to push the door and flail her arms. I then grabbed (A)'s left arm in an attempt to pull her away from the door and gain control. (A) pulled away violently, twisting her body and screaming. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted. We utilized an escort hold to guide (A) away from the door. (A) continued to resist, tensing her body and attempting to pull free, requiring both officers to maintain control. We eventually guided her outside and placed her in handcuffs for her safety and to prevent further disturbance. She was then transported for evaluation.

Narrative: On the above date and time, I responded to a report of a disturbance at 456 Elm Street. Dispatch advised a female was refusing to leave a convenience store and was causing a public disturbance. Upon arrival, I observed a female, later identified as S (DOB: XX/XX/2002), yelling at the store clerk and blocking the entrance. I advised S that she needed to leave the premises or she would be trespassed. S immediately turned her aggression towards me, yelling, "I ain't going anywhere! You can't make me!" and began using profanities. She refused multiple verbal commands to calm down and step outside.

As I attempted to guide S out of the store using an escort hold on her left arm, S pulled away violently, jerking her arm free and stepping back. She then balled her fists and took a combative stance, stating, "Get your hands off me!" Fearing S would assault me, I delivered a single open-hand push to S's upper torso to create distance and gain compliance. S stumbled backward but continued to resist, flailing her arms. Ofc. [NAME] arrived and assisted. We secured S's left arm, and after a brief struggle where S continued to pull away and kick at officers, we brought her to the ground to apply handcuffs. S was secured in handcuffs after being placed in a prone position. She continued to be verbally abusive but ceased physical resistance once restrained. S was then assisted to her feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle.

Narrative:
On the above date and time, I responded with Ofc. [NAME] to a report of a disorderly male refusing to leave the Speedway at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a white male, later identified as (A), standing near the counter, yelling profanities at the clerk and appearing heavily intoxicated. I gave verbal commands for (A) to calm down and step outside to speak with us. (A) turned towards us, pointed his finger, and yelled, "I ain't going anywhere! You can't make me!"

I again ordered (A) to exit the store. (A) took a step towards the exit but then abruptly stopped, tensed his body, and attempted to push past Ofc. [NAME], stating, "Get out of my way!" Ofc. [NAME] attempted to block (A)'s path, and (A) then shoved Ofc. [NAME] in the chest with both hands. I immediately grabbed (A)'s left arm and Ofc. [NAME] secured his right arm. (A) began to actively resist, pulling his arms away and thrashing his body, trying to break free. I delivered a closed-fist strike to (A)'s left bicep, which caused him to momentarily falter. Ofc. [NAME] then swept (A)'s legs, and we took him to the ground in a controlled manner. While on the ground, (A) continued to tuck his hands under his chest, refusing to comply with orders to show his hands. After several verbal commands and a knee strike to his lower back, (A) finally exposed his hands, allowing Ofc. [NAME] to secure him in handcuffs. (A) was then assisted up and transported to booking without further incident.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2315 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to 123 Main St for a report of a disorderly patron refusing to leave the establishment. Upon arrival, we observed S (later identified as [Name], W/F, 25) standing in the doorway, yelling obscenities at bar staff who were attempting to get her to exit. We approached S and identified ourselves as police. We advised S that she needed to leave the premises as requested by management. S immediately became agitated, yelling "I'm not leaving!" and attempted to push past Ofc. [NAME] to re-enter the bar.

Due to S's aggressive behavior and refusal to comply, I took S's right arm in an attempt to escort her out. S immediately tensed up, pulled her arm away, and attempted to spin around to face me. I then applied a modified arm bar control hold to S's right arm to gain compliance. S continued to actively resist, pulling her arm, kicking her legs, and yelling loudly. Ofc. [NAME] assisted by securing S's left arm, and together we escorted S out the front door of the establishment. S continued to pull away and yell obscenities, refusing to walk on her own. Due to S's continued active resistance, she was placed in handcuffs behind her back. S kept her arms tense, making handcuffing challenging, but it was eventually achieved. S was then escorted to my patrol vehicle. S refused to enter, bracing her feet and pulling backward. Ofc. [NAME] and I had to physically lift and place S into the rear passenger seat for transport.

Narrative: On 03/15/2023 at approximately 23:10 hours, I responded to 123 Main St regarding a report of an intoxicated male refusing to leave a private residence and becoming verbally abusive. Upon arrival, I made contact with the homeowner and the subject, identified as (A), a 38-year-old white male. (A) was highly intoxicated, slurring his words, and yelling at the homeowner. I attempted to de-escalate the situation and gave (A) several verbal commands to calm down and leave the property. (A) refused, stating "I'm not going anywhere, this is my house!" and stepped aggressively towards me. Due to his level of intoxication, aggressive posture, and refusal to comply, I informed (A) he was under arrest for disorderly conduct.

I attempted to grab (A)'s left arm to place him in handcuffs. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled his arm away forcefully, and spun around, pushing me backward with his chest. Officer [NAME] then moved in to assist. We both gave repeated verbal commands to stop resisting and place his hands behind his back. (A) continued to flail his arms and actively resist our attempts to control him. Officer [NAME] delivered a controlled takedown, bringing (A) to the ground in a prone position. (A) continued to struggle on the ground, tucking his arms underneath his body. I delivered two closed-fist strikes to (A)'s left deltoid area to gain compliance. After the strikes, (A) momentarily ceased resisting, allowing Officer [NAME] to secure his left hand and I secured his right hand in handcuffs. (A) was then assisted to his feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle, continuing to yell obscenities.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 14:30 hours, I responded to 789 Maple St for a report of a tenant refusing to vacate the premises and causing a disturbance. Upon arrival, I observed a female, later identified as (A), standing on the porch, yelling at the landlord. (A) matched the description provided by dispatch: a Black female, approximately 60 years of age. I approached (A) and attempted to speak with her, explaining the legal process and requesting her to calm down. (A) became increasingly agitated, stating "You can't make me leave!" and began to walk back into the residence, ignoring my verbal commands to stop and speak with officers.

Fearing further escalation and to prevent her from barricading herself or causing additional damage, I placed my left hand on (A)'s right arm to guide her outside. (A) immediately tensed up, pulled her arm away forcefully, and attempted to push past me. She continued to yell obscenities and actively resisted my attempts to gain control of her arm. Ofc. [NAME] then assisted, taking hold of (A)'s left arm. Despite repeated verbal commands to stop resisting and place her hands behind her back, (A) continued to pull away, stiffening her body. Due to her continued active resistance and refusal to comply, Ofc. [NAME] and I utilized a controlled escort hold to guide (A) to the ground. Once on the ground, (A) continued to struggle briefly, kicking her legs, before we were able to secure her hands behind her back in handcuffs. (A) was then assisted to her feet and transported.

Narrative:
On 11/15/23 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to the area of 45 Elm St for a report of a loud disturbance and a large group refusing to disperse from private property. Upon arrival, I observed approximately 15-20 individuals gathered in front of a closed business, consuming alcohol and playing loud music. As I approached, several individuals began to scatter. I identified a female, later identified as (A), who matched a description provided by a previous caller regarding a trespasser. I gave (A) verbal orders to disperse and leave the property. Fearing an imminent assault, I initiated a controlled takedown, grabbing (A)'s left arm and guiding her to the ground. (A) actively resisted, tensing her body and attempting to pull her arm free. I maintained control of her arm and, with the assistance of Ofc. [NAME], we were able to bring her hands behind her back. (A) continued to pull and twist, yelling profanities, but we successfully applied handcuffs. Narrative:
On 03/15/2023 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded with Officer [NAME] to a report of a disorderly female refusing to leave the premises of the 7-Eleven at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, we observed a Black female, later identified as (A), standing outside the entrance, yelling obscenities at customers and staff. Her speech was slurred, and she exhibited signs of intoxication. I approached (A) and instructed her to calm down and leave the property. Once on the ground, (A) continued to struggle, trying to roll over and keep her hands underneath her. Officer [NAME] applied pressure to her left shoulder, and I secured her right arm. After a brief struggle, we were able to bring her arms behind her back and apply handcuffs. (A) was then assisted to her feet and transported to the precinct without further incident.

On 07/12/23 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded to a report of a disturbance at 1500 Main St, involving a female refusing to leave a convenience store. Due to her continued non-compliance and aggressive demeanor, I advised her that she was under arrest for disorderly conduct. Narrative: On 11/15/23 at approximately 2030 hours, I responded to the area of 540 Main Street for a report of a disorderly female refusing to leave a restaurant. Upon arrival, I observed a White female, later identified as (A), age 52, standing in front of the establishment yelling profanities at patrons and staff. (A) displayed signs of intoxication, including slurred speech and an unsteady gait. I attempted to engage (A) verbally, advising her she needed to leave the private property or she would be arrested for trespass. As (A) attempted to push past me, I placed my hands on her upper arms to prevent her entry and guide her away from the door. (A) immediately tensed her body, pulled her arms away forcefully, and swung her left arm, striking my right forearm. Due to (A)'s continued resistance and assaultive behavior, I initiated a control hold, securing her left arm behind her back. (A) continued to struggle, twisting her body and attempting to kick backwards. Officer [NAME] arrived on scene and assisted by securing (A)'s right arm. We were able to gain control and place (A) in handcuffs. (A) continued to scream and resist while being escorted to the patrol vehicle, requiring two officers to guide her into the rear seat. She was transported to the station for booking.

On the above date and time, I responded to a call for a suspicious person reported to be trying door handles of businesses in the 1400 block of Elm Street. Upon arrival, I observed a male matching the description, later identified as (A), standing near the entrance of a closed restaurant. As I exited my patrol vehicle, I verbally identified myself and asked (A) to stop and speak with me. (A) immediately turned away and began walking quickly down the sidewalk, ignoring my commands to stop.

I increased my pace, reiterating my commands. (A) then yelled "I ain't do nothing!" and began to run. I initiated a foot pursuit, continually ordering (A) to stop. After approximately 50 yards, (A) cut through a narrow alleyway. As I entered the alley, (A) abruptly stopped and turned towards me, clenching his fists and adopting an aggressive stance. Fearing an imminent assault, I gave verbal commands to "show me your hands" and "get on the ground." (A) refused, yelling "get away from me!" and took a step forward.

To prevent an assault and effect an arrest for trespassing and evading, I grabbed (A)'s left arm and attempted a straight armbar takedown. (A) actively resisted, pulling his arm away and struggling violently. During the struggle, I utilized a leg sweep, bringing (A) to the ground onto his side. (A) continued to resist on the ground, attempting to push himself up. With the assistance of Ofc. [NAME], who arrived moments later, we were able to secure (A)'s hands behind his back in handcuffs after a brief struggle. (A) was then escorted to my patrol vehicle without further incident.

Narrative:
On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Elm St regarding a domestic disturbance. Dispatch advised a male, later identified as (A), was intoxicated and refusing to leave the residence, actively arguing with the homeowner. Upon arrival, I observed (A) standing in the doorway, yelling loudly at a female inside. His speech was slurred, and he appeared agitated. I gave several verbal commands for (A) to step outside and calm down. (A) ignored my commands, instead turning his attention to me, stating, 'You can't make me do anything!' and took a step towards me, clenching his fists.

I verbally ordered (A) to stop and put his hands behind his back. (A) refused, stating 'I'm not going anywhere!' and began to advance towards me in an aggressive manner. Fearing for my safety and anticipating an assault, I created distance and presented my department-issued taser, giving a loud verbal warning, 'Taser! Stop resisting or you will be tased!' (A) hesitated for a moment but then lunged forward. I deployed the taser, striking (A) in the torso. The taser deployment was effective, causing (A) to immediately fall to the ground. Ofc. [NAME] then moved in and secured (A)'s hands behind his back in handcuffs. (A) continued to verbally protest but was physically incapacitated and unable to resist further. EMS was requested to assess (A) prior to transport.

Narrative:
On 11/15/2023 at approximately 1430 hours, I responded to the main branch of the Public Library for a report of a disorderly person refusing to leave. Upon arrival, library staff identified the subject as a Black female, later identified as S, age 55, who had been asked to leave due to persistent disruptive behavior and was now refusing to exit the premises.

I approached S, who was seated at a table, and explained the reason for police presence, advising her that she needed to gather her belongings and leave. S immediately became verbally argumentative, raising her voice and stating, "I have every right to be here, you can't make me do anything." I issued several lawful orders for S to stand up and walk towards the exit. S refused, crossing her arms and tensing her body, stating, "I told you no, leave me alone." Due to S's continued non-compliance and refusal to leave after multiple warnings, Ofc. [NAME] and I decided to physically escort S from the building.

As I took S's left arm in an escort hold, S actively pulled away, tensing her arm and attempting to twist her body out of my grasp. Ofc. [NAME] secured S's right arm. S continued to resist our attempts to guide her, digging her heels into the ground and refusing to walk towards the exit. We maintained our escort holds, applying controlled pressure to prevent her from pulling free. S then momentarily lost her balance while actively pulling away, and we utilized this opportunity to guide her into a controlled descent to the ground to prevent further struggle and safely apply handcuffs. S continued to tense her body and pull her hands away during handcuffing but was eventually secured without further incident. S was then assisted to her feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 22:15 hours, I responded to 742 Elm Street for a report of a suspicious person loitering in the parking lot of a closed business. Upon arrival, I observed a white male, later identified as (A), standing near the rear entrance of the building. The business was clearly marked with 'No Trespassing' signs.

I exited my patrol vehicle and made verbal contact with (A), advising him of the complaint and requesting his identification. (A) immediately became defensive, stating, "I'm not doing anything wrong, leave me alone" and refused to provide any identification or explain his presence. I gave multiple lawful orders for (A) to identify himself and to leave the property. (A) ignored these commands, turned his back to me, and began walking away towards the rear of the lot, stating, "You can't hold me here."

Fearing (A) was attempting to flee or access a concealed area, I moved to intercept him. As I approached, (A) abruptly turned and pushed me in the chest with both hands. I immediately initiated a take-down maneuver, securing (A)'s left arm and guiding him to the ground in a controlled manner. (A) continued to resist by tensing his body and attempting to pull his arm free. I delivered two knee strikes to (A)'s left thigh to gain compliance. After the strikes, (A) ceased actively resisting, allowing me to secure his left arm and place him in handcuffs with the assistance of Ofc. [NAME], who had arrived on scene.

On 03/15/2024 at approximately 22:15 hours, I responded to 123 Elm St for a welfare check on a female, identified as (A), who was reported by a family member to be heavily intoxicated and making suicidal statements. Upon arrival, I made contact with (A) inside the residence. She was highly agitated, slurring her words, and holding a broken glass bottle. I immediately gave verbal commands for (A) to drop the bottle and step away. (A) refused, yelling profanities and stating she would not go anywhere with officers. She then began to cut her own wrist with the broken bottle.

Fearing for her immediate safety and the safety of officers, I attempted to disarm (A). (A) actively resisted, pulling her arm away and swinging the bottle towards me. Ofc. [NAME] simultaneously moved to secure her other arm. Due to (A)'s violent resistance and continued attempts to harm herself, I utilized an open-hand palm heel strike to her right shoulder to create separation and gain control of the bottle. The strike was effective, causing (A) to drop the bottle, which shattered on the floor. (A) then attempted to kick Ofc. [NAME]. We were able to gain control of her arms and guide her to the floor in a controlled manner to prevent further injury. While on the ground, (A) continued to thrash and scream, but we were able to apply handcuffs. She was then transported for evaluation.

On 03/15/2024 at approximately 1430 hours, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to a civil dispute at 456 Elm Street. Dispatch advised a utility worker was attempting to access the rear of the property for a mandatory gas line inspection, but the homeowner, later identified as (A) [Race=BLACK, Sex=FEMALE, Age=65], was refusing entry and blocking the gate. Upon arrival, we observed (A) standing firmly in front of a side gate, verbally confronting a utility employee.

We attempted to de-escalate the situation, explaining the necessity of the inspection and asking (A) to step aside. (A) became increasingly agitated, yelling "You're not coming on my property!" and waving her hands dismissively. She stated she didn't trust the utility company and refused to move. After multiple verbal commands to allow access or move to a safe distance were ignored, and with the utility worker stating the inspection was critical, Ofc. [NAME] informed (A) that she would be escorted away if she continued to obstruct. (A) responded by tensing her body and bracing herself against the gate frame.

I then took hold of (A)'s left arm to guide her away from the gate. (A) immediately tensed up, pulling her arm away from my grasp and attempting to twist her body. She continued to shout, "Don't touch me!" and resisted my attempts to gain control of her arm. Due to her active resistance and continued obstruction, Ofc. [NAME] assisted by securing (A)'s right arm. We utilized a two-officer escort hold, carefully guiding (A) approximately 10 feet away from the gate to allow the utility worker access. (A) continued to verbally protest but ceased active physical resistance once moved. No further force was used.

On 03/12/2024 at approximately 22:15 hours, I responded to 123 Elm St for a report of a domestic disturbance. Dispatch advised a male, identified as (A), was intoxicated and refusing to leave the residence of his ex-girlfriend, Ms. [NAME]. Upon arrival, I observed (A) standing in the doorway, yelling obscenities at Ms. [NAME], who appeared visibly distressed. I ordered (A) to step outside and speak with me. (A) turned his attention to me, stated "You can't make me do anything," and attempted to re-enter the apartment. Fearing for Ms. [NAME]'s safety and to de-escalate the situation, I stepped in front of (A) and repeated my order to step outside. (A) then aggressively pushed past me with his left shoulder, attempting to enter the apartment. I grabbed (A)'s left arm and attempted to guide him out. (A) tensed up, pulled his arm away, and swung his right elbow back towards my chest. I delivered a quick open-hand push to (A)'s upper chest, creating distance. (A) stumbled back, then squared his stance, clenching his fists. I presented my taser and gave loud verbal commands for (A) to get on the ground and place his hands behind his back. (A) paused, looked at the taser, and slowly knelt, placing his hands behind his back. I secured (A) in handcuffs without further incident. (A) continued to be verbally uncooperative but complied with physical commands during transport.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 2310 hours, I responded to 145 Main St. for a report of a highly intoxicated female refusing to leave a business and causing a disturbance. Upon arrival, I observed a white female, later identified as (A), standing outside the entrance, yelling obscenities at staff and passing pedestrians. I approached (A) and attempted to engage her in conversation, asking her name and if she needed medical assistance. (A) immediately became defensive, stating "mind your own business" and attempting to walk away from me into the street. I advised (A) that she was creating a public disturbance and needed to either calm down or be placed into protective custody. (A) ignored my commands and continued to walk into traffic.

On the above date and time, I responded to a call for service at 123 Main St regarding a trespasser refusing to leave a private business. On 07/12/2023 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded to a report of a highly intoxicated female causing a disturbance outside "The Corner Pub" at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, I observed a white female, later identified as (A) [Subject's Name], age 54, matching the description, yelling at patrons and attempting to block the entrance. Narrative:

Narrative:
On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Main St, The Rusty Mug bar, for a report of an intoxicated male refusing to leave the premises and causing a disturbance. Upon arrival, I observed S, later identified as [Name Redacted], a white male, age 47, standing near the bar, yelling loudly at staff and patrons. His face was flushed, and his speech was slurred. S ignored my commands, clenched his fists, and adopted an aggressive stance. He yelled, "Get out of my face!" and then pushed my right shoulder with both hands. On 03/12/2023 at approximately 2215 hours, I responded to a dispatch call regarding a disorderly male causing a disturbance at Willow Creek Park. Narrative:
On 11/15/2023 at approximately 14:15 hours, I responded to a 911 call regarding a shoplifting in progress at "MegaMart" where the suspect was actively resisting loss prevention personnel. Upon arrival, I observed Subject (A), a Black female, 33 years of age, attempting to pull away from two store security officers near the main entrance. Subject (A) was yelling loudly, "Get your hands off me, I didn't do anything!" and actively tensing her body, preventing LP from gaining control.

I approached and issued clear verbal commands, "Ma'am, stop resisting! Put your hands behind your back!" Subject (A) ignored my commands, continued to struggle, and began to flail her arms in an aggressive manner, nearly striking one of the LP officers. Due to her active resistance and the potential for injury to herself or others, I made the decision to physically intervene. I secured Subject (A)'s left arm in a wristlock and attempted to guide her hands behind her back for handcuffing. Subject (A) responded by tensing her entire body, pulling away forcefully, and attempting to spin out of my grip. She then dropped her weight, causing both of us to go to the ground.

On the ground, Subject (A) continued to actively resist, kicking her legs and attempting to push herself up. I maintained the wristlock, giving continuous verbal commands to stop resisting. Officer [NAME] arrived and assisted by securing Subject (A)'s right arm. After a brief struggle, we were able to bring Subject (A)'s hands together and apply handcuffs. Subject (A) remained verbally combative while being escorted to the patrol vehicle but ceased physical resistance. She was then transported to the precinct for booking.

On 11/15/23 at approximately 1430 hours, I responded to a shoplifting in progress call at "Quick Stop" located at 123 Main St. Upon arrival, store management identified a female, later identified as (A), D.O.B. [year - 19], who was attempting to exit the store with unpaid merchandise. I approached (A), identified myself as a police officer, and informed her she was being detained for suspected shoplifting. (A) immediately became verbally aggressive, yelling "You can't touch me! I didn't do anything!" On the ground, (A) tucked her hands underneath her body and refused to comply with repeated verbal commands to show her hands. Officer [NAME] arrived and assisted in securing (A)'s right hand, and she was successfully handcuffed without further incident. (A) was then assisted to her feet and escorted to the patrol vehicle for transport.

On the above date and time, Ofc. [NAME] and I responded to 123 Main St. for a welfare check on a female, later identified as (A), reported to be yelling and breaking items inside her apartment. Narrative: On the above date and time, I initiated a traffic stop on a black Honda Accord for an expired inspection sticker in the area of Maple Ave and 14th St. Upon approach, the driver, later identified as S, a Black male, age 20, refused to lower his window completely, only cracking it an inch. I requested S's license and registration multiple times. S stated, "I ain't doing nothing wrong," and kept his hands out of sight below the dashboard. Due to S's non-compliance and obscured hands, I ordered S to show his hands and open the door. S continued to refuse, yelling, "You can't make me!" and began making furtive movements towards the passenger seat. Fearing S was reaching for a weapon or attempting to conceal evidence, I opened the driver's door. S immediately tensed up and pushed against the door, attempting to close it on me. I grabbed S's left arm and ordered him to exit the vehicle. S pulled his arm away forcefully, twisting his body and bracing his feet to resist being removed. Ofc. [NAME] arrived on scene and assisted. We attempted to pull S from the vehicle. S continued to brace, pulling away and yelling "Get off me!" I delivered two open-hand strikes to S's left bicep to break his grip and gain compliance. S then released his brace, and we were able to pull him out of the vehicle. Once out, S continued to struggle, flailing his arms. Ofc. [NAME] performed a controlled takedown to the ground. On the ground, S continued to tuck his hands under his body, refusing to present them for handcuffing. I delivered one knee strike to S's lower back. S then complied, and we were able to secure his hands in handcuffs. S was then placed in the rear of my patrol vehicle. S continued to be verbally uncooperative but offered no further physical resistance.

On 03/15/2023 at approximately 22:15 hours, I responded to 123 Main St for a report of an intoxicated male causing a disturbance and refusing to leave the premises. Narrative: On the above date and time, I responded to 123 Elm St, Apartment 4B, for a 911 call reporting a verbal disturbance. Upon arrival, I made contact with a female, later identified as S, through a partially open door. S appeared highly agitated, yelling incoherently and refusing to fully open the door or step outside. S then forcefully pushed against the door, attempting to close it on my foot. Ofc. [NAME] arrived on scene and we verbally ordered S to stop resisting and step away from the door. On 11/15/23 at approximately 20:15 hours, I responded to 742 Elm Street for a welfare check. Narrative:

Narrative:

Narrative:
